abilities.desc: Each time this model's unit ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

abilities.name: Raider's Due
abilities.desc:
When this unit declares a charge, if an enemy unit within range of an objective is within 12" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do:
- This unit can re-roll that charge roll.
- This unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc: This model can be attached to the following units: ^^**Chosen, Legionaries, Nemesis Claw, Red Corsairs Raiders**^^

mark.name: Khorne
mark.ability: Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of this model's hellforged weapons.

mark.name: Nurgle
mark.ability: Add 1 to this model's Toughness characteristic.

mark.name: Slaanesh
mark.ability: Add 2" to this model's Move characteristic.

mark.name: Tzeentch
mark.ability: Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this model's infernal cannon.

abilities.name: Headlong Destruction
abilities.desc: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets the closest eligible enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

abilities.name: Architect of Ruin
abilities.desc: At the start of the battle, select one unit in your opponent’s army to be this model’s hated foe. Each time this model makes an attack that targets its hated foe, you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model’s hated foe is destroyed, you can select a new unit from your opponent’s army to be its hated foe.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc: This model can be attached to the following units: ^^**Chaos Terminator Squad, Mutilators, Obliterators.**^^

abilities.name: Wall of Muscle
abilities.desc: Each time an attack is allocated to a model in this unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

abilities.name: Renegade Plague Ogryns
abilities.desc: For the purposes of embarking within TRANSPORTS, each Renegade Plague Ogryn model counts as one TERMINATOR model.

abilities.name: Voltagheist Field
abilities.desc: Each time this unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6 for each model in this unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

abilities.name: Servants of the Abyss
abilities.desc: If a unit from your army with the Leader ability can be attached to a CULTIST MOB, it can be attached to this unit instead.

abilities.name: Mischief Makers (Aura)
abilities.desc: While an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within 6" of this unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Hovering Death
abilities.desc: This model is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

abilities.name: Dreadclaw Drop Pod
abilities.desc: This model has a transport capacity of 12 HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models. Each JUMP PACK, POSSESSED and TERMINATOR model takes up the space of 2 models. Each OBLITERATOR model takes up the space of 3 models. This model can instead transport 1 HELBRUTE or DREADNOUGHT model.

abilities.name: Dreadclaw Assault
abilities.desc: This model must start the battle in Reserves, but neither it nor any units embarked within it are counted towards any limits placed on the maximum number of Reserves units you can start the battle with. This model can be set up in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules. Any units embarked within this model can disembark after it has been set up on the battlefield, and if they do they must be set up more than 9" away from all enemy models.

abilities.name: Scuttling Gait
abilities.desc: Each time this unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

subAbilities.name: Impaled
subAbilities.desc: Each time this weapon scores a hit against an enemy Monster or Vehicle unit, until the end of the turn, if the bearer selects that unit as a target of a charge, add 2 to Charge rolls made for the bearer

abilities.name: Runes of the Blood God
abilities.desc: This model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-9 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-9 wounds remaining, subtract 5 from this model’s Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-8 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-8 wounds remaining, subtract 5 from this model’s Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.desc: Each time this model makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, its melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, once per battle, this model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-10 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-10 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Aerial Assault
abilities.desc: Each time a unit with the Deep Strike ability disembarks from this model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

abilities.name: Chaos Thunderhawk
abilities.desc: This model has a transport capacity of 30 Heretic Astartes INFANTRY or Heretic Astartes MOUNTED models. Each JUMP PACK, POSSESSED and TERMINATOR model takes up the space of 2 models. Each OBLITERATOR model takes up the space of 3 models. Each MOUNTED model takes up the space of 4 models.

options.name: Thunderhawk cluster bombs
options.ability: Each time the bearer ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit it moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 3+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

detData._format: Each detachment has optional 'ruleName' + 'rule' (string) and 'stratagems' (array of {name, type, cp, when, target, effect}). Rebuild with build.ps1 after editing.

stratagems.name: Example Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase
stratagems.target: One unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: What the stratagem does.

Pactbound Zealots.rule:
When mustering, each non-EPIC HERO HERETIC ASTARTES unit must be given a Mark keyword (Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, Slaanesh, or Chaos Undivided). Each time a marked unit gains a weapon ability from a Dark Pact and does not fail the Leadership test, until the end of the phase it also gains the associated ability:
If it gained [LETHAL HITS] — Khorne: melee Critical Hit on unmodified 5+. Tzeentch: ranged Critical Hit on 5+. Chaos Undivided: re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
If it gained [SUSTAINED HITS 1] — Nurgle: ranged Critical Hit on 5+. Slaanesh: melee Critical Hit on 5+. Chaos Undivided: re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
Restrictions: A CHARACTER/EPIC HERO unit can only be attached to a unit if both units share the same keyword from the list above. A unit can only embark within (or start the battle embarked within) a TRANSPORT if both of those units share the same keyword from the list above.

stratagems.name: Eye of the Gods
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED, DAEMON and EPIC HERO units) destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER model in that unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Move, Toughness and Wounds characteristics of that CHARACTER model, and add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of that model's melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Eternal Hate
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6 (add 1 if it is a KHORNE unit): on a 4+, do not remove it; it can fight after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Profane Zeal
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Wound rolls. Chaos Undivided unit, not selected to shoot/fight this phase.

stratagems.name: Skinshift
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds. In addition, if your unit is a TZEENTCH unit below its Starting Strength, one destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit with its full wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Torpefying Refrain
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a SLAANESH unit, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Festering Miasma
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability. If your unit is a NURGLE unit, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Veterans of the Long War.rule: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army to be your focus of hatred. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Endless Ire
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.

stratagems.name: Black Crusade
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using this ability.

stratagems.name: Contemptuous Disregard
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

defBuff.note: Worsen incoming AP by 1 (Armour of Contempt).

stratagems.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.

mathBuff.note: Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER]; Torrent weapons change their Attacks characteristic to 6.

stratagems.name: Bringers of Despair
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: Millennia of Experience
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Deceptors.rule:
In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select a number of LEGIONARIES and CULTIST MOB units from your army; until the end of the battle, those units, and any CHARACTER units attached to them (excluding EPIC HEROES), have the Infiltrators ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on battle size:
Incursion — up to 2 Legionaries and up to 2 Cultist Mobs
Strike Force — up to 3 Legionaries and up to 3 Cultist Mobs
Onslaught — up to 4 Legionaries and up to 4 Cultist Mobs

stratagems.name: Detonator
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy model with the Deadly Demise ability (excluding TITANIC models) is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 18" of that enemy model when it was destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your opponent does not roll to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by their model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted (if that ability inflicts a random number of mortal wounds, your opponent rolls to determine that number as normal).

stratagems.name: Coils of Deception
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: From All Sides
stratagems.when: Start of your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit for each other HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this phase (to a maximum of +3).

stratagems.name: Relentless Pursuit
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Pick Them Off
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Scrambled Coordinates
stratagems.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your unit.

Renegade Raiders.rule: Ranged weapons equipped by HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Unfailingly Obdurate
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Warpcharged Engines
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Scour and Seize
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Ruinous Raid
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hit AND Wound — only when targeting a unit within range of an objective marker.

stratagems.name: Opportunistic Raiders
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

stratagems.name: Reavers' Haste
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.

Dread Talons.rule: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each time an enemy unit within 12" of one or more HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army takes a Battle-shock test, subtract 1 from the result. Enemy units affected by this Detachment rule do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Depthless Cruelty
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP — only vs Battle-shocked OR Below Half-strength targets.

stratagems.name: Bloody Example
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Hunters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hit AND Wound — only vs Battle-shocked OR Below Half-strength targets.

stratagems.name: Relentless Terror
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Screaming Descent
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge. Then select one enemy INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit within 9" of and visible to your unit: that unit makes a Battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: Merciless Pursuit
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that Fell Back this turn and is within 6" of your unit. Your unit can declare a charge as if it were your Charge phase, but can only select that enemy unit as the target (and only if it is an eligible target). Even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Fellhammer Siege-host.rule: Each time a ranged attack targets a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Persistent Assailants
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more attacks this phase and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit is Below Half-strength you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hits. Also re-roll Wounds if your unit is Below Half-strength.

stratagems.name: Brutal Attrition
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is allocated to your unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to a maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Cannonade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

mathBuff.note: Critical Hit on 5+ — only vs Below Half-strength targets.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Destruction
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit's ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.

stratagems.name: Steadfast Determination
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

defBuff.note: Feel No Pain 5+ (your opponent's Shooting phase).

stratagems.name: Siegecraft
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

Chaos Cult.rule: Each time a DAMNED unit from your army with the Dark Pacts ability is selected to make a Normal or Advance move or declare a charge (excluding units that arrived from Reserves this turn), it can make a Desperate Pact: until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Move characteristic of its models and add 2 to Charge rolls made for it. Desperate Pacts: each time a unit makes a Desperate Pact it must first take a Leadership test; if failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds before the Desperate Pact's effects are resolved. In addition, TRAITOR GUARDSMEN SQUAD units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.name: Chosen for Glory
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if the unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Selfless Demise
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.

stratagems.name: Infernal Sacrifice
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (in addition to any from failing the Leadership test), and until the end of the phase add 1 to the Attacks of its melee weapons; if it did not fail the Leadership test, improve the Strength of those weapons by 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Crazed Focus
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration by 1, and if it did not fail the Leadership test, improve the Strength by 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Reckless Haste
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Mortal Thralls
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army selected as a target, and one friendly DAMNED unit within 3" of it and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while your DAMNED unit is on the battlefield, each time your opponent would make a Wound roll for an attack targeting your HERETIC ASTARTES unit, if the DAMNED unit is visible to the attacker and an eligible target, no roll is made; instead the DAMNED unit suffers mortal wounds equal to the attack's Damage.

Soulforged Warpack.rule: Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army makes a Dark Pact, it can invoke its contract. If it does, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test, and until the end of the phase: each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll; and add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Desperate Pledge
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Glut of Souls
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wounds).

stratagems.name: Daemonic Possession
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding DAEMON units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Rampage
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: Predatory Pursuit
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Feeding Frenzy
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of your units Falls Back, all models in that unit must take a Desperate Escape test; if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

Cabal of Chaos.rule:
- In your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit (excluding DAEMON units) is selected to shoot, if that unit makes a Dark Pact, that unit's ranged attacks have +1 S.
- In the Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE/DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS unit (excluding KHORNE units) is selected to fight, if that unit makes a Dark Pact, that unit's melee attacks have:
- +2 S.
- +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Infernal Vigour
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).
stratagems.effect: Your unit heals D3+1 wounds.

stratagems.name: Fleshy Curse
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6: on a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.

stratagems.name: Wreathed in Warpflame
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Devotees of Destruction.rule: Friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS units' ranged attacks have [HEAVY].

stratagems.name: Ruination's Bounty
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.effect: When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Snare of Fire
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Undying Hatred
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

Murdertalon Raiders.rule:
Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY units' attacks that target a battle-shocked unit or a unit at or below half-strength can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
When an enemy unit's attacks target a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit, if that enemy unit is battle-shocked or at or below half-strength, those attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.
This detachment has the NIGHTMARE tag and cannot be taken with another NIGHTMARE detachment.

stratagems.name: Plunging Talons
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: Raking Pass
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Warp-twisted Terrors
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.
stratagems.target: That WARP TALONS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

Warpstrike Champions.rule: At the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS and MUTILATORS units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size: Incursion - up to 1 unit; Strike Force - up to 2 units; Onslaught - up to 3 units. Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Empyric Dislocation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Armour of Corruption
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Warp Flicker
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Warp-Tainted
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Siegebreaker Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: Portal of Spite
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

Cult of the Arkifane.rule:
HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE units from your army gain the DAEMON keyword.
HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE, LORD DISCORDANT and VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE units from your army gain the SOUL FORGE keyword.
SOUL FORGE units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Touch of the Arkifane
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit's weapons to gain.

stratagems.name: Biomechanoid Regeneration
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

stratagems.name: Balefire Boon
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Forge-Fire Surge
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

stratagems.name: Soul-Tally Offering
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Unholy Fortitude
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

Creations of Bile.rule:
Bile's creations, the Terata, possess a variety of mutations. At the start of the battle, select which augmentations are active for HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models (excluding DAMNED models) from your army until the end of the battle. Either select one from the list below, or randomly determine two by rolling two D6. If Fabius Bile is your Warlord, when randomly determining your augmentations, you can re-roll one or both of the dice. Duplicated augmentations have no additional effect.
1. Cholinergic Accelerants: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
2. Hyperadrenal Infusion: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this model.
3. Paraneural Reactions: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.
4. Supracutaneous Chitination: Improve the Toughness characteristic of this model by 1.
5. Macrotensile Sinews: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
6. Ophthalmic Enhancement: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by this model by 1.

stratagems.name: Monstrous Visages
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Delayed Mutations
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.

stratagems.name: Masters Are Watching
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a DAMNED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Specimens for the Spider
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the enemy Warlord was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test instead.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Regeneration
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: One destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a BATTLELINE unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) are returned to your unit instead.

stratagems.name: Autostimulants
stratagems.when: Start of your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Nightmare Hunt.rule:
In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. Enemy units affected by this Detachment rule do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll.
Each time an attack targets a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army, if the attacking model is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a Battle-shocked unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Talons Sunk Deep
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Malicious Surge
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Prey on the Weak
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Relentless Terror
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Sadistic Display
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of and visible to your unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Horrific Incursion
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived from Reserves this turn.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12" of and visible to your unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Huron's Marauders.rule:
In your Command phase, select one of the following abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, each HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army has that ability. At the start of each phase, if such a unit is visible to a friendly HURON BLACKHEART model, until the end of the phase, it has both of the following abilities.
Huron's Elite: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.
Mobile Marauders: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Hardened Killers
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one of the following effects: improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1; improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1; or improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1. Until the start of your next turn, your unit has the benefit of that effect.

stratagems.name: Reavers' Flurry
stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: At the Tyrant's Command
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: To the Favoured the Spoils
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Seize the Prize
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army has been selected to Advance.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Encircling Surge
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Renegade Warband.rule:
HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army lose the Dark Pacts ability.
Ranged weapons equipped by HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.
When mustering your army, you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule.
Vendetta: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Vendetta target. Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Twisted Doctrine: In your Movement phase, each time you set up or select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding Battle-shocked units) from your army to move, it can choose to Default to Doctrine. If it does, it must first take a Battle-shock test. Then, select one of the following: until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back; or until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Never Outgunned
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

stratagems.name: Renegade Claim
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Vengeful Destruction
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Corrupted Munitions
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Undying Hatred
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Reavers' Reaction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

_armyRule.name: Dark Pacts
_armyRule.rule:
Beseeching the Chaos Gods with fanatical fervour, the champions of the Heretic Astartes pray for diabolic boons, offering the vilest of prices in return for their power.

If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one of the following abilities for that unit's weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
• [LETHAL HITS]
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

parts.name: Cult of the Dark Gods
parts.desc:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, you can include any of the following units in your army, and when you do their Faction keywords are replaced with HERETIC ASTARTES:
• KHORNE BERZERKERS (see World Eaters)
• RUBRIC MARINES (see Thousand Sons)
• PLAGUE MARINES (see Death Guard)
• NOISE MARINES (see Emperor's Children)
The combined points value of such units you can include depends on the battle size:
• Incursion: up to 250 pts
• Strike Force: up to 500 pts
• Onslaught: up to 750 pts

enhancements.name: Death Mask of Ollanius
enhancements.desc: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer’s unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, instead of changing it to 0

enhancements.name: Drill Commander
enhancements.desc: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, if that unit Remained Stationary this turn, a Critical Hit is scored on a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

enhancements.name: Reactive Command
enhancements.desc: **^^Officer^^** model only. Each time an enemy unit is set up within 8" of the bearer's unit, the bearer can issue one Order. This is not counted towards the number of Orders the bearer can issue each battle round.

enhancements.name: Grand Strategist
enhancements.desc: **^^Officer^^** model only. In your Command phase, the bearer can issue one additional Order.

enhancements.name: Eager Advance
enhancements.desc: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a **^^Regiment^^** unit, that unit has the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Flash Grenades
enhancements.desc: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Stalwart's Honours
enhancements.desc: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, when that unit is issued an Order, it is also affected by the Take Cover! Order.

enhancements.name: Legacy Sidearm
enhancements.desc: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristics of the bearer's Pistols.

enhancements.name: Bold Leadership
enhancements.desc: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. _armyRule.name: Voice of Command
_armyRule.rule:
If your Army Faction is ASTRA MILITARUM, your OFFICER models can issue Orders. Each Officer's datasheet says how many Orders it can issue in a battle round and which units can receive them. For each Order, choose one of those below, then pick one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that Officer to receive it.

Officers issue Orders in your Command phase, and at the end of any phase in which they disembarked from a TRANSPORT or were set up on the battlefield.

The unit keeps the Order until the start of your next Command phase. Unless a rule says otherwise, a unit can be under only one Order at a time (a new Order replaces the old one), and the same Order issued to a unit more than once still applies only once. Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and an Order stops affecting a unit the moment it becomes Battle-shocked. Only ASTRA MILITARUM models benefit from an Order issued to their unit.

- Move! Move! Move!: add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in the unit.
- Fix Bayonets!: improve the Weapon Skill of melee weapons carried by models in the unit by 1.
- Take Aim!: improve the Ballistic Skill of ranged weapons carried by models in the unit by 1.
- First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire!: improve the Attacks of Rapid Fire weapons carried by models in the unit by 1.
- Take Cover!: improve the Save of models in the unit by 1 (never to better than 3+).
- Duty and Honour!: improve the Leadership and Objective Control of models in the unit by 1.

(In-app, Orders are applied via each unit's Orders toggle, including in Mathhammer.)

detData._format: Same shape as detachments.json. Each detachment has optional 'ruleName' + 'rule' (string) and 'stratagems' (array of {name, type, cp, when, target, effect}). Fill from your rulebook; rebuild with build.ps1.

Combined Arms.rule:
Each time a model in a REGIMENT unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Each time a model in a SQUADRON unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Action
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One REGIMENT unit from your army and one SQUADRON unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.

stratagems.name: Reinforcements!
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining. Restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: Flexible Command
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to REGIMENT units and SQUADRON units.

stratagems.name: Fields of Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One REGIMENT unit and one SQUADRON unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP — targeting your selected enemy unit. REGIMENT + SQUADRON pair.

stratagems.name: Inspired Command
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.

stratagems.name: Stalwart Protector
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

defBuff.note: Benefit of Cover for INFANTRY screened by your VEHICLE.

Mechanised Assault.rule: Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM model from your army makes a ranged attack in a turn in which it disembarked from a TRANSPORT, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Vox-Relay
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY OFFICER unit from your army embarked within a TRANSPORT. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue Orders even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue Orders to ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT units from your army (excluding TITANIC units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit's TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Rapid Dispersal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Clear and Secure
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hit + Wound — disembarked this turn AND target on an objective marker.

stratagems.name: Swift Interception
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One TRANSPORT unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Hasty Extraction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Move Out
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's turn.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

Hammer of the Emperor.rule: Each time a SQUADRON unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and when making that Advance move, that unit can move within Engagement Range of enemy models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of enemy models.

stratagems.name: Final Hour
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One SQUADRON unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding OFFICER units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Blazing Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SQUADRON unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Tactical Withdrawal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SQUADRON unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Crash Through
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: Furious Cannonade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SQUADRON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP — only vs targets within 12". SQUADRON unit.

stratagems.name: Ablative Plating
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

defBuff.note: -1 to the Damage of each attack (Shooting phase).

Siege Regiment.rule:
Artillery barrages lay the ground for the assault to come. At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support:
**Creeping Barrage:** Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size (Incursion: 2, Strike Force: 3, Onslaught: 4).
**Incendiary Bombardment:** Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size (Incursion: 2, Strike Force: 3, Onslaught: 4).
**Smoke Shells:** Select a number of units from your army (Incursion: 2, Strike Force: 3, Onslaught: 4). Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Trench Fighters
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a REGIMENT model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Over the Top
stratagems.when: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY OFFICER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! Order, it can issue that Order to any number of eligible friendly INFANTRY REGIMENT units, regardless of range to your model.

stratagems.name: Flare Burst
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hit — only vs visible enemy within 12". CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.name: Callous Sacrifice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model's unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

stratagems.name: Furious Fusillade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.

mathBuff.note: +1 Attacks for ranged — only at half range. PLATOON unit.

stratagems.name: Minefield
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One PLATOON unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Armoured Infantry.rule:
Add SQUADRON to the list of units each OFFICER unit from your army can issue Orders to. Add the Order below to those listed in the Voice of Command ability.

On My Signal (Order): This Order can only be issued to ARMOURED SKIRMISHER units (see below). Each time an enemy unit ends a Normal or Advance move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". Each unit can only move in this way once per turn.

Keywords: ASTRA MILITARUM SQUADRON units from your army have the ARMOURED SKIRMISHER keyword (excluding ARTILLERY units and units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 13 or higher).

stratagems.name: Order the Advance
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.

stratagems.name: Mobile Firebase
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Burst of Speed
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Supporting Ordnance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hit — only vs MONSTER/VEHICLE targets. ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.

stratagems.name: Combined Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.

mathBuff.note: +2 Strength — only vs the selected enemy unit, only for ARMOURED SKIRMISHER attacks.

stratagems.name: Opening Salvo
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 to Wound — disembarked this turn.

Grizzled Company.rule:
Add 1 to the number of Orders each ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER model from your army can issue, as stated on their datasheet.

While an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is affected by an Order, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Snap to It
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.

stratagems.name: No Retreat!
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Veteran Sharpshooters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

mathBuff.note: Ignores Cover for ranged.

stratagems.name: Purging Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

mathBuff.note: Lethal Hits — only when your unit is within range of an objective marker, and is affected by an Order.

stratagems.name: Mordian Minute
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 Strength — INFANTRY unit, affected by First Rank Fire! Second Rank Fire! Order.

stratagems.name: Additional Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
