stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Steel Hammer.rule:
Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC or ASTRA MILITARUM SQUADRON unit from your army is selected to shoot, models in that unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of that unit (including with Blast weapons), provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. When doing so, such models do not suffer the penalty to their Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units (excluding attacks made with Indirect Fire weapons).

Keywords: In the Muster Armies step, you can select one or more ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC units from your army to gain the CHARACTER keyword. This means the selected units can be given Enhancements, and one of them can be selected as your WARLORD.

stratagems.name: Engine of Wrath
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2, and each time a model in your unit fights, it can only target that enemy unit.

mathBuff.note: +6 Attacks, +2 AP on melee — TITANIC only, target one enemy in Engagement Range.

stratagems.name: Imposing Arrival
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit on the battlefield, wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Adamantine Behemoth
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Shattering Salvo
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.name: Withering Firepower
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Accuracy Under Pressure
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hit rolls.

Recon Element.rule: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have Stealth.

stratagems.name: Crack Shots
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Draw Them Out
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Scramble Field
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Reinforcements step.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.

stratagems.name: Courageous Diversion
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Tanglefoot Grenades
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Scouting Outriders
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's turn.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED or ASTRA MILITARUM WALKER unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Abhuman Auxiliaries.rule:
Friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD/RATLINGS units have ABHUMAN.
Friendly COMMISSAR models can:
   Issue the Take Aim! Order.
   Issue 1 Order to a friendly ABHUMAN unit.
This detachment has the ABHUMAN tag and cannot be taken with another ABHUMAN detachment.

stratagems.name: Thick-Skulled Obdurance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.target: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Low Profile
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RATLINGS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That RATLINGS unit.
stratagems.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.name: Stirred To Action
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Bridgehead Strike.rule:
If a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER model is your WARLORD, friendly TEMPESTUS SCIONS units have:
   BATTLELINE.
   +1 OC.
When a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit is selected to shoot, if that unit was set up this turn, that unit's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: On My Position
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly engaged REGIMENT unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit: On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Firing Hot
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Hot-shot Lascarbines, Hot-shot Lasguns, Hot-shot Laspistols, Hot-shot Marksman Rifles, Hot-shot Volley Guns and Sentry Hot-shot Volley Guns weapons that targeted an enemy unit within 12" have +1 S and AP.

stratagems.name: Servo-Designators
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units' ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

Designation Force.rule:
Friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE units have the following ability:
   Signal Flares: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is designated: While a unit is designated, that unit has +3" detection range.
This detachment has the RECON tag and cannot be taken with another RECON detachment.

stratagems.name: Close-Range Detection
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: Triggered Alerts
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Sump-Smog Screen
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.
stratagems.effect: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Aspect of Murder
enhancements.desc: **^^Autarch^^** or **^^Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and those weapons have the **[PRECISION]** ability.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Wisdom
enhancements.desc: ^^**Autarch^^** or ^^**Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. While the bearer is leading an ^^**Aspect Warriors^^** unit, each time that unit is selected to shoot or fight, until the end of the phase, models in that unit gain both of the abilities from the Path of the Warrior Detachment rule.

enhancements.name: Shimmerstone
enhancements.desc: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Strategic Savant
enhancements.desc: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Gaze of Ynnead
enhancements.desc: Farseer model only. The bearer's Eldritch Storm weapon has the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

enhancements.name: Storm of Whispers
enhancements.desc: Warlock model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Borrowed Vigour
enhancements.desc: **^^Archon^^** model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Morbid Might
enhancements.desc: Succubus model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Cegorach's Coil
enhancements.desc: Troupe Master model only. Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, then roll one D6 for each model in the bearer's unit that is within Engagment Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

enhancements.name: Mask of Secrets
enhancements.desc: Harlequins model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

enhancements.name: Murder's Jest
enhancements.desc: Death Jester model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a unit that is below Half-strength, each successful Hit scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Mistweave
enhancements.desc: Shadowseer model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Craftworld's Champion
enhancements.desc: Asuryani model only. The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

enhancements.name: Ethereal Pathway
enhancements.desc: Asuryani model only. In the Deploy Armies step, select up to two Guardians units from your army. Models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Protector of the Paths
enhancements.desc: Asuryani model only. While the bearer is leading a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit, once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP, and while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control.

enhancements.name: Breath of Vaul
enhancements.desc: ASURYANI model only. While the bearer is leading a STORM GUARDIANS unit, each time you roll to determine the number of attacks made with a flamer equipped by a model in that unit, you can re-roll the result, and each time you make a Damage roll for a model equipped with a fusion gun in that unit, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.name: Crucible of Malediction
enhancements.desc: **^^Haemonculus^^** model only. Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend 1 Pain token. Then, each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if you spent 1 Pain token. Each time a **^^Psyker^^** unit fails that test, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Eye of Spite
enhancements.desc: **^^Succubus^^** model only. Improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

enhancements.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
enhancements.desc:
**^^Archon^^** model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can do one of the following:
Spend 1 Pain token and gain 1CP.
Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Dark Vitality
enhancements.desc: **^^Drukhari^^** model only. The bearer's unit is always Empowered - you do not need to spend any Pain tokens to activate that unit's Pain abilities

enhancements.name: Archraider
enhancements.desc: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^, that ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^ has the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Webway walker
enhancements.desc: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if that unit is currently losing the wager, until the end of the turn, you can re‑roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Reaper's Cowl
enhancements.desc: ^^**Harlequins**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth and Infiltrators abilities.

enhancements.name: Conductor of Torment
enhancements.desc:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In your Command phase, you can do one of the following:
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently losing the wager, you can gain 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Drukhari**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently winning the wager, you can discard 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Harlequins**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.

enhancements.name: Lucid Eye
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. In your Command phase, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the value of one Fate dice in your Fate dice pool.

enhancements.name: Runes of Warding
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds, Psychic Attacks and Critical Wounds caused by attacks with the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

enhancements.name: Stone of Eldritch Fury
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. Add 12" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Torc of Morai-Heg
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of the bearer with a Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, increase the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Phantasmal Smoke
enhancements.desc:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within 6" of a friendly ^^**Drukhari Transport**^^:
Models in the bearer’s unit have the  Stealth ability
Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Sadistic Fulcrum
enhancements.desc: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time you spend 1 Pain token to Empower the bearer’s unit in the Shooting phase, select one friendly ^^**Drukhari Transport**^^ within 6" of the bearer’s unit; until the end of the phase, each time that ^^**Transport**^^ makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Spiteful Raider
enhancements.desc: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, if that enemy unit was within range of one or more objective markers when the bearer’s unit was selected to fight, you gain 1 additional Pain token.

enhancements.name: Nightmare Shroud
enhancements.desc: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time the bearer’s unit disembarks from a ^^**Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Light of Clarity
enhancements.desc: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of Infanty models in that unit and add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic of Monster models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Stave of Kurnous
enhancements.desc: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer (excluding Titanic units). Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [Precision] ability.

enhancements.name: Rune of Mists
enhancements.desc: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, unless the attacking model is within 18, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Higher Duty
enhancements.desc: SPIRITSEER model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Psychic Destroyer
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ ^^Psyker^^ model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Phoenix Gem
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, remove it from play, then, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one of more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Gift of Foresight
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Timeless Strategist
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. At the start of the battle round, if the bearer is on the battlefield (or any Transport it is embarked within is on the battlefield), you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.

enhancements.name: Firstdrawn Blade
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Mirage Field
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Seersight Strike
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted Psyker model only. Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer have the [Anti-Monster 2+] and [Anti-Vehicle 2+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Echoes of Ulthanesh
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted model only. In your Command phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is not within your deployment zone, and adding an additional 1 to the result if the bearer is within your opponent's deployment zone: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Master Regenesist
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Each time the bearer uses its Fleshcraft ability, you can return up to D3+3 destroyed Bodyguard models to the bearer's unit instead of D3+1.

enhancements.name: Master Nemesine
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. The bearer's weapons have the ^^**[Anti-Beast 2+]**^^ and ^^**[Anti-Monster 4+]**^^ abilities.

enhancements.name: Master Artisan
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic and add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Master Repugnomancer [Aura]
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer's Fear Incarnate ability, and each time a friendly ^^**Drukhari**^^ within 9" of the bearer fails a Battle-shock test or is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 4+, you gain 1 Pain token.

enhancements.name: Leechbite Plate
enhancements.desc: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+. At the start of either player's Command phase, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, the bearer regains all of its lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Webway Awl
enhancements.desc: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability, and you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Informant Network
enhancements.desc: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select up to three ^^**Kabalite Warriors**^^ and/or ^^**Hand of the Archon**^^ units from your army; those units gain the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Towering Arrogance
enhancements.desc: ^^**Archon**^^ models only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pharmacophex
enhancements.desc: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. At the start of your Command phase, after selecting which Combat Drugs will be active for your army, roll one D6 and consult the Combat Drugs list. The result rolled applies to the bearer's unit until the start of your next Command phase in addition to any other Combat Drugs that are active for your army. If you randomly select one that is already active for your army, it has no additional effect.

enhancements.name: Chronoshard
enhancements.desc: ^^** Succubus**^^ model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Periapt of Torments
enhancements.desc: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Morghenna's Curse
enhancements.desc: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1.

enhancements.name: Spirit Stone of Raelyth
enhancements.desc: AELDARI PSYKER model only. While within 3" of a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit, the bearer has Lone Operative. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, select one friendly AELDARI VEHICLE model within 3"; that model heals D3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Guiding Presence
enhancements.desc: AELDARI PSYKER model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit within 6". That unit's ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: A Foot in the Future
enhancements.desc: TROUPE MASTER model only. This unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Mistweave
enhancements.desc: SHADOWSEER model only. This unit has Infiltrators.

enhancements.name: Camouflaged Snipers
enhancements.desc: RANGERS unit only. This unit's ranged attacks do not prevent it from being hidden.

enhancements.name: Assassins' Eye
enhancements.desc: RANGERS / SHROUD RUNNERS unit only. This unit's ranged attacks that target a CHARACTER unit have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Shadowfall Masks
enhancements.desc: TROUPE unit only. This unit has Fights First.

enhancements.name: Prelude Performer
enhancements.desc: HARLEQUINS model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Key of Ghosts
enhancements.desc: HARLEQUINS model only (excluding SOLITAIRE). Models in the bearer's unit have Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Weavers' Wail
enhancements.desc: TROUPE MASTER model only. Add 3 to the Strength and 1 to the Attacks of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Fanged Leer
enhancements.desc: DEATH JESTER model only. When using the bearer's Cruel Amusement ability, select two abilities for its shrieker cannon instead of one.

enhancements.name: Shedskin Raiment
enhancements.desc: SHADOWSEER model only. After both players deploy, select up to three HARLEQUINS units and redeploy them; any can be placed into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

enhancements.name: Pirate Prince
enhancements.desc: PRINCE YRIEL unit only. Each time you spend a Battle Focus token to enable an Agile Manoeuvre, roll one D6: on a 3+, gain 1 Battle Focus token.

enhancements.name: Alacritous Assault
enhancements.desc: ANHRATHE unit only. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have [LANCE].

enhancements.name: Exotic Munitions
enhancements.desc: ANHRATHE unit only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+].

enhancements.name: Adrenal Infusions
enhancements.desc: ANHRATHE INFANTRY unit only. This unit can perform the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre without spending a Battle Focus token, even if others have done so this phase.

enhancements.name: Infamy (Aura)
enhancements.desc: ANHRATHE unit only. While an enemy unit is within 3" of the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from its models' Objective Control (to a minimum of 1).

enhancements.name: Webway Pathstone
enhancements.desc: ANHRATHE unit only. Models in the bearer's unit have Deep Strike. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if not within Engagement Range, remove and place into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Archraider
enhancements.desc: ANHRATHE CHARACTER unit only. Select one CHARACTER model in the unit; it has Lord of Deceit (Aura): once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit within 12" with a Stratagem, increase that Stratagem's CP cost by 1.

enhancements.name: Voidstone
enhancements.desc: ANHRATHE INFANTRY unit only. Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: War Construct
abilities.desc: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

abilities.name: Psychic Guidance
abilities.desc: While this unit is within 12" of one or more friendly Aeldari Psyker models, models in this unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+ and each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Swift Demise
abilities.desc: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is the closest eligible target, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.desc: This unit has a 6+ Invulnerable save

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save (Asurmen)
abilities.desc: Asurmen has a 4+ Invulnerable save

abilities.name: Hand of Asuryan
abilities.desc: Once per battle, when this model is selected to shoot, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, its Bloody Twins weapon has a Damage characteristic of 3 and the [ANTI-INFANTRY 5+] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] abilities.

abilities.name: Tactical Acumen
abilities.desc: While this model is leading a unit, in your Shooting phase, after that unit has shot, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc:
This model can be attached to the following unit:

detData._format: Same shape as detachments.json. Each detachment has optional 'ruleName' + 'rule' (string) and 'stratagems' (array of {name, type, cp, when, target, effect}). Optional 'mathBuff' on each stratagem to surface as a Mathhammer toggle. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Warhost.rule:
At the start of the battle round, you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.

Each time a unit from your army performs the Swift as the Wind Agile Manoeuvre, until the end of the phase, add an additional 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

Each time a unit from your army performs an Agile Manoeuvre that involves rolling a D6, add 1 to the result.

stratagems.name: Lightning-Fast Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Sanctuary
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

stratagems.name: Feigned Retreat
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ASURYANI unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Blitzing Firepower
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 12". If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

mathBuff.note: Sustained Hits 1 ranged within 12". If weapon already has Sustained, crit on 5+ as well (toggle Critical Hit 5+ scenario manually for that case).

stratagems.name: Fire and Fade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT, ASURMEN and WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1". Restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Webway Tunnel
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Windrider Host.rule:
In the Declare Battle Formations step you can set up ASURYANI MOUNTED and VYPER units from your army in Reserves. During the battle, such units can be set up on the battlefield as if they were arriving from Strategic Reserves. For the purposes of setting up ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER units from your army on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

At the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER units from your army (excluding units within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units) and remove them from the battlefield, placing them into Strategic Reserves. Maximum per battle round: Incursion 1; Strike Force 2; Onslaught 3.

KEYWORDS: WINDRIDERS units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.name: Death From On High
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit from your army that was set upon the battlefield from Reserves this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Wounds. ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER, came from Reserves this turn.

stratagems.name: Overflight
stratagems.when: End of your Shooting phase or the end of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 7".

stratagems.name: Wind of Blades
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Daring Riders
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit from your army in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield from Reserves, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. If set up within 8" of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn it is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Focused Firepower
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP. ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER.

stratagems.name: Spiralling Evasion
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Spirit Conclave.rule:
Each time an ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army is destroyed by an enemy unit, that enemy unit gains a Vengeful Dead token. Each time a WRAITH CONSTRUCT model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit with one or more Vengeful Dead tokens, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

ASURYANI PSYKER models from your army gain the following Aura: Spirit Guides (Aura) — While a WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit from your army is within 12" of this model, that unit has the Battle Focus ability.

KEYWORDS: WRAITHBLADES and WRAITHGUARD units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.name: Seer's Eye
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI PSYKER model from your army and one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 12" of it that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your PSYKER model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Armour Penetration and/or Damage characteristics of that attack.

stratagems.name: Wraithbone Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Blades from Beyond
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

mathBuff.note: Devastating Wounds on melee. WRAITHBLADES/WRAITHLORD/WRAITHKNIGHT.

stratagems.name: Soul Bridge
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit from your army and one ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit is considered to be within 12" of your PSYKER model for the purposes of the Psychic Guidance and Spirit Guides abilities.

stratagems.name: Spirit Token
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One WRAITHBLADES or WRAITHGUARD unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Crushing Strides
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each WRAITHBLADES model in your unit, or 4D6 if WRAITHLORD, or 6D6 if WRAITHKNIGHT: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Guardian Battlehost.rule: Each time a DIRE AVENGER, GUARDIAN, SUPPORT WEAPON or WAR WALKER model from your army makes an attack, if that model's unit and/or the target unit are within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Warding Salvoes
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Wound — only vs target on objective. DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS.

stratagems.name: Shield Nodes
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Vaul's Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army.
stratagems.target: One WAR WALKERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). Once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Time to Strike
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One STORM GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Blades of Asuryan
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

stratagems.name: Cost of Victory
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GUARDIANS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. When doing so, return every destroyed GUARDIANS model to your unit.

Seer Council.rule:
Though future sight is not a precise art, the Aeldari seers excel in its craft. Having read the strands of fate that twine and branch through the upcoming battle, they direct events down their favoured paths at the most opportune moments.

At the start of the first battle round, generate Fate dice by rolling a number of D6 based on battle size (Incursion 3D6, Strike Force 6D6, Onslaught 9D6). Keep these to one side as your Fate dice pool.

Each time you use one of this detachment's Stratagems, if your Fate dice pool contains one or more Fate dice showing the value that corresponds to that Stratagem, you can discard one such Fate die; if you do, reduce the CP cost of that usage by 1CP. Corresponding values: Presentiment of Dread 1, Forewarned 2, Unshrouded Truth 3, Fate Inescapable 4, Isha’s Fury 5, Psychic Shield 6.

stratagems.name: Presentiment of Dread
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to your model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Forewarned
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Unshrouded Truth
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to move this phase, was not set up on the battlefield this phase, and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect:
- Place your unit in strategic reserves.
- Your unit has Deep Strike.
- Your unit must make an ingress move this phase.
- Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to be selected to move.

stratagems.name: Fate Inescapable
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: Ignores Cover. Crit wound also improves AP by 1 (not yet modelled as a separate effect).

stratagems.name: Isha's Fury
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Psychic Shield
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Aspect Host.rule:
Each time an ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, select one of the following abilities for it to gain until the end of the phase:
- Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
- Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Warrior Focus
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: To Their Final Breath
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Remove an Aspect Shrine token if available. Then, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6 (+1 if you removed a token). On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Sanctuary
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

stratagems.name: Doom Inescapable
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One AVATAR OF KHAINE model from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model's Wailing Doom ranged weapon has a Range characteristic of 18" and a Damage characteristic of 8.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Precision
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Remove an Aspect Shrine token if available. Then select 1 (or 2 if you removed a token) of: [IGNORES COVER], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected abilities.

mathBuff.note: This toggle models the LETHAL HITS pick. (Toggle Sustained or Ignores Cover separately when picking those; with an Aspect Shrine token, you get 2 of them.)

stratagems.name: Khaine's Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: All models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. If Battle-shocked, subtract 1.

Devoted of Ynnead.rule:
Lethal Intent: At the end of your opponent's Shooting phase, if one or more YNNARI units from your army were destroyed this phase, select one YNNARI INFANTRY or YNNARI MOUNTED unit from your army that was within 6" of your destroyed unit. That unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

Lethal Surge: Once per turn, when a YNNARI unit from your army performs the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre, it can make a Lethal Surge move instead of a Normal move. Roll one D6 and add 1: that unit can be moved a number of inches up to the total, and can move within Engagement Range of the enemy unit that just triggered that Agile Manoeuvre.

Lethal Reprisal: At the start of the Fight phase, select one YNNARI unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that is below its Starting Strength. Until the end of the phase, that unit has the Fights First ability.

Servants of the Whispering God: You can include YNNARI units in your army even though they do not have the ASURYANI Faction keyword. ASURYANI units (excluding EPIC HEROES) from your army gain the YNNARI keyword. You must include YVRAINE and/or THE YNCARNE in your army; one of those must be your WARLORD.

stratagems.name: Pall of Dread
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was just destroyed while within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. It remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Macabre Resilience
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI INFANTRY or YNNARI MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Emissaries of Ynnead
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a YNNARI INFANTRY unit from your army has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: That YNNARI INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hits of 1 melee. If below Starting Strength, full Hit re-roll (toggle Abaddon-style hit re-roll buff manually for that case).

stratagems.name: Parting the Veil
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Soulsight
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

mathBuff.note: Lethal Hits + Ignores Cover on ranged.

stratagems.name: Death Answers Death
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units), if one or more models in that unit were destroyed this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase.

Ghosts of the Webway.rule:
Each time a HARLEQUINS model from your army makes a Charge move, it can move through enemy models.

TRAVELLING PLAYERS: TROUPE units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword and TROUPE models in those units have an Objective Control characteristic of 2. You can include up to three of each of the following models in your army: DEATH JESTER, SHADOWSEER, TROUPE MASTER. When mustering your army, you can select a friendly HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD.

stratagems.name: Staged Death
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining. Once per battle per model.

stratagems.name: Heroes' Fall
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Mocking Flight
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HARLEQUINS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Tricksters' Retort
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One TROUPE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Bloody Dance
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units. Even if successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.name: Exit the Stage
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Armoured Warhost.rule: Friendly AELDARI VEHICLE units' ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: Layered Wards
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Soulsight
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.

stratagems.name: Vectored Engines
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit makes a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Fateful Performance.rule:
While a friendly HARLEQUINS unit is making a charge move, that unit can move through enemy models.
This detachment has the ACROBATIC tag and cannot be taken with another ACROBATIC detachment.

stratagems.name: Heroes' Fall
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove that model; it is removed after your unit has fought or at the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Exit the Stage
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Deceptive Feint
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

Path of the Outcast.rule: When a friendly RANGERS / SHROUD RUNNERS unit is selected to shoot, enemy units have +6" detection range until that friendly unit has shot.

stratagems.name: Eldritch Suppression
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS / SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit makes a Battle-shock test, with -1 if a model in it was destroyed by those attacks.

stratagems.name: Casting Back the Veil
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS / SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.name: Nomads of the Hidden Way
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS / SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". It is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a Transport until end of turn.

Twilight Flickers.rule:
Friendly HARLEQUINS units have Stealth.
This detachment has the ACROBATIC tag and cannot be taken with another ACROBATIC detachment.

stratagems.name: Presaged Rehearsal
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TROUPE unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That TROUPE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: Captivating Performance
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly TROUPE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Phantasmal Mirage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". It is not eligible to declare a charge until end of turn.

Serpent's Brood.rule:
Weapons equipped by HARLEQUINS MOUNTED and HARLEQUINS VEHICLE models from your army have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Each time a HARLEQUINS unit disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn its weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Travelling Players: TROUPE units gain the BATTLELINE keyword and TROUPE models have OC 2.
You can include up to three each of Death Jester, Shadowseer, Troupe Master.

stratagems.name: Fangs of the Brood
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TROUPE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit's Dance of Death ability, select three abilities instead of one.

stratagems.name: Venomous Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: After your unit has shot, if not within Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Not eligible to declare a charge until end of turn.

stratagems.name: Striking Stride
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Weavers' Coils
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If not within Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move; otherwise it can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Weaving Stride
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Skyward Lunge
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If not within Engagement Range, remove it from the battlefield and place into Strategic Reserves.

Eldritch Raiders.rule:
AELDARI units in your army are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced. Each time an ANHRATHE, RANGERS or SHROUD RUNNERS unit Advances, you can re-roll the Advance roll.
Veterans of the Void: Each ANHRATHE unit can be given up to one unique Corsair Enhancement (points per MFM).

stratagems.name: Raiders' Spoils
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ANHRATHE unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Ruthless Killers
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED unit that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each attack has +1 Damage.

stratagems.name: Yriel's Example
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT) selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: No Prey Too Big
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ANHRATHE, RANGERS or SHROUD RUNNERS unit that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model makes an attack, if its Strength is less than the target's highest Toughness, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Impeding Fire
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One RANGERS, SHROUD RUNNERS or STARFANG unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC) visible and within 36". Until the end of the phase, each time it declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (not cumulative with other negative modifiers).

stratagems.name: Withdraw and Reinforce
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ANHRATHE unit not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove and place into Strategic Reserves. If below Starting Strength, return all destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models).

Corsair Coterie.rule:
While an objective marker is under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
ANHRATHE units have: Void Thieves: At the end of a phase, if within range of an objective marker you control, it remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control is greater at the end of a phase.
Veterans of the Void: Each ANHRATHE unit can be given up to one unique Corsair Enhancement (points per MFM).

stratagems.name: Pirates' Due
stratagems.when: The Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, re-roll a Wound roll of 1; if ANHRATHE, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead against enemy units within range of an objective marker.

stratagems.name: Lethal Ruse
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an AELDARI unit Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, eligible to declare a charge after Falling Back. If ANHRATHE, select one enemy unit it was within Engagement Range of and roll six D6: for each 4+, 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Outcast Ambush
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One RANGERS or SHROUD RUNNERS unit that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER] and [RAPID FIRE 1] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Into the Breach
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ANHRATHE unit destroyed one or more enemy units.
stratagems.target: That ANHRATHE unit.
stratagems.effect: After resolving all shooting, it can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

stratagems.name: Cloak and Shadow
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit within range of an objective you control and selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models have Stealth and your unit can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18".

stratagems.name: Vengeful Sorrow
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit that lost models, not Battle-shocked, not within Engagement Range.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

_armyRule.name: Battle Focus
_armyRule.rule:
In war the Aeldari bring the full might of their intellect, skill and agility to bear, moving with a swiftness and grace the foe cannot match.

If your Army Faction is ASURYANI, at the start of the battle round you receive Battle Focus tokens based on battle size: Incursion 2, Strike Force 4, Onslaught 6.

Each time one of the triggers below occurs, you can spend one Battle Focus token to let the relevant eligible unit perform that Agile Manoeuvre. A unit is eligible if it has this ability and has not already performed an Agile Manoeuvre this phase. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot trigger the same Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase. At the end of the battle round, all unspent Battle Focus tokens are lost.

parts.name: Swift as the Wind
parts.desc:
Trigger: when an eligible unit is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move (can be triggered more than once per phase, by a different unit each time).
Effect: until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

parts.name: Flitting Shadows
parts.desc:
Trigger: when an eligible unit is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
Effect: until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at that unit.

parts.name: Star Engines
parts.desc:
Trigger: when an eligible VEHICLE unit is selected to make an Advance move.
Effect: until the end of the turn, Ranged weapons equipped by this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

parts.name: Sudden Strike
parts.desc:
Trigger: when an eligible unit is selected to fight.
Effect: until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

parts.name: Opportunity Seized
parts.desc:
Trigger: when an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Effect: one eligible unit (excluding TITANIC units) that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

parts.name: Fade Back
parts.desc:
Trigger: in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Effect: one eligible unit (excluding TITANIC units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

parts.name: Disparate Paths
parts.desc: When mustering your army you can include HARLEQUINS units even though they do not have the ASURYANI Faction keyword. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot select HARLEQUINS or YNNARI as your Army Faction.

enhancements.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
enhancements.desc: Each time the bearer manifests a Ritual, while resolving the Ritual, add 6" to its range.

enhancements.name: Umbralefic Crystal
enhancements.desc:
THOUSAND SONS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do:
- Place this unit in strategic reserves.
- This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase.
- This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

enhancements.name: Eldritch Vortex of E'taph
enhancements.desc: Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Incandeum
enhancements.desc: EXALTED SORCERER model only. Once per battle, when selecting a Ritual for the bearer to attempt, you can select Doombolt, even if a model from your army has already attempted to manifest that Ritual this phase.

enhancements.name: Nethershriek Mind-eater
enhancements.desc: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Diabolic Servant
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly ^^**Scintillating Legion^^** units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, add 1 to the Psychic test result.

enhancements.name: Duplicitous Malediction
enhancements.desc: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ^^**Thousand Sons^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserve if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Tome of True Names
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 2+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Warpmeld Dagger
enhancements.desc: Tzaangor Shaman model only. Each time the bearer attempts a Ritual, just before determining the Psychic test result, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer suffers D3 mortal wounds; if it is not destroyed as a result, add 1 to that Psychic test result for each of those mortal wounds suffered.

enhancements.name: Diamond of Distortion
enhancements.desc: Tzaangor Shaman model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Bray Lord
enhancements.desc: SORCERER or INFERNAL MASTER model only. The bearer has the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Flowing Flesh
enhancements.desc: Tzaangor Shaman model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability and a Wounds characteristic of 5.

enhancements.name: Risen Rubricae
enhancements.desc: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select either two ^^**Rubricae Battleline^^** units from your army or one other ^^**Rubricae^^** unit from your army; models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Arcane Thralls (Aura)
enhancements.desc: While a friendly ^^**Rubricae^^** unit is within 9" of the bearer, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Rubricae
enhancements.desc: While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a ^^**Rubricae^^** model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Stave Abominus
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [Sustained Hits D3] and [Devastating Wounds] abilities.

enhancements.name: Warp Syphon
enhancements.desc: While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly ^^**Thousand Sons Vehicle^^** units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, after you roll that additional D6 but before checking for doubles or triples, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one of those ^^**Vehicle^^** units; that ^^**Vehicle^^** unit suffers 1 mortal wound and you can re-roll that additional D6.

enhancements.name: Perplexing Cloak
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly ^^**Thousand Sons Vehicle^^** units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability.

enhancements.name: Biomechanical Mutation
enhancements.desc: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly ^^**Thousand Sons Vehicle^^** model within 6" of this model. That model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Warp-cursed Runemaster
enhancements.desc: While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly ^^**Thousand Sons Vehicle^^** units, each time the bearer manifests a Ritual, while resolving that Ritual, add 6" to its range.

enhancements.name: Eruption of Vitality
enhancements.desc: INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model only. (Once per battle, per army) When this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: On a 2+, set up this model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. This model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. This model has 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Curse of Life
enhancements.desc: INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model only. When this model heals as a result of the Sorcerous Invigoration detachment rule, you can add 3 to the number of wounds healed.

enhancements.name: Walking Rampart
enhancements.desc:
SORCERER/EXALTED SORCERER model only. This model has the following abilities:
Soul Bound: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 3" of this model. That SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit heals D3+1 wounds.
Kine-shielded Guardians: While this model is within 3" of a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit, this model has Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Occulus Infernum
enhancements.desc: SORCERER/EXALTED SORCERER model only. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit's ranged attacks have +1 BS until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Unravelled Fates
enhancements.desc: TZAANGOR SHAMAN model only. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly battle-shocked MUTANT unit within 6" of this model. That unit is no longer battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Thicket of Bladed Bone
enhancements.desc: SPAWN unit only. This unit's melee attacks have +1 AP and [CLEAVE 1].

enhancements.name: Arcane Might
enhancements.desc: Thousand Sons model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in that unit instead.

enhancements.name: Empowered Manifestation
enhancements.desc: Thousand Sons model only. While the bearer's unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, you can add 6" to the range of Psychic abilities the bearer has that specify a range (including Rituals) and each time a model in the bearer's unit takes a Hazardous test for a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.name: Empyric Onslaught
enhancements.desc: Thousand Sons model only. While the bearer's unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Noctilith Mantle
enhancements.desc: Thousand Sons model only. While the bearer's unit is on the battlefield, it is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic. Models in that unit cannot be selected to use any Rituals.

abilities.desc: if your army includes this model, after both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to 3 ^^**Thousand Sons^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

abilities.desc: Each time this model attempts a Ritual, add 1 to the Psychic test result.

abilities.name: Transport
abilities.desc: This model has a transport capacity of 12 ^^**Thousand Sons Infantry^^** models. Each ^^**Terminator^^** model takes up the space of 2 models.

abilities.name: Ensorcelled Annihilation
abilities.desc: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a ^^**Monster^^** or ^^**Vehicle^^** unit that was hit by one or more Psychic attacks made by a ^^**Thousand Sons Psyker^^** unit from your army this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Damage roll.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-4 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-4 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Ensorcelled Destruction
abilities.desc: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit (excluding ^^**Monsters^^** and ^^**Vehicles^^**) that was hit by one or more Psychic attacks made by a ^^**Thousand Sons Psyker^^** unit from your army this turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-4 wounds remaining

abilities.desc: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly model that disembarked from this ^^**Transport^^** this turn makes a Psychic attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Transport
abilities.desc: This model has a transport capacity of 12 ^^**Thousand Sons Infantry^^** models (excluding ^^**Terminator^^** models).

abilities.name: Regenerating Monstrosities
abilities.desc: At the start of each player’s Command phase, one model in this unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
