abilities.name: Siege Shield
abilities.desc: When making ranged attacks with its demolisher cannon, this model can target enemy units within Engagement Range of it (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, when making ranged attacks, this model does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-4 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-4 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Scuttling Walker
abilities.desc: Each time this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding ^^**Titanic**^^ models) and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

abilities.name: Destroyer of Futures
abilities.desc:
(Once per phase, per unit) You can target this unit with the Counteroffensive stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-6 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield (Psychic)
abilities.desc: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.desc: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Rebind Rubricae (Psychic)
abilities.desc: In your Command phase, if this model is leading a unit, you can roll one D6: on a 1, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2-5, you can return 1 destroyed Bodyguard model to that unit; on a 6, you can return up to 2 destroyed Bodyguard models to that unit.

Until the start of your next turn, that unit is ensnared. While a unit is ensnared, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

abilities.name: Devoted to Destruction
abilities.desc: If this model is equipped with 2 melee weapons in addition to its close combat weapon, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those two weapons.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.desc: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Flame-wreathed
abilities.desc: Each time this model ends a Normal move, select one enemy unit it moved over during that move. Until the end of the turn, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

abilities.name: Glimpse of Eternity (Psychic)
abilities.desc: Once per turn, you can change the result of one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one saving throw made for this model to an unmodified 6.

abilities.name: Unearthly Power
abilities.desc: At the start of the battle round, select one of the abilities in the Crimson King section. Until the start of the next battle round, this model has that ability.

abilities.name: Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers (Psychic)
abilities.desc: This model can attempt up to 2 Rituals per turn instead of one, and each time this model attempts a Ritual, add 2 to the Psychic test result.

subAbilities.name: Impossible Form (Psychic)
subAbilities.desc: Each time an attack is made against this ^^**Psyker^^** (excluding Psychic Attacks), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

subAbilities.name: Treason of Tzeentch (Psychic)

detData._format: Same shape as detachments.json. Each detachment has optional 'ruleName' + 'rule' (string) and 'stratagems' (array of {name, type, cp, when, target, effect}). Optional 'mathBuff' on each stratagem to surface as a Mathhammer toggle. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Grand Coven.rule:
In your Command phase, you can select one of the abilities listed below to take effect until the start of your next Command phase. You can only select each of these abilities once per battle.

Imbued Manifestation: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army.

Psychic Maelstrom: Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Wrath of the Immaterium: Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Psychic Dominion
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

stratagems.name: Destined by Fate
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army.
stratagems.target: That PSYKER model.
stratagems.effect: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

stratagems.name: Egotistical Power
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.

stratagems.name: Desecration of Worlds
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Arcane Focus
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a THOUSAND SONS model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).
stratagems.target: That THOUSAND SONS model.
stratagems.effect: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).

stratagems.name: Devastating Sorcery
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 9" to the Range characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hit + Wound on Psychic weapons only. Filters by the [PSYCHIC] keyword — Magnus's Gaze/Blade/Firestorm benefit; non-Psychic weapons like a Defiler's lascannon don't.

Changehost of Deceit.rule:
SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army have the following ability:

Daemonic Illusions (Aura): While a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is within 6" of and visible to this unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

THOUSAND SONS units from your army have the following ability:

Mortal Sorcery (Aura): While a friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS PSYKER unit is within 6" of and visible to this unit, that SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit has the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You can include SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units in your army even though they do not have the THOUSAND SONS Faction keyword. Combined points: Incursion 500 / Strike Force 1000 / Onslaught 1500. No SCINTILLATING LEGIONS models can be your WARLORD.

stratagems.name: Sulphurous Veil
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Deceptive Glamour
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible SCINTILLATING LEGIONS targets.

stratagems.name: Ethereal Phantasm
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or 6" if wholly within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS units.

stratagems.name: Fractal Disjunction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: Chronosorcerous Bleed
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER/SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Glimmershift Portal
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army (excluding MONSTERS), or one SCINTILLATING LEGIONS MONSTER unit, if more than 6" from all enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Warpmeld Pact.rule:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot or fight and one or more TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY or TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED units from your army are selected as a target of one or more of those attacks, each of those TZEENTCH MUTANT units can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that TZEENTCH MUTANT unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Each time a TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY or TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, before selecting its targets, that unit can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that TZEENTCH MUTANT unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER model from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, add one TZEENTCH CHAOS SPAWN unit (one model) to your army, set up as close as possible to where your model was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of enemy units. Once per battle round.

stratagems.target: That TZEENTCH MUTANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of 3", and any models within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight.

stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army and one friendly TZAANGORS unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 12" of that PSYKER model.

stratagems.target: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.target: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this phase.

Each time a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:
- If that VEHICLE unit is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.
- Otherwise, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll OR one Damage roll.

Each time a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed while within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models, that model's Deadly Demise inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 5+ instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: Hex-marked Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Mutate Landscape
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker is mutated, and remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. While mutated, each time an enemy unit ends a move within range of it, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Cyberspirit Machinations
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That VEHICLE unit, and one friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit within 6" of that VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your VEHICLE unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Malevolent Animus
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your VEHICLE unit is malevolent. While malevolent, it can ignore any or all modifiers to: the profile characteristics of its models; the WS/BS of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding saving throws).

stratagems.name: Ensorcelled Infusion
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, that is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by VEHICLE models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and each time an attack is made with such a weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 to Wound on ranged. THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE within 6" of a Tsons Psyker unit.

stratagems.name: Warpflame Gargoyles
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit must then take a Battle-shock test.

Ritual of Regeneration.rule: (Once per turn, per unit) When a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit (excluding MONSTER units) successfully manifests a Ritual, that unit heals D3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Relentless Rebirth
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Mutagenic Magicks
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly engaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Multitudinous Limbs
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an Action.

Sekhetar Cohort.rule:
Friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS units' attacks have [PSYCHIC].
Friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units have the following ability:
Infusion (Aura): While a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit is within 12" of this unit, that unit's melee attacks have +1 WS.

stratagems.name: Arcane Venting
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Ectoplasmic Extrusion
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit starts an Action.
stratagems.target: That SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit.
stratagems.effect: That Action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Warp Fields
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
stratagems.target: That SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to Wound rolls.

Servants of Change.rule:
Friendly TZAANGORS units have BATTLELINE.
In your Shooting phase, while a friendly MUTANT unit is shooting, enemy units have +6" detection range.
This detachment has the MUTANT tag and cannot be taken with another MUTANT detachment.

stratagems.name: Prismatic Displacement
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn. That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Temporal Instability
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED MUTANT unit.
stratagems.effect: In a turn your unit made an Advance or Fall Back move, that move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an Action.

stratagems.name: The Land Writhes
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly MONSTER MUTANT unit is selected to move.
stratagems.target: That MONSTER MUTANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

Hexwarp Thrallband.rule:
Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army's Flow of Magic, as follows:
- Your deployment zone is always within your army's Flow of Magic.
- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man's Land, until the end of that phase, No Man's Land is within your army's Flow of Magic.
- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent's deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent's deployment zone is within your army's Flow of Magic.

Each time a Thousand Sons model from your army makes a Psychic Attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If such a model is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, each time it makes a Psychic Attack, add 1 to the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Warding Hex
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control, if that objective marker is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Doomed
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Strands of Time
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That Thousand Sons Psyker unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic when it is targeted with this Stratagem, then until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Through the Veil
stratagems.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Rubric Marines or Scarab Occult Terminators unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.effect: If it is a Rubric Marines unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is a Scarab Occult Terminators unit it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models. RESTRICTIONS: If a Scarab Occult Terminators unit is targeted with this Stratagem, it is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: Scouring Warpflame
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. After your unit has shot this phase, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.name: Kaleidoscopic Tempest
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect:
- Your unit has Stealth.
- If your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, your unit has -3 detection range.

_armyRule.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
_armyRule.rule:
The Thousand Sons are wreathed in the energies of the Warp, channelling its power through battlefield ritual to divine forbidden knowledge, weave illusion, or ravage their foes with empyric fire.

If your Army Faction is THOUSAND SONS, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals from those below. Select one such model that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn, and one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test for that model (roll 2D6; you may Channel the Warp).

If one or more doubles or triples were rolled during the test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If the model is not destroyed, the combined total of all dice rolled is the Psychic test result; if it equals or exceeds the Ritual's Warp Charge value, the model manifests that Ritual.

parts.name: Destiny's Ruin (Warp Charge 5)
parts.desc: Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the Psychic test result was 10+, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

mathBuff.note: Destiny's Ruin — re-roll Hit 1 (10+: full re-roll)

parts.name: Temporal Surge (Warp Charge 6)
parts.desc: Select one friendly THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit that is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit and is within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. That unit can make a Normal move of up to D6" (up to 6" if the result was 10+). Until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

parts.name: Doombolt (Warp Charge 7)
parts.desc: Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model (excluding Lone Operative units that are not part of an Attached unit and are not within 12" of the manifesting model); that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If the Psychic test result was 11+, it suffers D3+3 mortal wounds instead.

parts.name: Twist of Fate (Warp Charge 9)
parts.desc: Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If the Psychic test result was 12+, improve it by 2 instead.

mathBuff.note: Twist of Fate — +1 AP (12+: +2)

parts.name: Pact of Sorcery
parts.desc: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select SCINTILLATING LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

enhancements.desc: Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons (excluding Extra Attacks weapons) equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Battle-lust
enhancements.desc: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. In addition, while the Unbridled Bloodlust Blessing of Khorne is active for your army, add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Helm of Brazen Ire
enhancements.desc: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Favoured of Khorne
enhancements.desc: Each time you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll up to 2 of the D6 rolled.

enhancements.name: Brazen Form
enhancements.desc: Monster model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Butcher Lord
enhancements.desc: WORLD EATERS INFANTRY model only. The bearer has the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Chosen of the Blood God
enhancements.desc: Monster model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer's Aura abilities.

enhancements.name: Strategic Slaughter
enhancements.desc: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to 3 ^^**Jakhals^^** and/or ^^**Goremongers^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Disciple of Khorne
enhancements.desc: LORD ON JUGGERNAUT model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability, and it has the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of the WORLD EATERS Faction keyword.

enhancements.name: Blood-forged Armour
enhancements.desc: The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. If the bearer is destroyed, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point.

enhancements.name: Icon of War

If the Might of Khorne ability is active for your army, then while a friendly ^^**Blood Legions^^** unit is within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

enhancements.name: Blade of Endless Bloodshed
enhancements.desc: Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, do not roll to gain a Blood Tithe point, you automatically gain 1 Blood Tithe point instead.

enhancements.name: Frenzied Focus
enhancements.desc: Daemon model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

enhancements.name: Killing Clarity
enhancements.desc: Daemon model only. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Violent Demise
enhancements.desc: Daemon model only. The bearer's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 2+ instead of on a 6. In addition, the bearer has the Deadly Demise D3+1 ability, instead of the Deadly Demise D3 ability.

enhancements.name: Malicious Vigour
enhancements.desc: Slaughterbound model only. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Brazen Fury move, it is treated as having rolled a 6 for the distance the unit can be moved.

enhancements.name: Aggressive Deployment
enhancements.desc: In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a ^^**Dedicated Transport^^**, that ^^**Dedicated Transport^^** has the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Unleash Hell
enhancements.desc: At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one ^^**Vehicle^^** model within 6" of the bearer or, if the bearer is embarked within a ^^**Transport^^**, you can select that ^^**Transport^^** model. Until the end of the phase, after the selected model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Infernal Infusion
enhancements.desc: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's unit has the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Murderous Onslaught
enhancements.desc: If the bearer's unit disembarked from a ^^**Transport^^** this turn, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.desc: MAULERFIEND unit only. This unit's Maulerfiend Fists have [CLEAVE 2].

enhancements.desc: WORLD EATERS VEHICLE unit only. This unit has DAEMON.

enhancements.desc: TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit has +1 OC.

WORLD EATERS DAEMON PRINCE model only. This model has:
 MOBILE.

Cult of Blood.rule:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Idols of Khorne abilities listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active and its effects apply to all WORLD EATERS TITANIC and WORLD EATERS MONSTER units from your army. You can only select each Idols of Khorne ability once per battle.

Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura): While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Idol of Burning Wrath (Aura): While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if TITANIC), add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

Idol of Blessed Blood (Aura): While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if TITANIC), models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

KEYWORDS: JAKHALS and GOREMONGERS units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS MONSTER or WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit from your army that was just destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One JAKHALS unit from your army that was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength. Restrictions: cannot return Attached units. Once per battle.

stratagems.target: One JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER units, or within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC units, FNP 5+ instead.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight; they can target enemy units within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

Khorne Daemonkin.rule:
Each time a BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point (BTP). At the start of the Command phase, you can spend BTP to activate one of the following until end of battle:

Enraged Abjuration [2BTP]: BLOOD LEGIONS and WORLD EATERS models have Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

Daemonic Rage [3BTP]: Melee weapons equipped by BLOOD LEGIONS units have the [LANCE] ability.

Boon of Blood [4BTP]: BLOOD LEGIONS units have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Might of Khorne [5BTP]: BLOOD LEGIONS units gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You can include BLOOD LEGIONS units. Combined points: Incursion 500 / Strike Force 1000 / Onslaught 1500. No BLOOD LEGIONS model can be your WARLORD.

_armyRule.name: Blessings of Khorne
_armyRule.rule:
Khorne is the Chaos god of warfare and slaughter, and he blesses those who spill blood and take skulls in his name.

If your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, at the start of the battle round you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll: roll eight D6, then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (below). Each Blessing lists the dice result it requires (where a number is given, a double or triple of that value or higher is needed). Each Blessing can only be activated once per battle round, and any unused dice are discarded. Once activated, a Blessing applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.

detData._format: Same shape as detachments.json. Each detachment has optional 'ruleName' + 'rule' (string) and 'stratagems' (array of {name, type, cp, when, target, effect}). Optional 'mathBuff' on each stratagem to surface as a Mathhammer toggle. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Virulent Vectorium.rule: At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. Until you lose control of that objective, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective, that enemy unit is Afflicted (pg 71).

stratagems.name: Putrid Detonation
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.name: Disgustingly Resilient
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Plaguesurge
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.

stratagems.name: Leechspore Eruption
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD model from your army that has lost one or more wounds.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).

stratagems.name: Overwhelming Generosity
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll the number of Attacks (full) for ranged weapons vs the marked target unit.

stratagems.name: Creeping Blight
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit & Wound re-roll vs Afflicted targets. Toggle only when modelling Afflicted enemy.

Shamblerot Vectorium.rule:
In your Command phase in each of the following battle rounds, depending on your chosen battle size, add a new POXWALKERS unit with a Starting Strength of 10 to your army, in Strategic Reserves.

Incursion: rounds 2, 3
Strike Force: rounds 2, 3, 4
Onslaught: rounds 2, 3, 4, 5

KEYWORDS: POXWALKERS units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.name: Grip of the Walking Pox
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.

stratagems.name: Smeared With Filth
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

stratagems.name: Gnawing Hunger
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

mathBuff.note: +1 A and +1 S melee on POXWALKERS for one turn.

stratagems.name: Hidden Amongst the Dead
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

stratagems.name: Shock and Horror
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That DEATH GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Shambling Wall
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.

Death Lord's Chosen.rule: In your opponent's Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Undying Spite

On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Signal Pox

stratagems.target: One LORD OF VIRULENCE model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.

stratagems.name: Mortarion's Teachings
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

mathBuff.note: +1 to Hit (HEAVY when remaining stationary). TERMINATOR unit only. Also gains ASSAULT — can shoot after Advancing.

stratagems.name: Sickening Impact
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Mortarion's Hammer.rule:
At the start of the battle round, select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size:

Incursion: 1
Strike Force: 2
Onslaught: 3

stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Drawn to Despair

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent's deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit re-roll ranged. Only when target is in opponent's deployment zone — toggle when modelling that case.

stratagems.name: Font of Filth
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

stratagems.name: Eyestinger Storm

stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

stratagems.effect: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit's Starting Strength accordingly.

stratagems.name: Death's Heads

stratagems.target: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle's Gift).

Tallyband Summoners.rule:
While a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army is within 7" of one or more DEATH GUARD units from your army, that PLAGUE LEGIONS unit has the Nurgle's Gift ability.

While a DEATH GUARD unit from your army is within 7" of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, add 3" to that DEATH GUARD unit's Contagion Range.

PLAGUE LEGIONS ALLIES: You can include PLAGUE LEGIONS units in your army, even though they do not have the DEATH GUARD Faction keyword. Combined points cap — Incursion: 500 pts, Strike Force: 1000 pts, Onslaught: 1500 pts. No PLAGUE LEGIONS models can be your WARLORD.

stratagems.name: Persistent Pests
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Clutching Corruption

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit re-roll melee vs targets engaged by a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit — toggle when modelling that case.

stratagems.name: All Is Rot

_armyRule.name: Nurgle's Gift
_armyRule.rule:
The Death Guard are warriors of the Plague God Nurgle. Their bloated bodies are riddled with corruption, and their mere presence causes the foe to sicken and wither in the grip of supernatural diseases while the battlefield falls to rot and ruin around them.

If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more DEATH GUARD models from your army, it is Afflicted.

Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle: 3" in the first battle round, 6" in the second, and 9" from the third battle round onwards. Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers.

Afflicted: During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague.

parts.name: Skullsquirm Blight
parts.desc:
Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the benefit of cover against that attack.
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

parts.name: Rattlejoint Ague
parts.desc: Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

parts.name: Scabrous Soulrot
parts.desc: Worsen the Move, Leadership, and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model's Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).

parts.name: Pact of Decay
parts.desc: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select PLAGUE LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

enhancements.name: Eager to Prove
enhancements.desc: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Repulsed by Weakness
enhancements.desc: Each time an enemy unit (excluding **^^Monster**^^ and ^^**Vehicle**^^ units) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.name: Proud and Vainglorious
enhancements.desc: You can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Slayer of Champions
enhancements.desc: The bearer's melee weapons have the [^^Precision^^] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a ^^**Character**^^ unit, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Faultless Opportunist
enhancements.desc:
You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Blinding Speed
enhancements.desc: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does so, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Distortion
enhancements.desc: Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Rise to the Challenge
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer can fight one additional time. When doing so, you can select one ability using the Exquisite Swordsmanship Detachment rule to apply to those attacks.

enhancements.name: Sublime Presence
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly **^^Emperor's Children Transport**^^ that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that **^^Transport**^^ on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Spearhead Striker
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. Each time the bearer disembarks from a **^^Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit and enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Accomplished Tactician
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, you can select one friendly **^^Emperor's Children**^^ unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit by one or more of those attacks, then select one friendly **^^Transport**^^ that unit is wholly within 6" of and is able to embark within. That **^^Emperor's Children**^^ unit can embark in that **^^Transport**^^.

enhancements.name: Heretek Adept
enhancements.desc: Infantry model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly **^^Emperor's Children Vehicle**^^ model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
enhancements.desc: The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. if that test is passed, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).

enhancements.name: Pledge of Dark Glory
enhancements.desc: While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
enhancements.desc: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked: if failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
enhancements.desc: Once per turn, after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

enhancements.name: Steeped in Suffering
enhancements.desc: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is also Below Half-Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Tactical Perfection
enhancements.desc: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to two **^^Emperor's Children**^^ units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Loathsome Dexterity
enhancements.desc: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

enhancements.desc: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Dark Blessings

enhancements.name: Possessed Blade
enhancements.desc: At the start of the battle, select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer; add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon. In addition, each time the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, when resolving those attacks add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and that weapon has the [^^Devastating Wounds^^] and [^^Hazardous^^] abilities.
