- Or: Up to 6", if the tactical doctrine is active for your unit.

stratagems.name: Umbral Evasion
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.
stratagems.target: That PHOBOS unit.
stratagems.effect: Hit rolls for ranged attacks that target your unit get -1.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 if hidden at the end of your Movement phase.

Gravis Linebreaker Force.rule:
For the rest of any turn in which a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks:
- Lose [HEAVY].
- Get +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Annihilating Force
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That GRAVIS unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks made by your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

mathBuff.note: [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Purgation Push
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That GRAVIS unit.
stratagems.effect:
- If your unit is unengaged, it may make a normal move of up to 5", and that move must end within range of an objective.
- Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or to embark within a TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Armoured Impact
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.target: That GRAVIS unit.
stratagems.effect:
When your unit ends that charge move, you may choose one enemy unit engaged with it. If you do, roll one D6 for every model in your unit that is engaged with that enemy unit:
- Each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that enemy unit.

mathBuff.note: +1 to hit (ranged) in a turn the unit made a normal move; also loses [HEAVY].

Gravis Siege Force.rule: Whenever a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, wound rolls get -1 for attacks that target it with a S higher than its T.

stratagems.name: Annihilating Force
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That GRAVIS unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks made by your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

mathBuff.note: [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Stand Unyielding
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly GRAVIS unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose one objective your unit controls. That objective becomes secured.

stratagems.name: Suppression Volleys
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That GRAVIS unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose one enemy unit that was hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that roll.

Stormlance Task Force.rule: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units get +2" M.

stratagems.name: Wind-swift Evasion
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
- If your unit is unengaged, it may make a normal move.
- Or: If your unit is engaged, it may make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: Sudden Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to make an advance move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: You may change the advance roll for your unit to a 6.

stratagems.name: Hurtling Targets
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Hit rolls for ranged attacks that target your unit get -1.

Ironclad Champions.rule: Hit rolls of 1 made for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units may be re-rolled.

stratagems.name: Adamantine Terror
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Every enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that roll.

stratagems.name: Mercy Is Weakness
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit's attacks gain one of the following:
- [LETHAL HITS].
- Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

mathBuff.note: [LETHAL HITS] (or pick [SUSTAINED HITS 1] instead).

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains MOBILE.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Gauntlet Task Force.rule:
In your Shooting phase, once a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, you may choose one enemy unit that was hit by those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit is assailed:
- Attacks that target an assailed unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] if they are made by an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: For that move, each model in your unit may be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT (rather than wholly within it).

stratagems.name: Duty Is Never Done
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: Storm and Secure
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit with an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.
stratagems.effect: Choose one objective your unit controls. That objective becomes secured.

Ironstorm Spearhead.rule:
Ranged attacks made by friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units (excluding WALKER units) may:
- Re-roll one hit roll.
- Re-roll one wound roll.

stratagems.name: Layered Ceramite
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Against mortal wounds, your unit has Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: Might of the Machine Spirit
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units).
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit may ignore any modifiers to its:
- M.
- BS.
- Hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Headhunter Doctrine
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units) is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks made by your unit have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

mathBuff.note: [LETHAL HITS] vs MONSTER/VEHICLE targets only.

_armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines
_armyRule.rule:
You may choose one combat doctrine from the list below at the start of your Command phase. The chosen combat doctrine is then active, until the start of your next Command phase, for every friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that has this ability.

Assault Doctrine: If this unit is selected to make an advance move, it is still eligible to declare a charge afterwards; the advance move does not stop it.

Devastator Doctrine: Ranged attacks made by this unit have [ASSAULT].

Tactical Doctrine: If this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, it is still eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge afterwards; the fall-back move does not stop it.

Unless a rule says otherwise:
- Each combat doctrine can be chosen only once per battle.
- A unit can have only one combat doctrine active at a time. When a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, whichever combat doctrine was active for that unit before stops being active for it.

parts.name: Templar Vows
parts.desc:
Black Templars armies use this instead of Oath of Moment: if your army includes a BLACK TEMPLARS unit or uses a Black Templars Detachment, your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units lose Oath of Moment and gain Templar Vows.

If your Army Faction is ADEPTUS ASTARTES, at the start of the first battle round select one Vow below to be active for the ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. While a Vow is active for a unit, that unit has its ability.

- Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch: this unit's melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have [PRECISION]. When this unit declares a charge while an enemy PSYKER unit is within 12", it can re-roll the charge roll, but it must then end that charge move engaged with one or more of those PSYKER units.
- Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds: each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, if that attack's Strength is less than or equal to the target's Toughness, add 1 to the Wound roll.
- Suffer Not the Unclean to Live: this unit can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and its Pile-in and Consolidation moves do not need to end closer to the closest enemy model, as long as they end as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
- Uphold the Honour of the Emperor (INFANTRY units only): at the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that marker stays under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In missions with Actions, this unit can start an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

parts.name: Curse of the Wulfen
parts.desc: While this unit is not Battle-shocked and is within 6" of one or more friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER models (other than WULFEN models) or within 12" of one or more friendly WOLF PRIEST models, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of its INFANTRY models and 3 to that of its VEHICLE models.

parts.name: Mission Tactics
parts.desc:
Only while you are using the Black Spear Task Force Detachment, and only for datasheets that list this ability (GW FAQ).

At the start of your Command phase, you can select one Mission Tactic below. Until the start of your next Command phase it is active, and it applies to every unit from your army with this ability. Each Mission Tactic can be selected only once per battle.

- Furor Tactics: weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- Malleus Tactics: weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army have [LETHAL HITS].
- Purgatus Tactics: each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army makes an attack that scores a Critical Hit, that attack has [PRECISION].

parts.name: Space Marine Chapters
parts.desc: When an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit's datasheet carries a second Faction keyword, that keyword names the unit's Chapter (Marneus Calgar, with ADEPTUS ASTARTES and ULTRAMARINES, belongs to the Ultramarines Chapter). Your army cannot contain units from more than one Chapter.

parts.name: Deathwatch
parts.desc: Your army can include ADEPTUS ASTARTES DEATHWATCH units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter. With the exception of KILL TEAM CASSIUS, your army cannot include any AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEATHWATCH units. Your army cannot include any of the following units: ASSAULT SQUAD; ASSAULT SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS; ATTACK BIKE SQUAD; DEVASTATOR SQUAD; LAND SPEEDER STORM; RELIC TERMINATOR SQUAD; SCOUT BIKE SQUAD; SCOUT SQUAD; SCOUT SNIPER SQUAD; TACTICAL SQUAD; TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD; TERMINATOR SQUAD.

parts.name: Transhuman Strategist
parts.desc: If your WARLORD is a model with this ability, you gain 1CP at the start of the battle round.

parts.name: Librarius
parts.desc:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or more, given in that unit's abilities. Every psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or more, given in the ability's name.

In each battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use any combination of psychic abilities as long as their psychic levels added together are no higher than that PSYKER unit's psyker level (for example, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, a psychic level 1 and a psychic level 2 ability, or a single psychic level 3 ability).

parts.name: Shock Disembark Move
parts.desc:
Eligible if (as the rule granting this move type states) every one of these is true for your unit:
- It is embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield.
- It did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase.

Effect: Your unit is set up following Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02).
While moving: Every model in your unit must be set up wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
After moving: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Set-up distance: 3"

parts.name: Assault Disembark Move
parts.desc:
Eligible if (as the rule granting this move type states) every one of these is true for your unit:
- It is embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield.
- It did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase.
- That TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase.

Effect: Your unit is set up following Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02).
While moving: Every model in your unit must be set up wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

Set-up distance: 3"

Angelic Inheritors.rule:
- Friendly BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units may re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- Friendly BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units may re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Restriction: BLOOD ANGELS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Focused Fury
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [LETHAL HITS]. If your unit is a CHARACTER unit, they gain [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE] instead.

mathBuff.note: Focused Fury: [LETHAL HITS] (CHARACTER units also get [LANCE]).

stratagems.name: Measured Strategist
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose one combat doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that doctrine is active for your unit.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Great Wings
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains Stealth and -3" detection range.

stratagems.name: Strike Now for Glory
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

mathBuff.note: Strike Now for Glory: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (ranged).

stratagems.name: Instant of Grace
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.

stratagems.name: Unto the Burning Skies
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly THE SANGUINOR unit or unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is placed in strategic reserves.

Encarmine Speartip.rule:
The tactical doctrine is active for SANGUINARY GUARD units, as well as any other combat doctrine.

Restriction: BLOOD ANGELS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Blinding Blurs of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains Stealth and -3" detection range.

stratagems.name: Inexorable Valour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Judgement of the Golden Host
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Pick one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: for every 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Wrath of the Doomed.rule:
- Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have this ability: at the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for this unit.
- The devastator and tactical doctrines can never be active for DEATH COMPANY units, whatever other rules say: the assault doctrine is the only one they can have.

Restriction: BLOOD ANGELS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Death Begets Vengeance
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is hated for the rest of the battle: attacks made by friendly DEATH COMPANY units have +1 to their wound rolls when they target a hated unit.

stratagems.name: No Barrier to Retribution
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a normal, advance or charge move.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Rage-Fuelled Response
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a surge move of up to D6".

Vow-Sworn Crusaders.rule:
At the start of the first battle round, you can pick one of the Vows below. It is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units for the rest of the battle.
- Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch: melee attacks against a PSYKER unit have [PRECISION] and [LANCE].
- Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds: melee attacks against a unit whose T is higher than the attacker's S have +1 to their wound rolls.
- Uphold the Honour of the Emperor: friendly INFANTRY units gain these abilities: at the end of your Movement phase, an objective this unit controls becomes secured; and an advance move does not stop this unit being eligible to start an action.

Restriction: BLACK TEMPLARS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Devout Push
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a pile-in or consolidation move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: That pile-in or consolidation move can be up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Heresy Begets Retribution
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Dread Crusaders
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit as a charge target.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit takes a battle-shock roll with -1 to it.

stratagems.name: Pious Enmity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks may re-roll hit rolls of 1. Against a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, they may re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1 instead.

stratagems.name: For the Emperor's Honour!
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Spoor of the Unholy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks can ignore modifiers to BS, WS and hit rolls.

Fist of the God-Emperor.rule:
When a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a surge move, you can pick the objective closest to it instead of a surge target. Each model must then end that surge move as close as possible to that objective.

Restriction: BLACK TEMPLARS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Angels Defiant
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 to their wound rolls when their S is higher than your unit's T.

stratagems.name: Avowed Destruction
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose: your unit's melee attacks gain [LETHAL HITS], or they gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Doctrinal Flexibility
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose one combat doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that doctrine is active for your unit.

Marshal's Household.rule:
In the Fight phase, the melee attacks of a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit within range of an objective have +1 A.

Restriction: BLACK TEMPLARS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Blade of Detestation
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.target: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Pick one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: for every 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (6 mortal wounds at most).

stratagems.name: Slayers of Abominations
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks against a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: Unsparing Execution
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode; if it is battle-shocked, its hazard rolls have -1.

Wrath of the Rock.rule:
When an attack targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit and that attack's S is higher than the unit's T, the attack has -1 to its wound roll.

Restriction: DARK ANGELS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: In Sacrifice, Victory
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit that is within range of an objective is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit. It can be targeted even though it was destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Choose one objective that no enemy units (other than AIRCRAFT) are within range of, and that your unit controlled at the end of the previous phase. That objective becomes secured.

stratagems.name: Lion's Will
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has +1 OC.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Justice
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Relics of the Dark Age
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks gain +2 S.

mathBuff.note: Relics of the Dark Age: +2 S (ranged).

stratagems.name: Knights of Iron
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly RAVENWING unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That RAVENWING unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Tactical Mastery
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose one combat doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that doctrine is active for your unit.

Darkflight Pursuit.rule:
- Ranged attacks made by friendly RAVENWING FLY units gain [IGNORES COVER].
- Friendly Outrider Squad units gain BATTLELINE.

Restriction: DARK ANGELS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Surveillance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That RAVENWING FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: We Are Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That RAVENWING FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Wings of Shadow
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.target: That RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains Stealth.

Inner Circle Task Force.rule:
In your Command phase, this ability can be used. When it is, pick one objective: it is your vowed objective until your next Command phase. Attacks made by friendly DEATHWING INFANTRY units have +1 to their wound rolls when they target an enemy unit that is within range of your vowed objective.

Restriction: DARK ANGELS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly DEATHWING unit.
stratagems.target: That DEATHWING unit.
stratagems.effect:
Each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not yet been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6 (+1 to the roll if your unit is engaged with an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective):
- On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield. It is removed once your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

stratagems.name: Relic Teleportarium
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit with Deep Strike is selected to make an ingress move.
stratagems.target: That DEATHWING unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up more than 6" horizontally away from every enemy unit, instead of more than 8". Your unit cannot declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Lion
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, after a friendly DEATHWING unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.target: That DEATHWING unit.
stratagems.effect: Pick one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is engaged with that enemy unit: for every 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (6 mortal wounds at most).

Black Spear Task Force.rule:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have these abilities:
- Furor Tactics: while the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- Malleus Tactics: while the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, its attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
- Purgatus Tactics: while the assault doctrine is active for this unit, its attacks against an enemy unit within 9" have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Adaptive Tactics
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose one combat doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that doctrine is active for your unit.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That KILL TEAM unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks (other than attacks with [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]) gain [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

mathBuff.note: Hellfire Rounds: [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+] (not on [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapons).

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until that enemy unit has attacked, attacks that target your unit have -1 AP.

stratagems.name: Kraken Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That KILL TEAM unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have +6" range and +1 S.

mathBuff.note: Kraken Rounds: +1 S (and +6" range).

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That KILL TEAM unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks may re-roll wound rolls of 1 and gain [IGNORES COVER].

mathBuff.note: Dragonfire Rounds: re-roll wound rolls of 1, [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Site-to-Site Teleportation
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is placed in strategic reserves. If it is a KILL TEAM unit, it has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.

Deathwatch Support.rule:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have these abilities:
- Furor Tactics: while the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- Malleus Tactics: while the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, its attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
- Purgatus Tactics: while the assault doctrine is active for this unit, its attacks against an enemy unit within 9" have [PRECISION].

Deathwatch Allies: your army can include DEATHWATCH units even though their Chapter keyword differs from the rest of your army, up to 500 points of them in total. Unless a rule says otherwise, a DEATHWATCH model cannot be your WARLORD, and KILL TEAM units can only take enhancements from this detachment. This overrides the Space Marine Chapters army rule.

stratagems.name: Blackstar Extraction
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is placed in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That KILL TEAM unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks may re-roll wound rolls of 1 and gain [IGNORES COVER].

mathBuff.note: Dragonfire Rounds: re-roll wound rolls of 1, [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That KILL TEAM unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks (other than attacks with [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]) gain [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

mathBuff.note: Hellfire Rounds: [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+] (not on [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapons).

Saga of the Great Wolf.rule:
- Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability (other than MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have these abilities:
  Encircling Jaws: while the assault doctrine is active for this unit, it has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.
  Hunter's Eye: while the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, its ranged attacks may re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  Ferocious Strike: while the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, its attacks against an enemy unit within 9" have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- Friendly LOGAN GRIMNAR units have this ability:
  Howling Onslaught (Once per battle, per army): in your Command phase, this ability can be used. When it is, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER/VEHICLE units also benefit from Master of Wolves until the start of your next Command phase.

Restriction: SPACE WOLVES units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Battle Instincts
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Fenrisian Ferocity
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Eye of the Pack
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks may re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

stratagems.name: Grimnar's Command
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
stratagems.effect: Choose one combat doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that doctrine is active for your unit.

stratagems.name: Fangs of the Pack
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Wolf Totems
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Champions of Fenris.rule:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER units have this ability:
Countercharge (Once per battle round, per unit): targeting this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem costs 1CP less.

stratagems.name: Birth of a Saga
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.

stratagems.name: Champion's Guidance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks may re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

mathBuff.note: Champion's Guidance: re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1 (melee).

stratagems.name: Heroic Resolve
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until that enemy unit has attacked, attacks that target your unit have -1 D.

Saga of the Beastslayer.rule: Attacks made by friendly BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN units have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: Co-ordinated Strike
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit within 9" of a battlefield edge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is placed in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Impetuosity
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Unbridled Ferocity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [LANCE].

Blade of Ultramar.rule:
If your army includes MARNEUS CALGAR, you can choose the assault doctrine, the devastator doctrine and the tactical doctrine one extra time each per battle.

Restriction: ULTRAMARINES units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until that enemy unit has attacked, attacks that target your unit have -1 AP.

stratagems.name: Practical Tactics
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Courage and Honour!
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [LANCE].

mathBuff.note: [LANCE] = +1 to Wound on the charge.

stratagems.name: Tactical Foresight
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 to their wound rolls when their S is higher than your unit's T.

stratagems.name: Exemplary Vigilance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks gain [IGNORES COVER].

mathBuff.note: Ranged [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Ultramarian Adaptivity
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Choose one combat doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that doctrine is active for your unit.

Forgefather's Seekers.rule:
- You can choose the devastator doctrine one extra time per battle.
- Ranged attacks made by friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units against a target within 12" have +1 S.
- If your army includes VULKAN HE'STAN, friendly INFERNUS SQUAD units have this ability: an advance or fall-back move does not stop this unit being eligible to start an action, and starting an action does not stop it being eligible to shoot.

Restriction: SALAMANDERS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Blazing Earth
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that has one or more torrent or melta weapons.
stratagems.effect: Pick one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit: it has -1 to its charge rolls this phase.

stratagems.name: Forged in Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's [TORRENT] weapons lose [BLAST], gain [CLOSE-QUARTERS] and have +1 A.

stratagems.name: Burning Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a disembark move and then shoot using normal shooting, but only at that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Immolation Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Crucible of Battle
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks may re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

mathBuff.note: Crucible of Battle: re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1 (target within 6").

stratagems.name: Wrath and Ruin
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: The assault doctrine or the tactical doctrine (your choice) is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

Shadowmark Talon.rule:
- Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have Stealth.
- Friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD units have -3" detection range.
- Friendly AETHON SHAAN units have this ability: Unparalleled Tactician (Once per battle round, per army): using the Into Darkness stratagem costs 1CP less.

Restriction: RAVEN GUARD units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Feint and Thrust
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, as well as any other combat doctrine.

stratagems.name: Murderous Fusillade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have +1 BS and +1 AP.

mathBuff.note: Murderous Fusillade: +1 BS, +1 AP (unit made an ingress move this turn).

stratagems.name: Into Darkness
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is placed in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Raptorial Vigilance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if it is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

stratagems.name: Lay Low the Tyrants
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Suppressed Weapons
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not stop your unit being hidden.

Medusa's Wrath.rule:
When a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or fight, pick one for those attacks: re-roll one hit roll, re-roll one wound roll, or re-roll one damage roll. If the unit is within 6" of a friendly CAANOK VAR/IRON FATHER FEIRROS unit, it can do all three instead.

Restriction: IRON HANDS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Ancient Fury
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has +1" M, +1 T, +1 Ld, +1 OC and +1 to its hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Spirits of Iron
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Mercy is Weakness
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; a VEHICLE unit's attacks also have +1 to their wound rolls.

mathBuff.note: Mercy is Weakness: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (VEHICLE units also +1 to wound).

stratagems.name: Unbowed Conviction
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to BS, WS, hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting (or normal shooting if it is at or below Half-strength), and can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Vengeful Animus
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is destroyed, before rolling for Deadly Demise.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Deadly Demise rolls count as unmodified 6s.

Ceramite Sentinels.rule:
- While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain area, its attacks may re-roll wound rolls of 1.
- A friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is entrenched while it is within a terrain area, was not set up this turn, and none of its models moved more than 3" this turn.
- Friendly DARNATH LYSANDER/TOR GARADON units have this ability: Defensive Mastery: this unit is entrenched at the start of each phase, and always counts as entrenched whatever the conditions above.

Restriction: IMPERIAL FISTS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Augmented Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks gain [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (your choice), or both if your unit is entrenched.

stratagems.name: Priority Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks against a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to their wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Establish Supremacy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: You can pick the objective consolidation mode for that move, whatever that move's Before Moving restrictions say.

stratagems.name: Stand to the End
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 to their wound rolls when their S is higher than your unit's T; while your unit is entrenched, every attack that targets it has -1 to its wound roll.

stratagems.name: Evasive Repositioning
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D6" (D3+3" if entrenched), and cannot embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Unyielding Might
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has +1 OC.

Spearpoint Task Force.rule:
- You can choose the assault doctrine or the tactical doctrine one extra time per battle.
- Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +1 to their advance rolls.
- Friendly SUBODEN KHAN units have this ability: Wrath of the First Khan: at the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, it can make a normal move if it is unengaged, or a fall-back move if it is engaged.

Restriction: WHITE SCARS units may be included in your army, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Evasive Manoeuvers
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to their wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Mobile Lethality
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance or fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: A fall-back move does not stop your unit being eligible to shoot, and your unit's ranged attacks gain [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: Flawless Riders
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Spear Thrust and Sabre Swing
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks gain [LETHAL HITS] or [LANCE] (your choice); a MOUNTED unit gets both.

mathBuff.note: Spear Thrust and Sabre Swing: [LETHAL HITS] (or [LANCE]; MOUNTED units get both).

stratagems.name: Hunter's Instincts
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Withdraw and Regroup
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is placed in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Divine Aspect
enhancements.desc: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of that bearer; that unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

enhancements.name: Triptych of the Macharian Crusade
enhancements.desc: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Each time the bearer uses an Act of Faith to substitute a saving throw, that saving throw is successful, irrespective of the value of the Miracle dice used.

enhancements.name: Blade of Saint Ellynor
enhancements.desc: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1, and those weapons have the [Precision] ability. _armyRule.name: Acts of Faith
_armyRule.rule:
GAINING MIRACLE DICE
If your Army Faction is ADEPTA SORORITAS, you gain 1 Miracle dice:
- At the start of each turn.
- Each time an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army is destroyed.

Each time you gain a Miracle dice, roll one D6. The number you roll is the value of that Miracle dice. This value cannot be changed or re-rolled, unless a rule specifically states otherwise. Keep your Miracle dice to one side - this is your Miracle dice pool.

PERFORMING AN ACT OF FAITH
Before making a dice roll for a model or unit from your army with the Acts of Faith ability, if you have one or more dice in your Miracle dice pool, that unit can perform an Act of Faith. If it does, select one of the dice from your Miracle dice pool to substitute that dice roll (if a roll involves more than one dice, e.g. a Charge roll or Battle-shock test, only a single dice can be substituted). The dice that is being substituted is not rolled; instead, the value of the selected Miracle dice is used as if it had been rolled (this counts as an unmodified dice roll of that value for all rules purposes). Each Miracle dice can only be selected for substitution once. Once all Miracle dice substitutions have been made, remove the chosen Miracle dice from your Miracle dice pool, and roll all remaining, unsubstituted dice that are a part of the dice roll. You can use Miracle dice when a unit performs an Act of Faith for any of the following types of dice roll:
- Advance roll
- Battle-shock test
- Charge roll
- Damage roll
- Hit roll
- Saving throw
- Wound roll

Shield Host.rule:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the bullet points below. If you do, until the start of the next battle round, that bullet point's effects apply.

- Each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army with the Martial Ka'tah ability makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
- Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by ADEPTUS CUSTODES models from your army with the Martial Ka'tah ability by 1.

stratagems.name: Arcane Genetic Alchemy
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA models).
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES model's unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.

mathBuff.note: +1 A melee (requires the unit below Starting Strength). Set +2 instead while Below Half-strength.

stratagems.name: Unwavering Sentinels
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Multipotentiality
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Vigilance Eternal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.name: Archeotech Munitions
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

mathBuff.note: Ranged [LETHAL HITS]; the Stratagem can grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] instead — pick one in play.

Auric Champions.rule: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Slayer of Champions
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected with your Assemblage of Might ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll. In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.

stratagems.name: Superhuman Reserves
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model from your army has used a 'once per battle' ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use its 'once per battle' ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase). You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: The Emperor's Auspice
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

stratagems.name: Earning of a Name
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit & Wound re-roll, but only vs MONSTER or VEHICLE targets. Toggle when the defender is one of those.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Shoulder the Mantle
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that is not leading a unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit's Starting Strength accordingly.

Lions of the Emperor.rule: Each time a model in an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLES) makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 6" of that unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army has used a 'once per battle' ability on its datasheet.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use that 'once per battle' ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase). You cannot use this Stratagem on the same model more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Defiant to the Last
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Peerless Warrior
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ALLARUS CUSTODIANS or AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Null Maiden Vigil.rule:
In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is either a PSYKER unit or below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more ANATHEMA PSYKANA models from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that unit is Below Half-strength, it must subtract 1 from its Battle-shock test this phase instead.

KEYWORDS: If you select this Detachment, PROSECUTORS units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.name: Desperation's Price
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.
stratagems.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test. If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed, that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Witch Hunters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.

mathBuff.note: Only when targeting a PSYKER unit. [LETHAL HITS]; can be [SUSTAINED HITS 1] instead — pick one.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One VIGILATORS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

mathBuff.note: Full melee Hit re-roll. Wound re-roll only vs Battle-shocked or PSYKER targets — untick it otherwise.

stratagems.name: Psy-chaff Volley
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has just shot.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model makes an attack against it, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.

mathBuff.note: Torrent weapons only: +1 Attacks (set +2 instead vs a PSYKER or Battle-shocked target).

stratagems.name: Psychic Abominations
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".

Solar Spearhead.rule:
While an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army is at Starting Strength (unless it is an AIRCRAFT or is Battle-shocked), add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.
While such a unit is below Starting Strength, each time a model in it makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
While such a unit is Below Half-strength, each time a model in it makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

MORITOI ANCIENTS: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER units from your army and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for such units.

KEYWORDS: In the Muster Armies step, you can select up to 2 ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER models; the selected units gain the CHARACTER keyword (so they can take Enhancements and one can be your WARLORD).

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Emperor's Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the WALKER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Wrathful Advance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".

stratagems.name: Unstoppable
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Relentless Persecution
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the WALKER keyword, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

stratagems.name: Punishment Inescapable
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: [IGNORES COVER] on ranged weapons (also lets you ignore Hit/BS modifiers).

Talons of the Emperor.rule:
ANATHEMA PSYKANA units from your army gain Null Aegis (Aura): While an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is within 6" of this unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

All other ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army gain Deadly Unity (Aura): While an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a model in that ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Hunt as One
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your units are eligible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back. You can only select two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.

stratagems.name: Talons Interlocked
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. You can only select two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.

mathBuff.note: +1 Strength and +1 AP on ranged attacks (must focus a single target unit).

stratagems.name: Empyric Severance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Emperor's Executioners
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll. You can only select two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound, but only vs enemy units that are below their Starting Strength. Toggle when modelling that.

stratagems.name: Taloned Pincer
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6". You cannot select units within Engagement Range of any enemy units. You can only select two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.

stratagems.name: Shield of Honour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target, and one other friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).

Might of the Moritoi.rule:
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER units:
Have +2" M.
Have +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.
This detachment has the ARMOURY tag and cannot be taken with another ARMOURY detachment.

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit is selected to move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Prioritised Eradication
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit's:
Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons have [RAPID FIRE 6].
Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons have [RAPID FIRE 2].

Silent Hunters.rule:
When a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to start an action.
Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have the following ability:
Ceaseless Vigilance: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is nulled:
While a unit is nulled, that unit has +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: Deathsong Scythes
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATORS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That VIGILATORS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].
Your unit's melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have +1 A.

stratagems.name: Umbral Prosecution
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTORS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That PROSECUTORS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit's Boltgun weapons have:
[RAPID FIRE 2].
+1 AP.

stratagems.name: Synchronised Inferno
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKERS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That WITCHSEEKERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's [TORRENT] ranged attacks have [BLAST 1].

Tharanatoi Hammerblow.rule:
If a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit made an ingress move this turn, that unit can reroll charge rolls.
This detachment has the LIONS tag and cannot be taken with another LIONS detachment.

stratagems.name: Hardened Resolve
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 T.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ALLARUS CUSTODIANS/AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Electro-Exorcist Saturation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Ballistus Grenade Launcher weapons have D3+3 A.

In the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight, its melee attacks gain one of:
- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- Or: [LETHAL HITS].

⚠ 3 DP is an estimate until the Munitorum Field Manual is published.

stratagems.effect:

Restriction: the same unit cannot be picked for this stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect:

- Your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
