_armyRule.name: Martial Ka'tah
_armyRule.rule:
MARTIAL KA'TAH
At the start of your Command phase, your units with this ability become readied. A readied unit may use one ka'tah ability below when its timing comes up; using it means the unit is no longer readied. Some characters and stratagems ready a unit again.

Conservai - Your Command phase. Target: one friendly readied unit. Until the end of the turn:
- Being engaged/battle-shocked does not stop your unit being eligible to start an action.
- Starting an action does not stop your unit being eligible to shoot.

Calistus - Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move. Target: that unit. When it makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, it may move through all types of model.

Salvus - Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot. Target: that unit. It may ignore modifiers to its BS, and to its hit rolls and wound rolls.

Dacatarai - Start of the Fight phase. Target: one friendly readied unit. Its melee attacks against an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) may re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Kaptaris - Start of the Fight phase. Target: one friendly readied unit. Melee attacks against it have -1 to hit rolls.

Rendax - Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight. Target: that unit. Its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

⚠ Summarised from the Warhammer Community preview; the codex page for this rule (pg 90) is still pending.

AEGIS OF THE EMPEROR
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units that have this ability get Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

AQUILA COMMANDER
When a battle round starts, gain 1CP if your WARLORD is a model with this ability.

DAUGHTERS OF THE ABYSS
- Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units that have this ability get Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.
- Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units that have this ability also gain:
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit get Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

ANATHEMA PSYKANA
ANATHEMA PSYKANA units (pg 118-120) can be included in an ADEPTUS CUSTODES army although they lack that faction keyword. Unless a rule says otherwise, ANATHEMA PSYKANA cannot be chosen as your army faction, and an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model cannot be your WARLORD.

SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE (special move type)
Maximum distance 3". Eligible if the rule allowing it says so and your unit is embarked within a TRANSPORT model on the battlefield that it did not embark within this phase. Set each model up wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT (Core Rules 03.02). Afterwards your unit cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.

detData._format: Same shape as detachments.json. Each detachment has optional 'ruleName' + 'rule' (string) and 'stratagems' (array of {name, type, cp, when, target, effect}). Optional 'mathBuff' on each stratagem to surface as a Mathhammer toggle (scope: 'ranged'|'melee'|'all'). Rebuild with build.ps1.

Questoris Companions.rule:
At the start of your turn, if your current Oath is fulfilled, determine an additional Oath as normal, except you cannot select a Deed or Quality you have already selected (re-roll/re-select duplicates). If you have already selected every Deed and Quality, do not determine an additional Oath. The Qualities from Oaths you have fulfilled continue to apply to all models with the Code Chivalric ability. When the Deed for an additional Oath is completed, you instead gain 1CP.

Valour's Reward: The Enhancements in this detachment can become expended (you cannot use them while expended). Each time you fulfil your Oath, each expended Enhancement is no longer expended.

stratagems.name: Courageous Stand
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Hit and +1 Wound, but ONLY vs MONSTER / TITANIC / WALKER targets. Toggle when the defender is one of those.

stratagems.name: Moment of Glory
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" provided your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Hero's Tread
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Warrior
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Driven by the Past
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Freeblade Company.rule: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models from your army have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. In addition, at the start of your Command phase, each IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army regains 1 lost wound.

stratagems.name: Noble Sacrifice
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+, adding 1 to the result if it is an ARMIGER unit, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: Strength from Exile
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 9" of your unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hits of 1 and Wounds of 1 — only while no other friendly unit is within 9".

stratagems.name: Full Tilt
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, or 9" instead if your unit is an ARMIGER or DESTRIER unit.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Barrage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making ranged attacks with Blast weapons, models in your unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of your unit (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). Your unit does not suffer the penalty to Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range; but each time a model makes a Blast attack against a unit within Engagement Range, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1 your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all its attacks resolve.

stratagems.name: Survivor of Strife
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Flanking Manoeuvres
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ARMIGER unit from your army that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Gate Warden Lance.rule:
At the start of the first battle round, select two objectives to be your foundations. Place a circular 40mm foundation marker in each one. When you draw a line from any part of one your foundation markers to any part of the other, if any part of a model’s base (or any part of a model’s hull, for a model without a base) crosses that line, that model’s unit is said to be on your defensive line.

While an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army is on your defensive line, that unit has the following ability:

Against the Horde: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll, and weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Drive Them Out!
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit on your defensive line, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Lancebreaker
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Steadfast Superiority
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that is on your defensive line and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit re-roll. Requires the unit to be on your defensive line and in Engagement Range.

stratagems.name: Marshal the Defence
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units from your army that have not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your units.

stratagems.name: Titanic Bombardment
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that Remained Stationary this turn, that is on your defensive line and that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

mathBuff.note: Ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 2]. Requires Titanic, Remained Stationary, on your defensive line.

stratagems.name: Fortress of Intimidation
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Spearhead-at-Arms.rule:
Each time a model from your army uses its Bondsman ability, if no other model from your army has used that Bondsman ability that turn, you can select up to three friendly ARMIGER models (instead of one) within 12" of that model, or within 15" while your army is Honoured (you still cannot select a model already affected by a Bondsman ability). Until the start of your next Command phase, those models are affected by that Bondsman ability.

KEYWORDS: ARMIGER models from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP for ARMIGER models vs the selected enemy unit.

_armyRule.name: Code Chivalric
_armyRule.rule:
Imperial Knights fight by a stringent set of codes — in addition to defeating the foe, honour must always be upheld.

If your Army Faction is IMPERIAL KNIGHTS, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step you must determine your army's Oath for the battle. An Oath consists of two parts — one Deed and one Quality (three options each, below). For each part you can either select one or randomly select one by rolling a D6.

The selected Deed describes what must be achieved to complete it. The selected Quality's ability applies to all models in your army with this ability until the end of the battle.

The first time your selected Deed is completed, your Oath is fulfilled: until the end of the battle your army is Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (this CP gain is an exception to the 1-CP-per-battle-round limit).

parts.name: Deed — We vow to lay low the tyrant
parts.desc: At the start of the battle, select one CHARACTER model in your opponent's army. This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that CHARACTER is destroyed.

parts.name: Deed — We swear to reclaim the realm
parts.desc: This Deed is completed at the end of your opponent's turn if you control more objective markers than your opponent.

parts.name: Deed — We pledge to reap a great tally
parts.desc: This Deed is completed at the end of the battle round if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than the battle round number (even if those units are subsequently returned to the battlefield — for example, two destroyed enemy units in the first battle round).

parts.name: Quality — …with our martial valour risen over all
parts.desc: Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.

parts.name: Quality — …and we are eager for the challenge
parts.desc: Add 2" to this model's Move characteristic, and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.

parts.name: Quality — …yet shall our legacy be unsullied
parts.desc: Improve this model's Objective Control characteristic by 2 and its Leadership characteristic by 1.

parts.name: Bondsman
parts.desc: Some IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models have a Bondsman ability (tagged 'Bondsman'). In your Command phase, one or more models with a Bondsman ability can use it: for each one that does, select one friendly ARMIGER model within 12" that is not already affected by a Bondsman ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ARMIGER model is affected by that Bondsman ability.

parts.name: Super-heavy Walker
parts.desc: Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them. It can also move through terrain features more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

parts.name: Freeblades
parts.desc: If every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include either one TITANIC IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model or up to three ARMIGER models even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected. None of these models can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

_armyRule.name: Gate of Infinity
_armyRule.rule:
If your Army Faction is GREY KNIGHTS, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, you can select a number of units (see below) from your army that are on the battlefield (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), provided every model in those units has this ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
- Incursion: Up to 2 units
- Strike Force: Up to 3 units
- Onslaught: Up to 4 units

Place those units in strategic reserves. Those units can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

detData._format: Same shape as detachments.json. ruleName + rule (string) + stratagems [{name,type,cp,when,target,effect,mathBuff?}]. mathBuff scope: 'ranged'|'melee'|'all'. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Brotherhood Strike.rule: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Channelling
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

mathBuff.note: Psychic melee weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

stratagems.name: Combat Manifestation
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn it is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Purgation Pattern
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

mathBuff.note: Requires the unit to have Deep Struck this turn. Weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Duty Unending
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GREY KNIGHTS units Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Shining Veil
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Expeditious Exit
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Augurium Task Force.rule: From the second battle round onwards, at the start of your Movement phase, if you did not select the maximum number of GREY KNIGHTS units using the Gate of Infinity ability at the end of your opponent's previous turn, you can select one GREY KNIGHTS unit on the battlefield that could have been selected using Gate of Infinity. Remove that unit and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Anticipation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Appointed Hour
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Forewarned Evasion
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS WALKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Necessary End
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Redirected Strike
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Mirage of Echoes
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Banishers.rule:
Each time a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army is selected to fight, that unit can take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, select one of the following. Until the end of the phase, that unit has that rule:
- Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
- Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Hexwrought Reprisal
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (max 6). These are Psychic Attacks.

stratagems.name: Warding Chant
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.

stratagems.name: Chaos Bane
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.

stratagems.name: Celerity
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Circle of Sanctuary
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.

stratagems.name: Shadow of Anarch
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Hallowed Conclave.rule: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Giants of the Battlefield
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

mathBuff.note: +1 Attacks on melee weapons (Terminator unit).

stratagems.name: Unending Fidelity
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Purgation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

mathBuff.note: Storm bolters gain [TWIN-LINKED] (full Wound re-roll) — toggle when simulating a storm bolter.

stratagems.name: Grind Them Underfoot

stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (max 6).

stratagems.name: Precognitive Strategies
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Shining Resolve
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Sanctic Spearhead.rule: Each time a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Will
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Abominus-Class Targets
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound, but only vs MONSTER or VEHICLE targets.

stratagems.name: Armoured Aegis
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

stratagems.name: Redoubled Assault
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Force Wave
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Argent Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

Warpbane Task Force.rule:
Certain areas are within your army's Hallowed Ground: your deployment zone always; within 6" of any PURIFIER SQUAD unit; No Man's Land (at the start of any phase if you control at least half its objectives); your opponent's deployment zone (at the start of any phase if you control at least half its objectives).

Each time a model in a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army makes a ranged attack against a visible target or makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD and/or is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Kill Zone
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Wounds of 1 (requires wholly within Hallowed Ground). Set to full Wound re-roll if the unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.

stratagems.name: Flames of Sanctity
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One PURIFIER SQUAD unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 if your unit includes CASTELLAN CROWE: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Hallowed Beacon
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding TERMINATOR units) arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Fires of Covenant
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 if your unit is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Aegis Eternal
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Repelling Sphere
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground.

Argent Assault.rule: When a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight, if the Strength of those attacks is lower than the Toughness of the target, those attacks have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Aegis
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: A Threat Ended
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have the [PRECISION] ability.

mathBuff.note: [PRECISION] on melee for a PALADIN SQUAD.

stratagems.name: Aura of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit's melee attacks have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

Fires of Purgation.rule: When you select a unit to be pinned by a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit's Righteous Persecution ability, that enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test with -1 to that test.

stratagems.name: Soul-Locked
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Focused Immolation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Your unit's ranged attacks that target that unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

mathBuff.note: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] + [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ranged vs the chosen unit.

stratagems.name: Spiritsear
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one Battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

Immaterial Interdiction.rule:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do:
- That unit cannot use its Personal Teleporters ability.
- That unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

stratagems.name: Blades From the Beyond
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have the [LANCE] ability.

mathBuff.note: [LANCE] (+1 to Wound on the charge) melee for an INTERCEPTOR SQUAD.

stratagems.name: By Thought Alone
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit starts an Action.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That Action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Responsive Displacement
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a Fall Back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is unengaged.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Clandestine Infiltrator
enhancements.desc: Skitarii model only. The bearer, and models in any unit they are leading, have the Infiltrators and Scouts 6" abilities.

enhancements.name: Veiled Hunter
enhancements.desc: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to three SKITARII INFANTRY units from your army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Battle-Sphere Uplink
enhancements.desc: Skitarii model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Radial Suffusion
enhancements.desc: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. From the second battle round onwards, when resolving the Fallout effect of the Rad-bombardment Detachment rule, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your opponent’s deployment zone, in addition to those that are within your opponent’s deployment zone.

enhancements.name: Malphonic Susurrus
enhancements.desc: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Peerless Eradicator
enhancements.desc: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

enhancements.name: Autoclavic Denunciation
enhancements.desc: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Magos
enhancements.desc: Tech-Priest model only. At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is within range of your Acquisition objective marker, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Genetor
enhancements.desc: Tech-Priest model only. While the bearer is leading a unit that is within range of your Acquisition objective marker, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Logis
enhancements.desc: Tech-Priest model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of your Acquisition objective marker, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Artisan

- Muted Servomotors: Stealth.

stratagems.name: Eradication Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Wounds of 1; also re-roll Hits of 1 if the unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit (tick hit re-roll of 1 separately if so).

stratagems.name: Targeting Override
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Neural Overload
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Select one Override ability; until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active for your unit (in addition to others if already HALO OVERRIDE).

stratagems.name: Aggressive Impulse
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One SKORPIUS DUNERIDER model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Guided Retreat
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army makes a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for it.

stratagems.name: Analytical Divination
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit (excluding KATAPHRON units) from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit.

Cohort Cybernetica.rule: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in LEGIO CYBERNETICA units from your army. In addition, unless that unit is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Motive Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: Auto-Divinatory Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army, and one objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have a Ballistic Skill of 3+ and the [IGNORES COVER] ability, but can only target units within range of the selected objective marker.

mathBuff.note: Sets Ballistic Skill to 3+ and grants [IGNORES COVER], but only vs units within range of the chosen objective marker. Stacks with Protector (+1 BS) -> 2+.

stratagems.name: Machine Spirit Resurgent
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

mathBuff.note: Requires the unit below Starting Strength. Full Hit re-roll; also full Wound re-roll while Below Half-strength.

stratagems.name: Machine Superiority
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back, and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

stratagems.name: Transcendent Cogitation
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for your unit.

stratagems.name: Benevolence of the Omnissiah
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, improved to Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Data-psalm Conclave.rule:
At the start of the first battle round, select one Benediction to be active for CULT MECHANICUS units from your army until the end of the battle:
- Panegyric Procession: Each time a CULT MECHANICUS model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within half range, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
- Citation in Savagery: Each time a CULT MECHANICUS unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Incantation of the Iron Soul
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after you allocate a mortal wound to a CULT MECHANICUS model from your army.
stratagems.target: That CULT MECHANICUS model's unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Chant of the Remorseless Fist
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound on melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Verse of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. It can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Tribute of Emphatic Veneration
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army and one enemy unit within 18" of it.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If failed, until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Litany of the Electromancer
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of one or more CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit, adding 1 if that model is an ELECTRO-PRIEST. On a 5+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Luminescent Blessing
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Eradication Cohort.rule:
Each time a model in a SKITARII unit from your army makes an attack:
- If the Protector Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
- If the Conqueror Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Servo-driven Charge
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.name: Unrelenting Aggression
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the SKITARII keyword, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

stratagems.name: Unshackled Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] to apply all three.

mathBuff.note: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (or [LETHAL HITS]; or both + [HAZARDOUS]). Adjust to taste.

stratagems.name: Threat-Cogitation Targeters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

stratagems.name: Precision Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a SICARIAN unit from your army declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That SICARIAN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit within Engagement Range of it: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Analytic Reprisals
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII INFANTRY unit from your army that lost one or more models as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target.

Explorator Maniple.rule: At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker. Until the start of your next Command phase, that is your Acquisition objective marker. Each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model from your army makes an attack, if that model's unit is within range of your Acquisition objective marker, or if the target of that attack is within range of it, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Cached Acquisition
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was just destroyed while within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.name: Priority Reclamation
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends within range of your Acquisition objective marker. Cannot be used if the unit is within 3" of any enemy units.

stratagems.name: Infoslave Skull
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One TECH-PRIEST model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of it (excluding your Acquisition objective marker).
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is also considered to be one of your Acquisition objective markers for all rules purposes.

stratagems.name: Auto-Oracular Retrieval
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Acquisition objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound (requires the unit disembarked this turn and the target within range of your Acquisition objective).

stratagems.name: Incense Exhausts
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKE unit within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, both of those units have the Stealth ability and the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.name: Reactive Safeguard
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army within range of your Acquisition objective marker that was selected as a target of that charge, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT (every model must be within 3" and there must be sufficient capacity).

Rad-zone Corps.rule:
BOMBARDMENT (Battle round 1): At the start of the first battle round, for each enemy unit within your opponent's deployment zone, your opponent decides whether it takes cover or stands firm. Roll one D6 per unit:
- Standing Firm: on a 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- Taking Cover: it is Battle-shocked and, on a 5+, suffers D3 mortal wounds.

FALLOUT (Battle rounds 2-5): At the start of your Command phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within your opponent's deployment zone. On a 3+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound and must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Baleful Halo
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target. If it is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE) within 6".
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is made that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Extinction Order
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One TECH-PRIEST model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of it.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within range of that objective marker. On a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound and must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Aggressor Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase. If it is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE) within 6".
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Pre-Calibrated Purge Solution
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. If it is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE) within 6".
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of those units makes a ranged attack, if the target is within your opponent's deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit re-roll, but only vs targets within your opponent's deployment zone.

stratagems.name: Lethal Dosage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

mathBuff.note: Ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Bulwark Imperative
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that was selected as the target. If it is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE) within 6".
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in those units have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.rule: Friendly SKITARII INFANTRY, SKITARII MOUNTED and IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII units have Stealth.

stratagems.name: Bionic Endurance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SICARIAN, PTERAXII or SYDONIAN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: Binharic Offence
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two SKITARII units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration of weapons equipped by models in both of your units by 1. Each model in either unit can only target that enemy unit (if eligible).

mathBuff.note: +1 AP (both selected units must focus the single chosen enemy unit).

stratagems.name: Expedited Purge Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Isolate and Destroy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SICARIAN, PTERAXII, SYDONIAN, IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other enemy units within 6" of the unit targeted by that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound, but only vs an isolated target (no other enemy unit within 6" of it).

stratagems.name: Shroud Protocols
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: Programmed Withdrawal
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two SICARIAN units from your army, or one SKITARII INFANTRY or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. Each unit must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.

Cohort Acquisitus.rule:
Friendly PTERAXII/INFILTRATORS/RANGERS/SERBERYS RAIDERS/SERBERYS SULPHURHOUNDS units have RECON AUGURY.
Friendly RECON AUGURY units have the following ability:
Enhanced Augurs: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is analysed: While a unit is analysed, that unit has +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: Defect Scrutiny
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly RECON AUGURY unit. Your unit's ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Repolarised Augurs
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged RECON AUGURY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has -3" detection range until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Clandestine Reposition
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged INFILTRATORS/PTERAXII unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Lords of the Forge.rule:
Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have:
4+ InSv.
Feel No Pain 5+.
Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have the following ability:
Baffling Data Screed: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can use this ability. If you do, roll one D6:
On a 2+, select one enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. A unit cannot be selected for this ability more than once per turn.
Or: On 2+, those ranged attacks do not prevent this unit from being hidden.

stratagems.name: Scriptural Prognosis
stratagems.when: In your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.target: That TECH-PRIEST unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Overloaded Safeguards
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That TECH-PRIEST unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Holy Avarice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit starts an action.
stratagems.target: That TECH-PRIEST unit.
stratagems.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Luminen Auto-Choir.rule:
Friendly CORPUSCARII units' ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
When a friendly FULGURITE unit has fought, that unit heals D3 wounds.
This detachment has the DATA-PSALM tag and cannot be taken with another DATA-PSALM detachment.

stratagems.name: Echoes of the Conduit Wars
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks that target a unit within range of an objective can: Re-roll hit rolls of 1. Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Chant of Electrotraction
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ELECTRO-PRIESTS BATTLECLADE unit is selected to make an advance move.
stratagems.target: That ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Momentum Feedback
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

_armyRule.name: Doctrina Imperatives
_armyRule.rule: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Doctrina Imperatives below. Until the end of the battle round, that Doctrina Imperative is active for your army, and all units from your army that have the Doctrina Imperatives ability gain the relevant abilities shown below.

parts.name: Protector Imperative
parts.desc:
- Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [HEAVY] ability.
- Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
- Each time a melee attack targets this unit, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

parts.name: Conqueror Imperative
parts.desc:
- Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
- Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
- Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Universal Anathema
enhancements.desc: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] abilities

enhancements.name: Blackweave Shroud
enhancements.desc: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.desc: Watch Master model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Amulet of Auto-chastisement
enhancements.desc: Watch Master model only. At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

enhancements.name: Liber Heresius
enhancements.desc: Ministorum Priest or Inquisitor model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to 3 AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: No Escape
enhancements.desc: Inquisitor model only. While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time it is selected to Fall Back it must first take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

enhancements.name: Witch Hunter
enhancements.desc: Ministorum Priest or Inquisitor model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets a PSYKER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Ignis Judicium
enhancements.desc: Ministorum Priest or Inquisitor model only. The bearer's ranged weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS], [MELTA 1] and [PRECISION] abilities.

enhancements.name: Formidable Resolve
enhancements.desc: Inquisitor model only. Improve the bearer's Leadership and Wounds characteristics by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly Battle-shocked unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Daemon Slayer
enhancements.desc: Inquisitor model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons, and those weapons have the **[ANTI-DAEMON 3+]** ability.

enhancements.name: Grimoire of True Names

_armyRule.name: Assigned Agents
_armyRule.rule:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, you select one of the Agents of the Imperium Detachments in the Select Detachment Rules step as normal.

If your Army Faction is something else but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can still include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units, up to a limit set by the battle size:
- Incursion: 1 Retinue unit, 1 Character unit and 1 Requisitioned unit.
- Strike Force: 2 Retinue units, 2 Character units and 1 Requisitioned unit.
- Onslaught: 3 Retinue units, 3 Character units and 2 Requisitioned units.

AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units can be included in such an army as normal, but each one must start the battle with one or more units embarked in it, or it cannot be deployed and counts as destroyed during the first battle round.

parts.name: Kill Team
parts.desc:
Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value.

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a TRANSPORT, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the TERMINATOR, MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.
