Alien Hunters (Ordo Xenos).rule:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one Mission Tactic. Until the start of your next Command phase it is active for all DEATHWATCH units from your army. Each can only be selected once per battle:
- Furor Tactics: weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
- Malleus Tactics: weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
- Purgatus Tactics: each time a DEATHWATCH model makes an attack, on a Critical Wound that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Tactics
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select Furor, Malleus or Purgatus Tactics. Until the start of your next Command phase that Mission Tactic is active for your unit instead of any other active for your army, even if already selected this battle.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities. Cannot combine with Kraken or Dragonfire Rounds this phase.

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities. Cannot combine with Kraken or Hellfire Rounds this phase.

mathBuff.note: Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER] (and [ASSAULT]).

stratagems.name: Kraken Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve their Range characteristic by 6". Cannot combine with Dragonfire or Hellfire Rounds this phase.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP on ranged weapons (also +6" Range).

stratagems.name: Rapid Tactical Relocation
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR or DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army (not within Engagement Range of any enemy units).
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield. In your next Movement phase Reinforcements step, set it up anywhere more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy models.

Daemon Hunters (Ordo Malleus).rule: Each time an INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and, if the target is a DAEMON unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Ritual of Warding
stratagems.when: Start of any Command phase.
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker is Warded and remains under your control even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While Warded and under your control, enemy DAEMON units cannot be set up within 6" of it.

stratagems.name: Rites of Exorcism
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy DAEMON unit within 12" and visible to your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test. If failed, until the end of the phase each time a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit makes an attack that targets that DAEMON unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

mathBuff.note: Attacks gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS], but only vs the targeted DAEMON unit (and only if it failed its Battle-shock test).

stratagems.name: Steel Heart
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Hexagrammic Wards
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.name: Psybolt Ammunition
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC] abilities.

Imperialis Fleet.rule:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the following to apply:
- Eliminate At All Costs: Select one enemy unit. Until your next Command phase, each time an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
- Acquire At All Costs: Select one objective marker. Until your next Command phase, while an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit is within range of it, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1 and they have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Violent Acquisition
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LANCE] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

mathBuff.note: [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [IGNORES COVER] and [LANCE], but only vs an enemy unit within range of an objective marker.

stratagems.name: Masters of the Void
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One VOIDFARERS CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit arriving from Strategic Reserves this turn can be set up within your opponent's deployment zone (all other restrictions still apply).

stratagems.name: Close-Quarters Barrage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One VOIDFARERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 Strength and +1 AP, but only vs targets within 12".

stratagems.name: Emperor's Will
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Displacer Field
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save and, after the attacking unit resolves its attacks, unless within Engagement Range of an enemy unit, your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" (moving as if it has Fly).

stratagems.name: Selfless Bodyguard
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM Attached unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack with the [PRECISION] ability is allocated to a CHARACTER model in your unit, if there are one or more Bodyguard models in your unit, roll one D6: on a 2+, that attack is allocated to a Bodyguard model of your choice instead.

Purgation Force (Ordo Hereticus).rule:
Ranged weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS and ORDO HERETICUS models from your army have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Each time an ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS model from your army makes an attack that targets a CHAOS unit containing 5 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Stun Grenades
stratagems.when: Start of any phase (excluding the Command phase).
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS or VEHICLES) within 8" of and visible to your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in it makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Dispense Justice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

mathBuff.note: Weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Inviolate Jurisdiction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army within range of an objective marker that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: Execution Order
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy CHARACTER unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit targets that CHARACTER unit, its weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Line of Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of friendly units with ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons), provided the target is within 12".

stratagems.name: Exact Punishment
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army is destroyed as the result of an enemy unit's attacks.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that was within 6" of the destroyed unit.
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

Veiled Blade Elimination Force.rule:
When pursuing an extremis-level target, the agents of the Officio Assassinorum are expected to push their altered minds and bodies beyond the limits of endurance. Additional equipment, augmentation and ammunition may be provided to complete the task.
Officio Assassinorum units from your army can use the Overkill, Soulless Horror and Shieldbreaker abilities twice per battle, instead of once per battle (but cannot use such an ability more than once in the same battle round).
When mustering your army, each Officio Assassinorum unit from your army has the relevant Extremis ability shown on the right, and you must increase the points cost of each of those units by the amount shown. If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.

stratagems.name: Prime Target
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Agents of the Imperium unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a Character unit, reroll a Wound roll of 1. If that attack is made by an Officio Assassinorum model and it targets the enemy Warlord, you can reroll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Hyperstimms
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Agents of the Imperium Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, if it is an Eversor Assassin unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

stratagems.name: Will-sapping Salvo
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Agents of the Imperium Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, if it is a Culexus Assassin unit, until the end of the phase, change the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit to 3.

stratagems.name: Orbital Oversight
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Agents of the Imperium Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18", or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6".

stratagems.name: Blind Grenades
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One Agents of the Imperium Grenades or Vindicare Assassin unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit, or, if your unit is a Vindicare Assassin, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit instead.

stratagems.name: Ensnaring Trap
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Agents of the Imperium Infantry unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select one or more of those enemy units as the targets of that charge. In addition, if it is a Callidus Assassin unit and it makes a Charge move as a result of this Stratagem, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

extremis.name: Decoy Targets
extremis.desc: CALLIDUS ASSASSIN models only. Twice per battle, in your Movement phase, you can select one other friendly INFANTRY model that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. The selected model is destroyed (ignoring any rules that are triggered when a model is destroyed) and this model is removed from the battlefield and set up again as close as possible to where that destroyed model was and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. This ability cannot be used more than once in the same battle round.

extremis.name: Esoteric Explosives
extremis.desc: CULEXUS ASSASSIN models only. Each time this model is targeted with the Explosives Stratagem, 1 mortal wound is inflicted for each D6 roll of 3+ instead of for each 4+.

extremis.name: Intraneural Biotech
extremis.desc:
EVERSOR ASSASSIN models only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

extremis.name: Micromelta Rounds
extremis.desc: VINDICARE ASSASSIN models only. This model's exitus rifle has the [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Malevolent Heraldry
enhancements.desc: Each time you roll dice to randomly select which Dread abilities are active for your army, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one or both results rolled.

enhancements.name: Veil of Medrengard
enhancements.desc: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.

enhancements.name: Tyrant's Shadow
enhancements.desc: At the end of your Command phase, select one objective marker the bearer is in range of and that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Deathly Terror ability as if it were a ^^**Chaos Knights^^** model from your army.

enhancements.name: Nightmare's Master
enhancements.desc: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Warp-borne Stalker
enhancements.desc: The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Blade of Celerity
enhancements.desc: The bearer's ranged weapons have the [Assault] ability. In addition, once per battle, in the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Putrid Carapace
enhancements.desc: The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, once per battle, at the start of either player's Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Mirror of Fates
enhancements.desc: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
enhancements.desc: The bearer has the Stealth ability. In addition, once per battle, after you make a saving throw for the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
enhancements.desc: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. In addition, once per battle, in your Charge phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Loping Predator
enhancements.desc: WAR DOG model only. The bearer's ranged weapons have the [Assault] ability.

enhancements.name: Final Howl (Aura)
enhancements.desc: WAR DOG model only. While a friendly ^^**War Dog^^** model is within 6" of the bearer, each time that model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knights
enhancements.desc: WAR DOG model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer's Mantle
enhancements.desc: WAR DOG model only. The bearer has the Super-Heavy Walker ability.

enhancements.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
enhancements.desc: Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness characteristic. While the bearer is using the Unnatural Fortitude ability, each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to the bearer, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

enhancements.name: Blasphemous Engine
enhancements.desc: Add 2 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Malefic Surge, you can re-roll the Leadership test taken to see if it suffers any mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Bestial Aspect
enhancements.desc: The bearer's ranged weapons have the [Assault] ability. While the bearer is using the Unholy Hunger ability, it can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to Advance rolls made for its unit.

enhancements.name: Knight Diabolus
enhancements.desc: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons by 1. While the bearer is using the Diabolic Power ability, its melee weapons have the [Lance] ability.

enhancements.name: Pterrorshade Rookery
enhancements.desc: KNIGHT TYRANT model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Hate-filled Dominion
enhancements.desc: KNIGHT TYRANT model only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

enhancements.name: Soul-spoor Auspicator
enhancements.desc: HUNTSMAN unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have +6" R.

enhancements.name: Snarling Rivalry
enhancements.desc: EXECUTIONER unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

enhancements.name: Cruel Lashmaster (Aura)
enhancements.desc: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6" of this model, when that unit is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, that unit has +2" M until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Iconoclast Idol (Aura)

detData._format: ruleName + rule + stratagems [{name,type,cp,when,target,effect,mathBuff?}]. mathBuff scope: 'ranged'|'melee'|'all'. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Houndpack Lance.rule:
At the start of your Command phase, select one enemy unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a WAR DOG model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if it is visible, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

KEYWORDS: Your army must include three or more WAR DOG units; WAR DOG units gain the BATTLELINE keyword; select three WAR DOG units to gain the CHARACTER keyword (can take Enhancements / be WARLORD).

stratagems.name: Vox-Howl
stratagems.when: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WAR DOG CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each friendly WAR DOG unit within 6" that is Battle-shocked takes a Leadership test; if passed, it is no longer Battle-shocked. Once per turn.

stratagems.name: Hungry for Combat
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two or more WAR DOG units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those units. Until the end of the phase, those units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in them makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Cunning Hunter
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a WAR DOG unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Animalistic Rage
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a WAR DOG unit from your army that has not been selected to attack this phase is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Before resolving Deadly Demise, your unit can shoot or fight, targeting only the enemy unit that destroyed it. Then resolve Deadly Demise as normal.

stratagems.name: Harrying Hounds
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One WAR DOG unit from your army within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Encircling Pack
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WAR DOG unit from your army wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Infernal Lance.rule:
In your Command phase, one or more CHAOS KNIGHTS units can make a Malefic Surge. Each takes a Leadership test first; if failed, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then it is Empowered until your next Command phase and can use one Malefic Surge ability (after which it is no longer Empowered):
- Unholy Hunger: +3" Move on a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move.
- Diabolic Power: when selected to shoot or fight, weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (your choice).
- Unnatural Fortitude: When this unit is selected as the target of an attack, select one of the following to apply until the end of the phase: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.name: Profane Symbiosis
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is not Empowered.
stratagems.effect: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge. Cannot select the same unit more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Hellforged Construction
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Corrupting Taint
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. It remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Unleash Balefire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: After your unit shoots, select one enemy unit hit. It takes a Battle-shock test; if failed, until the end of your opponent's next turn it is aflame (−2" Move and −2 to Charge rolls).

stratagems.name: Warp Vision
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

mathBuff.note: Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Diabolic Bulwark
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Lords of Dread.rule: Improve the Objective Control characteristic of CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER models from your army by 2. In addition, once per battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.

stratagems.name: Claimed for the Dark Gods
stratagems.when: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. It remains under your control with a Level of Control of 5 (unless higher) until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Spiteful Demise
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: When rolling for your unit's Deadly Demise ability, it inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+ instead of 6.

stratagems.name: Runes of Disdain
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit attacks that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1. If that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll instead.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hits/Wounds of 1 vs a chosen MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Set to full re-rolls if that target is TITANIC.

stratagems.name: Trophy Hunter
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army consolidates.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Crushed Like Vermin
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army ends a Normal move.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) your unit moved over and roll six D6: for each 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed, that unit takes a Battle-shock test.

Traitoris Lance.rule: At the start of the first battle round, after selecting one or more Dread abilities to be active for your army, you can select one additional Dread ability to be active for your army (this additional Dread ability cannot be randomly selected).

stratagems.name: Pterrorshades
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound. Once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Conquerors Without Mercy
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After it fights, if it destroyed one or more enemy units, each enemy unit within 6" must take a Battle-shock test.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP melee (model must have charged this turn).

stratagems.name: Disdain for the Weak
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.

stratagems.name: A Long Leash
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ABHORRENT unit from your army and up to two friendly WAR DOG units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.

stratagems.name: Imperious Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two WAR DOG units from your army or one TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).

stratagems.name: Storm of Darkness
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Stealth. Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Rune-cursed Stronghold

stratagems.target: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Focus

stratagems.name: Intimidating Reminder

stratagems.name: Insensate Bloodthirst

stratagems.name: Leash of the Masters

stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an Action.

stratagems.name: Stalking Focus
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit within range of an objective.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.rule:
You can include DAMNED units in your army (see Codex: Chaos Space Marines). The combined points cost of such units cannot exceed 500 points.
Friendly DAMNED units can re-roll Leadership rolls.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Masters!
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle. Friendly DAMNED units' attacks that target a marked unit have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Dark Sacrifice
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS units) within 9" of a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS model.
stratagems.effect: Select one CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" of your unit and roll D3+3: Your DAMNED unit suffers that number of mortal wounds. That CHAOS KNIGHTS model heals that number of wounds.

stratagems.name: Coursing Thralls
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DAMNED unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit is hunted: While a unit is hunted, that unit has +6" detection range.

Helhunt Lance.rule: If a TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army has an Aura ability that affects friendly WAR DOG units, while two or more friendly WAR DOG models are within range of that TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit's Aura ability, that TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is affected by that Aura ability as well.

stratagems.name: Feral Arrogance
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Merciless Fusillade
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army, and up to two friendly WAR DOG units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those Chaos Knights units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Beasthide Manifestation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Flush the Quarry
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army and up to three friendly WAR DOG units within 6" of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: Contemptuous Volleys
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Chaos Knights unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Goaded Beast
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

_armyRule.name: Harbingers of Dread
_armyRule.rule:
Where Chaos Knights tread, the skies grow unnaturally dark and the power of the warp permeates the battlefield.

If your Army Faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, each unit from your army with this ability gains the Dread abilities that are active for your army (below). Deathly Terror is active from the start of the battle. In addition, at the start of the first, third and fifth battle rounds, you can either select one of the other Dread abilities or randomly select two (roll two D6 and apply the results rolled, from those numbered 1-6).

Selected Dread abilities remain active until the end of the battle. You cannot select the same Dread ability more than once, and any duplicates (from random selection) have no additional effect.

parts.name: Deathly Terror (Aura)
parts.desc: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.

parts.name: Despair (Aura)
parts.desc: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. This is cumulative with Deathly Terror.

parts.name: Doom
parts.desc: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target of that attack is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Doom — +1 to Wound vs Battle-shocked targets

parts.name: Darkness
parts.desc: This model has Stealth.

parts.name: Dismay (Aura)
parts.desc: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 9" of this model, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

parts.name: Delirium (Aura)
parts.desc: While an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength is within 9" of this model, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

parts.name: Dominion
parts.desc: Add 3" to the range of this model's Aura abilities.

parts.name: Dreadblades
parts.desc: If every model in your army has the CHAOS keyword, you can include either 1 TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model or up to 3 WAR DOG models in your army, even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected. None of these models can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

parts.name: Super-heavy Walker
parts.desc:
Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:
- It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
- It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Alien Cunning
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three **^^Tyranids^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Perfectly Adapted
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll, one Damage roll, one Advance roll, one Charge roll or one saving throw made for the bearer

enhancements.name: Synaptic Linchpin
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit is within 9" of the bearer, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Biology
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. At the start of any turn, if the bearer has fewer than its starting number of wounds remaining, until the end of the battle, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

enhancements.name: Instinctive Defense
enhancements.desc: TYRANIDS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, when you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP. In addition, while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Parasitic Biomorphology
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit. The first time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase while the bearer is within 6" of one or more **^^Harvester^^** units, until the end of battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only (excluding **^^Monsters^^** models) The bearer's unit can be regenerated up to twice per phase, instead of once.

enhancements.name: Biophagic Flow (Aura)
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Harvester^^** model is within 12" of the bearer, when using the Feed the Swarm ability, that **^^Harvester^^** model can Regenerate one friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit that is within 9" instead of one within 6".

enhancements.name: Monstrous Nemesis
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a **^^Monster^^**or **^^Vehicle^^**unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Null Nodules
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Once per battle, when a Psychic Attack is allocated to the bearer, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.name: Ominous Presence
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Enraged Reserves
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. If the bearer is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. It can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Psychostatic Disruption
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Synapse^^** model only. Enemy units that arrive on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up with 12" of the bearer. In addition, once per battle, during the first or second battle round, when your opponent declares that a unit will arrive on the battlefield from Strategic Reserves, the bearer can use this enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy cannot arrive on the battlefield this turn.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Control
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Synapse^^** model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the attack.

enhancements.name: The Dirgeheart of Kharis (Aura)
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Synapse^^** model only. While an enemy unit is within 9" of the bearer, worsen that unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.

enhancements.name: Power of the Hive Mind
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Psyker^^** model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of psychic weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Naturalised Camoflage
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. At the start of the first battle round, select up to three friendly **^^Endless Multitude^^** units within 9" of the bearer. Until the end of the battle round, each time a ranged attack targets one of those units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Piercing Talons
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Each time a model in the Bearer's unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Relentless Hunger
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Adrenalised Onslaught
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Pile In or Consolidation, models in this unit can move an additional 3"

enhancements.name: Hunting Grounds
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your opponent sets up a Reserves unit on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 2+ that unit must make a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.desc: TYRANIDS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to three VANGUARD INVADER units from your army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Stalker
enhancements.desc: **^^Vanguard Invader^^** model only. At the start of the battle, select one enemy unit. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Chameleonic
enhancements.desc: VANGUARD INVADER model only. This unit has Stealth.

enhancements.name: Predatory Instincts
enhancements.desc: **^^Abominant^^**, **^^Biophagus^^** or **^^Patriarch^^** model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Infiltrators ability and, once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.name: Biomorph Adaption
enhancements.desc: **^^Abominant ^^** or **^^Patriarch^^** model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Mutagenic Regeneration

enhancements.name: Alien Majesty
enhancements.desc: **^^Abominant^^**, **^^Biophagus^^** or **^^Patriarch^^** model only. While an enemy unit is in within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit (to a minimum of 1).

Once Per turn, when a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** or **^^Astra Militarum Mounted^^**unit within 9" of the bearer is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Reprisal
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults Infantry^^** model only. Once per turn, you can target a friendly **^^Genestealer Cults^^** unit within 8" of the bearer with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: The Hero Returned
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults Infantry^^** model only. Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer's unit by 1

enhancements.name: Synaptic Auger
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Each time the bearer would regain one or more lost wounds from the Psionic Parasitism Detachment rule, it regains up to twice that number of lost wounds instead.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Tyrant
enhancements.desc: **^^Winged Hive Tyrant^^** model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Inhuman Integration
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. Weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability while targeting an enemy unit within 6" of one or more friendly **^^Tyranids^^**units.

enhancements.name: Enraptured Damnation
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Our Time is Nigh

enhancements.name: A Chink in Their Armour

enhancements.name: Prowling Agitant

enhancements.name: Serpentine Tactics
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults Mounted^^** model only. The bearer's unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Cartographic Data-leech

While the bearer is embarked within a **^^Transport^^**, each time that **^^Transport^^** is selected to shoot, until end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by that **^^Transport^^** as a result of the Firing Deck ability by 1.

enhancements.name: Starfall Shells

enhancements.name: Denunciator of Tyrants

enhancements.name: Hypersurge Gland

enhancements.name: Primary Detonator

enhancements.name: Miasmic Fumes
enhancements.desc: **^^Biophagus^^** model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Psi-spoor Sensitivity
enhancements.desc: Each time the bearer declares a charge, it can target enemy units that are not visible to it.

enhancements.name: Stalking Menace
enhancements.desc: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
