detData._format: ruleName + rule + stratagems [{name,type,cp,when,target,effect,mathBuff?}]. mathBuff scope: 'ranged'|'melee'|'all'. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Invasion Fleet.rule:
At the start of the first battle round, select one Hyper-adaptation to be active for TYRANIDS units until the end of the battle:
- Swarming Instincts: attacks vs INFANTRY or SWARM units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- Hyper-aggression: attacks vs MONSTER or VEHICLE units have [LETHAL HITS].
- Hive Predators: attacks vs CHARACTER units have [PRECISION] on a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Rapid Regeneration
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, Feel No Pain 5+ instead.

stratagems.name: Adrenal Surge
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units within Synapse Range that are eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in any of those units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Death Frenzy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it; it fights after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Overrun
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That TYRANIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models can move an additional 3" to end within Engagement Range. If within Synapse Range and not within Engagement Range, it can instead make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Predatory Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units within Synapse Range, or one other TYRANIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one Hyper-adaptation (not the one chosen at the start of the battle). Until your next Command phase, it is active for those units in addition to any other.

stratagems.name: Endless Swarm
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two ENDLESS MULTITUDE units within Synapse Range, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.
stratagems.effect: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each selected unit.

Crusher Stampede.rule: Each time a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model's unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model's unit is Below Half-strength. In addition, while a TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) is at its Starting Strength, add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Corrosive Viscera
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army with Deadly Demise that cannot FLY is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll for Deadly Demise; instead mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

stratagems.name: Rampaging Monstrosities
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit re-roll (MONSTER unit).

stratagems.name: Savage Roar
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in it attacks your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If the test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Untrammelled Ferocity
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so: It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them. It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Swarm-Guided Salvoes
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and you can ignore any or all modifiers to Ballistic Skill and to the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: [IGNORES COVER] on ranged weapons (also ignore Hit/BS modifiers). MONSTER unit.

stratagems.name: Massive Impact
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range and roll six D6: for each 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Unending Swarm.rule: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model from a friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit was destroyed as a result of those attacks, that friendly unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Synaptic Goading
stratagems.when: Any phase, just before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move.
stratagems.target: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.
stratagems.effect: When making that surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit). All other rules for making surge moves still apply.

stratagems.name: Unending Waves
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit identical to the destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength. Attached CHARACTERs are not returned. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Teeming Masses
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Swarming Masses
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and if your unit contains 15 or more models, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

mathBuff.note: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; also Critical Hits on 5+ if the unit has 15+ models.

stratagems.name: Bounding Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Preservation Imperative
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.

Assimilation Swarm.rule:
In your Command phase, each HARVESTER unit from your army can Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit that is within 6" of it. A unit can only be regenerated once per phase. Each time a unit regenerates, do one of the following:
- One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
- One destroyed INFANTRY model (excluding CHARACTERS) is returned to that unit with its full wounds remaining. If that unit is an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit, up to 3 destroyed models are returned instead.

stratagems.name: Broodguard Impulse
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Reclaim Biomass
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model is removed.
stratagems.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army within 6" of that destroyed unit.
stratagems.effect: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (see Feed the Swarm).

stratagems.name: Tyrannoformed
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.name: Ablative Carapace
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability, or Feel No Pain 4+ if within range of an objective marker you control.

stratagems.name: Secure Biomass
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a HARVESTER unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ also scores a Critical Hit.

mathBuff.note: Melee [LETHAL HITS]; HARVESTER units also get Critical Hits on 5+.

stratagems.name: Rapacious Hunger
stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit immediately Regenerates (see Feed the Swarm). If it is a HARVESTER unit and you choose the wounds option, a model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead of D3.

Vanguard Onslaught.rule:
TYRANIDS units with this ability are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Fell Back. VANGUARD INVADER units with this ability are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Advanced.

Vanguard Prime: DEATHLEAPER loses the Hunter Organism rule and can be your WARLORD.

stratagems.name: Surprise Assault
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: That VANGUARD INVADER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit targeted by your unit's attacks. It takes a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit attacks that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll; if the test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

mathBuff.note: +1 Hit vs the selected enemy unit; +1 Wound too if that unit failed its Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Assassin Beasts
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One VANGUARD INVADER INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Seeded Broods
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit in Reserves, or up to two VANGUARD INVADER units in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, for setting up those units, treat the current battle round number as one higher than it is.

stratagems.name: Hypersensory Scillia
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units within 8" of that enemy unit, or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit within 8".
stratagems.effect: Those units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Unseen Lurkers
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" (or 6" if your unit has Lone Operative).

stratagems.name: Invisible Hunter
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit (more than 3" from all enemy units).
stratagems.effect: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Synaptic Nexus.rule:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one Synaptic Imperative (each once per battle). Until the end of the round it is active for your army; a TYRANIDS unit within Synapse Range benefits:
- Synaptic Augmentation: 5+ invulnerable save.
- Surging Vitality: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.
- Goaded to Slaughter: +1 to the Hit roll for melee attacks.

stratagems.name: The Smothering Shadow
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Channelling
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

stratagems.name: Irresistible Will
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model attacks that enemy unit, if the attacking model's unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hits/Wounds of 1 vs the chosen enemy unit, only while within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit.

stratagems.name: Reinforced Hive Node
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Imperative Dominance
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army within Synapse Range of your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one Synaptic Imperative (even if already selected this battle). Until your next Command phase it is active for your unit instead of any other.

stratagems.name: Override Instincts
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit within Synapse Range that made a Fall Back move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.

Ambush Predators.rule:
Friendly DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR units have Deep Strike.
Friendly LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR units' attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Counterpredation
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR / VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Hypersensory Adaptations
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR / VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.name: Scanner Gheist
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves.

Talons of the Norn Queen.rule: Friendly NORN EMISSARY / NORN ASSIMILATOR units have: Protean Purpose: (Once per battle, per unit) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit can make a new selection for its Singular Purpose ability (this replaces the previous selection).

stratagems.name: Catalytic Biofortification
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Lesser Prey
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR / NORN EMISSARY unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have +2 S.

stratagems.name: Tanglestrike Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is tethered until the start of your next Command phase. While a unit is tethered, that unit has -2" M.

Warrior Bioform Onslaught.rule:
Friendly TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS / TYRANID WARRIORS WITH MELEE BIO-WEAPONS units gain the TYRANID WARRIORS and BATTLELINE keywords.
TYRANID WARRIORS / TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP / WINGED TYRANID PRIME models from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Alien Physiology
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.target: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Micronodes
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Parasitic Payload
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Subterranean Assault.rule:
Each time a TYRANIDS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
Each time a BURROWER unit from your army is set up from Reserves, place a 40mm Tunnel Marker within 1" of it and more than 3" horizontally from all enemy units. In the Reinforcements step, you can set up a unit from Reserves wholly within 9" of one of your Tunnel Markers and more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends a move within 3" of one of your Tunnel Markers, remove that marker.
KEYWORDS: MAWLOC and TRYGON units gain the BURROWER keyword. In the Muster Armies step you can select up to 2 TRYGON models; the selected units gain the CHARACTER keyword (can take Enhancements / be Warlord).

stratagems.name: Adaptive Optimisation
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One MAWLOC or TRYGON unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the SYNAPSE keyword.

stratagems.name: Replenishing Swarms
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.
stratagems.effect: One model regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or return up to D3+1 destroyed 1-wound models to the unit instead.

stratagems.name: Enfilading Emergence
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit set up as Reinforcements this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Tunnel Network
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit wholly within 9" of one of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove and set up your unit again wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed and more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Swarming Assault
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit set up as Reinforcements this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Retreat Below
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit or up to two BURROWER units not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

_armyRule.name: Synapse
_armyRule.rule:
Some Tyranids serve as synaptic conduits through which the Hive Mind's iron will flows, overriding the swarm's instincts to make it function as a single gestalt organism.

If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, while a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly SYNAPSE models, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army. While within Synapse Range:
• Each time that unit takes a Battle-shock test, take that test on 3D6 instead of 2D6.
• Each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

parts.name: Synapse (within range)
parts.desc: While within Synapse Range, melee attacks made by models in the unit gain +1 Strength, and the unit takes Battle-shock tests on 3D6 instead of 2D6.

mathBuff.note: Within Synapse Range — +1 Strength (melee)

parts.name: Shadow in the Warp
parts.desc: Once per battle, in either player's Command phase, if one or more units from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can unleash the Shadow in the Warp: each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test, and each time an enemy unit within 6" of one or more of your SYNAPSE units takes that test, subtract 1 from it.

enhancements.name: Exemplar of the Kauyon
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only (excluding **^^Kroot Shaper^^** models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter Detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round onwards instead of the third.

enhancements.name: Precision of the Patient Hunter
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. From the third battle round onwards, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Solid-image Projection Unit
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three **^^T’au Empire^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Through Unity, Devastation
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only (excluding **^^Kroot Shaper^^** models). While this model is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

enhancements.name: Exemplar of the Mont'ka
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only (excluding **^^Kroot Shaper^^** models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow Detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well.

enhancements.name: Strike Swiftly
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, you can select up to two friendly **^^T’au Empire^^** units within 6" of the bearer that do not have the Scouts ability. Until the end of the battle, all models in the selected units have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Strategic Conqueror
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only. At the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, select one objective marker on the battlefield. While a friendly **^^T’au Empire^^** model is within range of that objective marker and the bearer is on the battlefield, add 1 to that friendly model's Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Coordinated Exploitation
enhancements.desc: **^^T’au Empire^^** model only (excluding **^^Kroot Shaper^^** models). While this model is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

enhancements.name: Starflare Ignition System
enhancements.desc: Battlesuit model only. **^^T’au Empire Battlesuit^^** model only. At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Prototype Weapon System
enhancements.desc: Battlesuit model only. **^^T’au Empire Battlesuit^^** model only. Each time the bearer is select to shoot, select either the **[LETHAL HITS]** or **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability. Until those attacks are resolved, ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the select ability.

enhancements.name: Internal Grenade Racks
enhancements.desc: Battlesuit model only. **^^T’au Empire Battlesuit^^** model only. The bearer has the **^^Grenades^^** keyword, and each time the bearer ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit that it moved over during that move. If you do, roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
enhancements.desc: Battlesuit model only. **^^T’au Empire Battlesuit^^** model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Nomadic Hunter
enhancements.desc: **^^Kroot Trail Shaper^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and ranged weapons equipped by the models in that unit have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

enhancements.name: Borthrod Gland
enhancements.desc: Flesh Shaper or Kroot model only. **^^Kroot Flesh Shaper^^** only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Root-carved Weapons
enhancements.desc: **^^Kroot War Shaper^^** model only. All weapons equipped by the bearer have the **[PRECISION]** and **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** abilities.

enhancements.name: Kroothawk Flock
enhancements.desc: **^^Kroot^^** model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability, and enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Quill Marker
enhancements.desc: At the start of your Charge phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time a **^^Kroot^^** unit from your army declares a charge, if it is within 6" of that enemy unit, it can include that enemy unit as a target of that charge, even if it is not visible to it.

enhancements.name: Experienced Leader
enhancements.desc: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle, each time a **^^Kroot^^** model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Target Optimisation Microdrones
enhancements.desc: **^^Cadre Fireblade^^** model only. Once per turn, in your Shooting phase, when a friendly **^^Fire Warrior^^**, **^^Pathfinder Team^^** or **^^Cadre Fireblade^^** unit within 6" of the bearer is selected to shoot, the bearer use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Duty's Echo
enhancements.desc: **^^Ethereal^^** model only. At the end of your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly **^^Fire Warrior^^** or **^^Pathfinder Team^^** unit within 6" of the bearer. If you do, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 3" and then counts as having performed the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre this turn.

enhancements.name: Negation Emitters
enhancements.desc: STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Unmasking Suite
enhancements.desc: GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT / PATHFINDER TEAM / STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only. When this unit is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 24". That enemy unit has +9" detection range until this unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Student of Kauyon
enhancements.desc: KROOT SHAPER model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select up to three friendly KROOT CARNIVORES / FARSTALKERS units. Those units have Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: Admired Leader
enhancements.desc: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT). In your Command phase, select one KROOT / VESPID STINGWINGS unit within 12". That unit has +1 Ld and +1 OC until your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Thermoneutronic Projector
enhancements.desc: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model's T'au flamer weapons. That weapon's attacks have +2 S and +1 AP and D.

enhancements.name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
enhancements.desc: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model's plasma rifle weapons. That weapon's attacks have +2 S and +1 A, AP and D.

enhancements.name: Supernova Launcher
enhancements.desc: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model's airbursting fragmentation projector weapons. That weapon's attacks have +3 S and +1 AP and D.

abilities.name: Agile Combatant
abilities.desc: This model is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

abilities.name: Hero of the Empire (Aura)
abilities.desc: While a friendly **^^T’au Empire^^** unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

abilities.name: Advanced Guardian Drone
abilities.desc: Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Command-link Drone (Aura)
abilities.desc: While a friendly **^^T’au Empire^^** unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time you select that unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Supreme Commander
abilities.desc: If this model is in your army, it must be your **^^Warlord^^**.

abilities.name: Way of the Short Blade
abilities.desc: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Puretide's Teachings
abilities.desc: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc:
This model can be attached to the following units:
- **^^Crisis Sunforge Battlesuits^^**
- **^^Crisis Fireknife Battlesuits^^**
- **^^Crisis Starscythe Battlesuits^^**

abilities.name: Enforcer Commander
abilities.desc: While this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc:
This model can be attached to the following units:
- **^^Crisis Sunforge Battlesuits^^**
- **^^Crisis Fireknife Battlesuits^^**
- **^^Crisis Starscythe Battlesuits^^**

options.name: Battlesuit support system
options.ability: The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back, but when doing so only models equipped with this wargear can make ranged attacks.

options.name: Shield generator
options.ability: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

options.name: Weapon support system
options.ability: Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

options.name: Marker Drone
options.ability: The bearer’s unit has the **^^Markerlight^^** keyword and can act as an Observer unit for another unit even if it Advanced this turn.

options.name: Shield Drone
options.ability: Add 1 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc:
This model can be attached to the following units:
- **^^Crisis Sunforge Battlesuits^^**
- **^^Crisis Fireknife Battlesuits^^**
- **^^Crisis Starscythe Battlesuits^^**

abilities.name: Coldstar Commander

Kauyon.rule: During the third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T'AU EMPIRE models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. During the third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit (see For the Greater Good), each time a ranged attack is made by a model in that unit that targets a Spotted unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic skill characteristics and/or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: A Tempting Trap
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase (not battle rounds 1-2).
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. The first time, also select an objective marker not in your opponent's deployment zone — this becomes your Trap objective marker for the battle.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Trap objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound vs enemies within range of your Trap objective marker. Battle rounds 3-5 only.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Ambush
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase (not battle rounds 1-2).
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP vs targets within 9". Battle rounds 3-5 only.

stratagems.name: Coordinate to Engage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has just been selected as an Observer unit (For the Greater Good).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets their Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if your unit has the MARKERLIGHT keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

mathBuff.note: +1 to Hit (improved BS) vs your Spotted unit; MARKERLIGHT units also ignore cover.

stratagems.name: Combat Embarkation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge, and one friendly TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT (every model within 3", sufficient capacity); your opponent can select new charge targets.

stratagems.name: Photon Grenades
stratagems.when: Your opponent's charge phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its charge target.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE GRENADES unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and until the end of the phase subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: Wall of Mirrors
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One STEALTH, GHOSTKEEL or COMMANDER SHADOWSUN unit from your army (not within Engagement Range of enemy units).
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Mont'ka.rule: During the first, second and third battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T'AU EMPIRE models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability. During the first, second and third battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit (see For the Greater Good), its ranged weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Pinpoint Counter-Offensive
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a T'AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT) from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Hit re-roll vs the enemy unit that destroyed one of your units (battle-long).

stratagems.name: Aggressive Mobility
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Focused Fire
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase (not battle rounds 4-5).
stratagems.target: Two T'AU EMPIRE units from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase, and one enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either unit makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 AP, but both units must focus the single chosen enemy unit. Battle rounds 1-3 only.

stratagems.name: Combat Debarkation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Full Wound re-roll vs the closest enemy unit. Unit must have disembarked this turn.

stratagems.name: Pulse Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit (excluding KROOT) from your army that has just shot, and one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, that enemy unit is shaken (−2" Move, −2 to Advance and Charge rolls).

stratagems.name: Counterfire Defence Systems

stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Retaliation Cadre.rule: Each time a T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1. If that attack targets a unit within 8", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Fail-Safe Detonator
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That destroyed model's unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even if it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: If the model has Deadly Demise, do not roll — choose whether the result is 1 or 6. If it does not, roll one D6 for each unit within 6": on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Stimm Injectors

stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.name: The Shortened Blade
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models. It is not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: The Arro'kon Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, attacks targeting an enemy unit with 6+ models have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; vs an enemy unit with 11+ models they have [SUSTAINED HITS 2] instead.

mathBuff.note: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs 6+ model units; set to Sustained Hits 2 vs 11+ model units.

stratagems.name: The Torchstar Gambit
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that can FLY whose attacks have been resolved this phase.
stratagems.effect: If not within Engagement Range of enemy units, your unit can make a Normal move. If it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Grav-Inhibitor Field
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and roll one D6 per model in it: for each 6, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Kroot Hunting Pack.rule:
Each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if the target is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if the target is Below Half-strength.

Skirmish Fighters: KROOT models have a 6+ invulnerable save against melee attacks and a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

KEYWORDS: KROOT CARNIVORE units gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

stratagems.name: Join the Hunt

stratagems.effect: Add a new unit identical to the destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength. Cannot return CHARACTERs to Attached units. Once per battle.

Friendly KROOT / VESPID STINGWINGS units have: Harnessed Alien Instincts: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is prey-marked (has +3" detection range while prey-marked).

This detachment has the BATTLESUIT tag and cannot be taken with another BATTLESUIT detachment.

_armyRule.name: For the Greater Good
_armyRule.rule:
The Hunter Cadres fight for the betterment of the T'au Empire, pinning enemies with deadly covering fire and exposing fortified positions with the infamous markerlight.

If your Army Faction is T'AU EMPIRE, at the start of your Shooting phase you can select units from your army with this ability to become Observer units. During that phase, for each Observer unit that has not been selected to shoot and is eligible to shoot (excluding FORTIFICATION and Battle-shocked units), select one visible enemy unit to be marked as its Spotted unit until the end of the phase (each enemy unit can be Spotted only once per phase). Units with this ability that are not Observers are Guided units while targeting one or more Spotted units.

Until the end of the phase, each time a model in a Guided unit makes an attack that targets a Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1, and — if the Spotted unit was marked by an Observer unit with the MARKERLIGHT keyword — that attack also has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

parts.name: Guided (vs Spotted unit)
parts.desc: A Guided unit attacking its army's Spotted unit improves its Ballistic Skill by 1. If the Spotted unit was marked by a MARKERLIGHT Observer unit, those attacks also gain [IGNORES COVER].

mathBuff.note: Guided vs Spotted: Ballistic Skill improved by 1; Ignores Cover when marked by a MARKERLIGHT unit

War Horde.rule: Melee attacks made by friendly ORKS units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Breakin' Heads
stratagems.when: Any phase, as a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.
stratagems.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit — being battle-shocked does not stop this stratagem targeting it.
stratagems.effect:
Roll one D3:
- Your unit takes mortal wounds equal to the result.
- Your unit ceases to be battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Hit 'Em Harder
stratagems.when: Fight phase, as a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: The selected ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks made by your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

mathBuff.note: Melee [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.when: Fight phase, as an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).
stratagems.target: The targeted ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Each time a model in your unit is destroyed, and your unit has not yet been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is riled up:
- On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield. It is removed once your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

stratagems.name: Mow 'Em Down
stratagems.when: Fight phase, as a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that charged this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: The selected ORKS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect:
Melee attacks made by your unit have:
- [CLEAVE 1].
- Or: Where the attack already has [CLEAVE], add 1 to that value instead (so [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.name: Fungus-fuel Injection
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, as a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move.
stratagems.target: The selected ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains +2" M.

stratagems.name: Close-range Dakka

stratagems.effect:
Ranged attacks made by your unit have:
- [RAPID FIRE 1].
- Or: Where the attack already has [RAPID FIRE], add 1 to that value instead (so [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

Dread Mob.rule:
When a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units) is selected to attack in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, you may use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6, re-rolling until the results differ. That unit's attacks gain the matching rule(s):
- 1-2: +1 A.
- 3-4: +2 S.
- 5-6: +1 AP.

Where two D6 were rolled, the unit makes one hazard roll once it has attacked.

When every one of a friendly BIG MEK/MEK GUNZ/MORKANAUT/WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit's ranged attacks is aimed at a single enemy unit in your Shooting phase, roll one D6:

Wurrband.rule:

Roar of Mork (psychic level 1): In your Movement phase, provided this unit is not battle-shocked, you may make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- Pick one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 from that battle-shock roll for every 10 models in this unit.

Visions of Violence (psychic level 1): At the start of the Fight phase, provided this unit is not battle-shocked, you may make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.

_armyRule.name: Waaagh!
_armyRule.rule:
WAAAGH!
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
- Re-roll advance rolls.
- Become riled up, as stated in other rules.

While a unit is riled up:
- That unit has 5+ InSv.
- That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
- When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.

DA BOSS
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

UNSTABLE ENERGIES
ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.
In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

parts.name: Riled up
parts.desc: While riled up: 5+ InSv, ranged attacks have [ASSAULT], and an advance move no longer stops the unit declaring a charge. Unlike the index Waaagh!, there is no +1 Strength or +1 Attack in melee - that damage moved into the reworked datasheets. Riling up is no longer only the once-per-battle War Cry: several datasheets and detachment rules rile units up on their own.

parts.name: Da Boss
parts.desc: At the start of each battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, you gain 1CP.

parts.name: Unstable Energies
parts.desc: ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or more (given in the unit's abilities), and each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or more (given in its name). In each battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use any psychic abilities whose psychic levels add up to no more than its psyker level. For example, a psyker level 3 unit could use three level 1 abilities, a level 1 and a level 2, or a single level 3 ability.

enhancements.name: Veil of Darkness
enhancements.desc:
(Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent's turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do:
- Place this unit in strategic reserves.
- This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase.
- This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

enhancements.name: Nether-realm Casket
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Phasal Subjugator
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding CHARACTER units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the hit roll.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Overseer
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Hyperphasing rule.

enhancements.name: Eternal Madness
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. In the Fight phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit is destroyed, if that model had not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Ingrained Superiority
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Soulless Reaper
enhancements.desc: DESTROYER CULT model only. Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit is selected to Fall Back, roll one D6. On a 3+, that unit cannot Fall Back and must Remain Stationary.

enhancements.name: Eldritch Nightmare
enhancements.desc: DESTROYER CULT model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Sanctum
enhancements.desc: CRYPTEK model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Hyperphasic Fulcrum
enhancements.desc: CRYPTEK model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, if that unit is wholly within your army's Power Matrix, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Autodivinator
enhancements.desc: CRYPTEK model only. Each time your opponent gains a CP as a result of an ability, roll one D6: on a 2+, you also gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Metalodermal Tesla Weave
enhancements.desc: CRYPTEK model only. Once per phase, when an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as a target of a charge, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Honourable Combatant
enhancements.desc: OVERLORD model only. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, your opponent loses 1CP if they have any.

enhancements.name: Unflinching Will
enhancements.desc: OVERLORD model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] and [ANTI-INFANTRY 5+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Warrior Noble
enhancements.desc: OVERLORD model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Eternal Conqueror
enhancements.desc: OVERLORD model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Enaegic Dermal Bond
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: Arisen Tyrant
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the bearer's unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

enhancements.name: Hyperspatial Transfer Node
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. Each time the bearer's unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Osteoclave Fulcrum
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Enlivened Sentinels
enhancements.desc: NECRON WARRIORS unit only. This unit has Scouts 5".

enhancements.name: Tools of Dominion
enhancements.desc: IMMORTALS unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1].

enhancements.name: Recursive Reanimation
enhancements.desc: TOMB BLADES unit only. When this unit activates its Reanimation Protocols, add 1 to the roll.

enhancements.name: Deepening Madness
enhancements.desc: DESTROYER CULT MOUNTED unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

enhancements.name: Prelocational Optimiser
enhancements.desc: NECRONS model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, if it was set up using a Monolith's Eternity Gate ability this turn, its ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Mortality Shroud (Aura)
enhancements.desc: OBELISK unit only. In your opponent's Battle-shock step, if an enemy unit within 8" is below Starting Strength, that unit makes a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Dread Majesty (Aura)
enhancements.desc: OVERLORD or CATACOMB COMMAND BARGE model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC) is within 6" of the bearer, each model re-rolls a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Miniaturised Nebuloscope

If it does, select one of those NECRON WARRIORS units; that unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. The same NECRON WARRIORS unit cannot be selected for this ability more than once per turn.

abilities.name: Transport
abilities.desc: This model has a transport capacity of 10 NECRON WARRIOR models and 1 NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model.

abilities.name: Invasion Beams
abilities.desc: At the end of the Fight phase, if there are no models currently embarked within this TRANSPORT, you can select one friendly NECRONS INFANTRY unit wholly within 6" of this TRANSPORT. Unless that unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can embark within this TRANSPORT. That unit can embark within this TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from this TRANSPORT.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-4 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-4 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Quantum Invader
abilities.desc: This model can be set up in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

abilities.name: Transport
abilities.desc: This model has a transport capacity of 1 NECRONS INFANTRY unit.

abilities.name: Atavistic Instigation
abilities.desc:
Each time this model targets an enemy unit with its heavy death ray, your opponent must declare if that unit will stand firm or duck for cover:
■ If it stands firm, when resolving attacks against that unit this phase, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
■ If it ducks for cover, until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-4 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-4 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-8 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-8 wounds remaining, subtract 4 from its Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Gravitic Pulse
abilities.desc: At the start of your opponent’s Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the end of the turn, halve the Move characteristic of models in that unit and halve Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit. In addition, if that unit can FLY, until the start of your next Movement phase, roll one D6 each time that unit ends any type of move: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-8 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-8 wounds remaining, subtract 4 from its Objective Control characteristic and you can only select one of the C'tan Powers weapons in your Shooting phase, instead of two.

abilities.name: Powers of the C’tan
abilities.desc: In your Shooting phase, when this model is selected to shoot, first select up to 2 different C’tan Powers weapons. Until the end of the phase, this model is equipped with those weapons in addition to its other weapons (this model cannot make attacks with any other C’tan Powers weapon you did not select in this way this phase).

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.desc: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-7 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-7 wounds remaining, subtract 4 from its Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Eternity Gate
abilities.desc: In your Movement phase (excluding the first battle round), you can select one friendly NECRONS INFANTRY unit that is either in strategic reserves or on the battlefield (if you select a unit on the battlefield, remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into strategic reserves). That unit can make an ingress move, and while making that ingress move, that unit must be set up wholly within 6" of this unit and unengaged (instead of more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units), even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone. That unit cannot make a charge move this turn.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.desc: Models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-6 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this unit’s Szarekh model has 1-6 wounds remaining, halve the Attacks characteristic of that model’s weapons, and each time this unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Voice of the Triarch
abilities.desc: At the start of the battle round, select one Triarch ability. Until the start of the next battle round, this unit has that ability.

abilities.name: The Silent King
abilities.desc: While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this unit’s Szarekh model, improve that unit’s Leadership characteristic by 1.

abilities.name: Triarchal Menhirs
abilities.desc: If this unit’s Szarekh model is destroyed, all of this unit’s remaining Triarchal Menhir models are also destroyed.

subAbilities.name: Phaeron of the Stars (Aura)
subAbilities.desc: While a friendly ^^**Necrons**^^ unit (excluding ^^**Monster^^** units) is within 6" of this unit’s Szarekh model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

subAbilities.name: Phaeron of the Blades (Aura)
subAbilities.desc: While a friendly ^^**Necrons^^** (excluding ^^**Monster^^** units) unit is within 6" of this unit’s Szarekh model, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit and each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

subAbilities.name: Relentless March (Aura)
subAbilities.desc: While a friendly ^^**Necrons^^** unit (excluding ^^**Monster^^** units) is within 6" of this unit’s Szarekh model, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

abilities.name: Reanimation Nodes (Aura)
abilities.desc: While a friendly NECRONS INFANTRY unit is within 6” of this FORTIFICATION, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

abilities.name: Ancient Cover
abilities.desc: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this FORTIFICATION, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

abilities.name: Deployment
abilities.desc: When this unit is first set up on the battlefield, its models do not have to be set up in Unit Coherency. Instead, each model must be set up wholly within 12" of one other model from its unit. From that point on, each model in this unit is treated as a separate unit.

abilities.name: Terrifying Monstrosity
abilities.desc: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more units with this ability must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-9 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-9 wounds remaining, subtract 5 from this model’s Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.desc: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

options.name: Two synaptic obliterators and two transdimensional projectors

abilities.name: Translocation Shroud
abilities.desc: Each time this model's unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit. In addition, each time a model in that unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, until that move is finished, it can move horizontally through models and terrain features (it cannot finish a move on top of another model or its base).

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.desc: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: My Will Be Done
abilities.desc: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc:
This model can be attached to the following units:
■ IMMORTALS
■ LYCHGUARD
■ NECRON WARRIORS

options.name: Resurrection orb
options.ability:
(Once per battle, per unit) At the end of any phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit resurrects:
- When a unit resurrects, that unit's Reanimation Protocols activate, but that unit heals D6 wounds (instead of D3 wounds). You cannot resurrect more than one unit per turn.

abilities.name: Harassment Swarm (Aura)
abilities.desc: While an enemy unit (excluding ^^**Monsters^^** and ^^**Vehicles^^**) is within 3" of this unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

wargearAbilities.name: Nanoscarab Projector
wargearAbilities.desc: Once per battle round, when a friendly ^^**Necrons^^** unit within 3" of the bearer activates its Reanimation Protocols, the bearer can use this ability. If it does, that unit reanimates 1 additional wound.

wargearAbilities.name: Accelerator Mandible
wargearAbilities.desc: At the start of the Fight phase, select one friendly ^^**Canoptek^^** unit within 3" of the bearer’s unit. Until the end of the phase, improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

abilities.name: Weapon Sentinels
abilities.desc: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Canoptek Retinue
abilities.desc: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, this unit can join one other unit from your army that is being led by a ^^**Cryptek^^** model (a unit cannot have more than one ^^**Tomb Crawlers^^** unit joined to it and cannot have both a ^^**Tomb Crawlers^^** and a ^^**Cryptothralls^^** unit joined to it). If it does, until the end of the battle, every model in this unit counts as being part of that Bodyguard unit, and that Bodyguard unit’s Starting Strength is increased accordingly.

models.name: Tomb Crawler w/ twin gauss reaper
Tomb Crawler w/ twin gauss reaper

abilities.name: Tectonic Reverberations
abilities.desc: In your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the start of your next Movement phase that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

abilities.name: Obelisk Node Control
abilities.desc: While this model is within range of an objective marker you control, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

abilities.name: Vanguard Protocols
abilities.desc: If this model is attached to a ^^**Canoptek Macrocytes^^** unit during the Declare Battle Formations step, this model has the Scouts 8" ability.

abilities.name: Support
abilities.desc: This model can be attached to the following units: ^^**Canoptek Macrocytes, Immortals, Necron Warriors^^**.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save (4+)
abilities.desc: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Protective Disciples
abilities.desc: While this model is within 3" of one or more other friendly ^^**Destroyer Cult^^** units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

abilities.name: Infectious Murder-madness (Aura)
abilities.desc: While a friendly ^^**Necrons^^** unit (excluding ^^**Monster**^^ and ^^**Titanic^^** units) is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, if that model has the ^^**Destroyer Cult^^** keyword or that enemy unit is the closest eligible target, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

abilities.name: Prophet of Destruction
abilities.desc: Each time this model destroys an enemy unit, select one other friendly ^^**Destroyer Cult^^** unit within 9" of it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

abilities.name: Nullstone Field Generator (Aura)
abilities.desc: While a friendly ^^**Necrons^^** unit is within 6" of the bearer, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

abilities.name: Phase Shift Generator (Aura)
abilities.desc: While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 3" of this Fortification, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Phase-shifted Cover
abilities.desc: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this Fortification, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-7 wounds remaining
abilities.desc: While this model has 1-7 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Fortification
abilities.desc:
While an enemy unit is only within Engagement Range of one or more ^^**Fortifications**^^ from your army:
- That unit can still be selected as the target of ranged attacks, but each time such an attack is made, unless it is made with a Pistol, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
- Models in that unit do not need to take Desperate Escape tests due to Falling Back while Battle-shocked, except for those that will move over enemy models when doing so.

abilities.name: Lord of the Pyrrhian Eternals
abilities.desc: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Mind in the Machine
abilities.desc: At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" of and visible to this model. That unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll; if that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.
