detData._format: ruleName + rule + stratagems [{name,type,cp,when,target,effect,mathBuff?}]. mathBuff scope: 'ranged'|'melee'|'all'. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Awakened Dynasty.rule: While a NECRONS CHARACTER model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Eternal Revenant
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has half of its starting number of wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Undying Legions
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit that had one or more models destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit reanimates D3 wounds (D3+1 if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading it).

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Hungry Void
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength of melee weapons in your unit. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading it, improve the Armour Penetration of those weapons by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 Strength melee; add +1 AP as well if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading the unit.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Sudden Storm
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading it, re-roll Advance rolls for it.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit that has not shot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading it, re-roll the Hit roll instead.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hits of 1 vs targets within half range (full re-roll if a CHARACTER leads the unit).

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Vengeful Stars
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit that was within 6" of that destroyed unit.
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit resolves its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but only targeting that enemy unit (if eligible).

Annihilation Legion.rule: Each time a DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit declares a charge, re-roll the Charge roll; if one or more targets are Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Charge roll. Each time a DESTROYER CULT unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, add 1 to the Armour Penetration of that attack.

stratagems.name: Masks of Death
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: The Spoor of Frailty
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that has not shot or fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit attacks a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

mathBuff.note: +1 Hit vs targets below Starting Strength; +1 Wound too vs Below Half-strength targets.

stratagems.name: Murderous Reanimation
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that just destroyed an enemy unit, or just took one Below Half-strength.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Hunters
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

stratagems.name: Blood-fuelled Cruelty
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move ending as close as possible to that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Insanity's Ire
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit this phase has shot.
stratagems.target: That DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Canoptek Court.rule: Your deployment zone is always within your Power Matrix. At the start of any phase, No Man's Land / your opponent's deployment zone is within your Power Matrix if you control at least half its objectives. Each time a model in a CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1; if that unit is wholly within your Power Matrix, re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: Curse of the Cryptek
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One CRYPTEK model destroyed by that unit's attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model attacks the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Cynosure of Eradication
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit wholly within your Power Matrix.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

mathBuff.note: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]. Requires the unit wholly within your Power Matrix.

stratagems.name: Solar Pulse
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective within 18". Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have [IGNORES COVER] while targeting units within range of that objective.

stratagems.name: Reactive Subroutines
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One CANOPTEK unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Countertemporal Shift
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CANOPTEK unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: Suboptimal Facade
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One CANOPTEK unit that was a target of that charge and is wholly within your Power Matrix.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.

Obeisance Phalanx.rule: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit. Until your next Command phase, each time a NOBLE, LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Your Time Is Nigh
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your opponent's WARLORD is destroyed.
stratagems.target: Your NECRONS WARLORD.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.

stratagems.name: Enslaved Artifice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding TITANIC) that has not shot or fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Nanoassembly Protocols
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Sentinels of Eternity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it has not fought, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it; it fights after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Suffer No Rival
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Territorial Obsession
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control of models in your unit (add 3 instead if it has the VEHICLE keyword).

Hypercrypt Legion.rule: At the end of your opponent's turn, you can select NECRONS units from your army that are not within Engagement Range: up to 1 unit (Incursion), up to 2 units (Strike Force) or up to 3 units (Onslaught). Remove them from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Hyperphasic Recall
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit that had models destroyed, and one friendly MONOLITH model.
stratagems.effect: Remove your INFANTRY unit and set it back up wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH and not within Engagement Range.

stratagems.name: Quantum Deflection
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Reanimation Crypts
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Your NECRONS WARLORD.
stratagems.effect: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: Cosmic Precision
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER units) that is arriving using an ingress move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (not eligible to charge that turn).

stratagems.name: Dimensional Corridor
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit set up this turn via a MONOLITH's Eternity Gate ability.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.

stratagems.name: Entropic Damping
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TITANIC model that was selected as a target and is within 18" of the attacking unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

Hand of the Dynasty.rule:
Friendly IMMORTALS / NECRON WARRIORS units' ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When such a unit is selected to make an Advance move, that move does not prevent it from being eligible to start an Action.
This detachment has the DYNASTY tag and cannot be taken with another DYNASTY detachment.

stratagems.name: Dominance Protocols
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly IMMORTALS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Will of the Conqueror
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly IMMORTALS / NECRON WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Nanosaturation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly IMMORTALS / NECRON WARRIORS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.

Skyshroud Spearhead.rule: Friendly TOMB BLADES units have Deep Strike. When a friendly TOMB BLADES unit is selected to shoot, if it made an ingress move this turn, its ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Omnilocked Strafing
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Swift as Death
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Evasive Protocols
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to Wound rolls.

The Phaeron's Armoury.rule:

_armyRule.name: Reanimation Protocols
_armyRule.rule:
Should a Necron be slain, its body becomes wreathed in an eerie glow — crawling limbs reattach and smashed forms reform amid emerald sparks as it rises again, while those too catastrophically damaged are teleported away for repair.

If your Army Faction is NECRONS, at the end of your Command phase, each friendly unit with this ability that is on the battlefield activates its Reanimation Protocols:
• When a unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate, that unit heals D3 wounds.

_armyRule.name: Prioritised Efficiency
_armyRule.rule:
The kinhost switches its strategic footing with ease — swiftly assessing a foe's possessions, seizing them for the kindred's need, then toiling stubbornly to hold them.

If your Army Faction is LEAGUES OF VOTANN, your units have one of two abilities — Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover — depending on your current Yield points (YP). At the start of the battle, units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase. At the end of your Command phase: if you have fewer than 7YP, units have Hostile Acquisition; if you have 7YP or more, units have Fortify Takeover (until the start of your next Command phase).

parts.name: Hostile Acquisition
parts.desc: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll. You can also re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

mathBuff.note: Hostile Acquisition — +1 to Hit vs an enemy within range of an objective marker

parts.name: Fortify Takeover
parts.desc: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack while this unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each time an attack targets this unit, if the attack's Strength is greater than this unit's Toughness and this unit is not a VEHICLE, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: Fortify Takeover — +1 to Hit while within range of a controlled objective

parts.name: Yield Points
parts.desc: At the end of each player's Command phase, you gain 1YP if you control one or more objective markers within your deployment zone. From the second battle round onwards, you gain 1 additional YP for each of: controlling one or more objectives not in your deployment zone; controlling two or more objectives not in your deployment zone; controlling more objectives than your opponent. In your turn, YP are gained before checking which ability your units have. Spending YP reduces your total (it cannot go below 0).

enhancements.name: Alien Cunning
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three **^^Tyranids^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Perfectly Adapted
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll, one Damage roll, one Advance roll, one Charge roll or one saving throw made for the bearer

enhancements.name: Synaptic Linchpin
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit is within 9" of the bearer, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Biology
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. At the start of any turn, if the bearer has fewer than its starting number of wounds remaining, until the end of the battle, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

enhancements.name: Instinctive Defense
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more **^^Harvester^^** units, you can target the bearer's unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP. In addition, while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly **^^Harvester^^** units, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Parasitic Biomorphology
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit. The first time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase while the bearer is within 6" of one or more **^^Harvester^^** units, until the end of battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only (excluding **^^Monsters^^** models) The bearer's unit can be regenerated up to twice per phase, instead of once.

enhancements.name: Biophagic Flow (Aura)
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Harvester^^** model is within 12" of the bearer, when using the Feed the Swarm ability, that **^^Harvester^^** model can Regenerate one friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit that is within 9" instead of one within 6".

enhancements.name: Monstrous Nemesis
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a **^^Monster^^**or **^^Vehicle^^**unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Null Nodules
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Once per battle, when a Psychic Attack is allocated to the bearer, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.name: Ominous Presence
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. Add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Enraged Reserves
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Monster^^** only. If the bearer is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. It can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Psychostatic Disruption
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Synapse^^** model only. Enemy units that arrive on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up with 12" of the bearer. In addition, once per battle, during the first or second battle round, when your opponent declares that a unit will arrive on the battlefield from Strategic Reserves, the bearer can use this enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy cannot arrive on the battlefield this turn.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Control
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Synapse^^** model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the attack.

enhancements.name: The Dirgeheart of Kharis (Aura)
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Synapse^^** model only. While an enemy unit is within 9" of the bearer, worsen that unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.

enhancements.name: Power of the Hive Mind
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids Psyker^^** model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of psychic weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Naturalised Camoflage
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. At the start of the first battle round, select up to three friendly **^^Endless Multitude^^** units within 9" of the bearer. Until the end of the battle round, each time a ranged attack targets one of those units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Piercing Talons
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Each time a model in the Bearer's unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Relentless Hunger
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Adrenalised Onslaught
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Pile In or Consolidation, models in this unit can move an additional 3"

enhancements.name: Hunting Grounds
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your opponent sets up a Reserves unit on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 2+ that unit must make a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Neuronode
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to three **^^Vanguard Invader^^** units from your army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Stalker
enhancements.desc: **^^Vanguard Invader^^** model only. At the start of the battle, select one enemy unit. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Chameleonic
enhancements.desc: **^^Vanguard Invader^^** only. The bearer has the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Sensory Assimilation
enhancements.desc: **^^Winged Tyranid Prime^^** model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Elevated Might
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Ocular Adaptation
enhancements.desc: **^^Winged Tyranid Prime^^** model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Tyrant
enhancements.desc: **^^Neurotyrant^^** model only. During the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a **^^Tyranid Warriors^^** unit.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Intellect
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.name: Trygon Prime
enhancements.desc: **^^Trygon^^** model only. The bearer gains the **^^Synapse^^** keyword. Improve the Strength and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Synergy
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.name: Tremor Senses
enhancements.desc: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three friendly **^^Tyranids^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Predatory Instincts
enhancements.desc: **^^Abominant^^**, **^^Biophagus^^** or **^^Patriarch^^** model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Infiltrators ability. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do: that use is -1CP; and that use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Biomorph Adaption
enhancements.desc: **^^Abominant ^^** or **^^Patriarch^^** model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Mutagenic Regeneration
enhancements.desc: **^^Abominant^^**, **^^Biophagus^^** or **^^Patriarch^^** model only. In each Command phase, one model in the bearer's unit regains 1 lost wound.

enhancements.name: Alien Majesty

enhancements.name: Martial Espionage
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults Infantry^^** model only. Once Per turn, when a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** or **^^Astra Militarum Mounted^^**unit within 9" of the bearer is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Reprisal
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults Infantry^^** model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

enhancements.name: The Hero Returned
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults Infantry^^** model only. Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer's unit by 1

enhancements.name: Fire-point Commander
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults Infantry^^** model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, while resolving that stratagem, hits are successfully scored on a 5+.

enhancements.name: Our Time is Nigh
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. Once per battle, when the bearer's unit declares a charge, the bearer can use the Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: A Chink in Their Armour
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. Each time the bearer is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, ranged weapons equipped in the bearer's unit have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

enhancements.name: Prowling Agitant
enhancements.desc: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

abilities.desc: Each time this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER model, you gain 1CP

abilities.name: Neural Disruption
abilities.desc: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of this model. That unit must take a Battle-shock test

abilities.name: Psychological Saboteur (Aura)
abilities.desc:
While an enemy unit is with 12" of this model, if that unit is Battle-shocked:

- Each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll
- Each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Paroxysm (Psychic)
abilities.desc: At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to this model and roll one D6: on a 1, this Psyker suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+, until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

abilities.name: Will of the Hive Mind
abilities.desc: Once per battle round, one model from your army with this ability can use it when a friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit within 12" of that model is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

abilities.name: Alpha Invader
abilities.desc: Weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

abilities.name: Hypersensory Array
abilities.desc: Once per battle round, you can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this turn.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.desc: This unit can be attached to the following units: **^^Raveners^^**

abilities.name: Serpentine Fiend
abilities.desc: This model can move through terrain features, but cannot end a move within a wall, a floor, etc. This model can be set up or end a move on any floor level of **^^Ruins^^**, but if that level is not the ground floor, it can only do so if its base does not overhang the floor at that level.

abilities.name: Swallow Whole
abilities.desc: Each time an attack with this model’s gaping maw targets an **^^Infantry^^**, **^^Mounted^^** or **^^Beasts^^** unit, each successful unmodified Wound roll is a Critical Wound. Each time an **^^Infantry^^**, **^^Mounted^^** or **^^Beasts^^** model is destroyed as a result of an attack made by this model’s gaping maw, this model regains up to D3+2 lost wounds.

abilities.name: Subterranean Hunter
abilities.desc: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detData._format: ruleName + rule + stratagems [{name,type,cp,when,target,effect,mathBuff?}]. mathBuff scope: 'ranged'|'melee'|'all'. Rebuild with build.ps1.

Brood Brother Auxilia.rule:
Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 18" and visible; until end of phase that ASTRA MILITARUM unit can only target it and that unit is caught in overlapping fire (each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model targets it with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll).

BROOD BROTHERS: include ASTRA MILITARUM units — Incursion 500 / Strike Force 1000 / Onslaught 1500 pts. A GENESTEALER CULTS model must be your WARLORD, and ASTRA MILITARUM models from your army lose the Voice of Command ability if they have it. You cannot include units with the following keywords: AIRCRAFT, COMMISSAR, EPIC HERO, MILITARUM TEMPESTUS, OGRYN, RATLING, TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER, MINISTORUM PRIEST.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Iron
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers; set it up anywhere more than 8" from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.

stratagems.name: Regimental Reinforcements
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY REGIMENT unit (excluding ARTILLERY/CHARACTER) is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: On a 3+, place a Cult Ambush marker more than 8" from enemy units and add a new identical unit in Cult Ambush at Starting Strength. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Suppress and Overwhelm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit. Until end of turn it cannot be targeted with Fire Overwatch, and each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit selects it as a charge target, re-roll the Charge roll.

stratagems.name: Acceptable Losses
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GENESTEALER CULTS units. Your unit can shoot it; after resolving, roll one D6 per those GSC units: on a 5+ that unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Symbiotic Destruction
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM and one GENESTEALER CULTS unit that have not shot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to and in range of both. Until end of phase those units can only target it, and each time such a model attacks, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Wounds of 1 (both selected units must focus the one chosen enemy unit).

stratagems.name: A Dark Network
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up from Reserves.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM or GENESTEALER CULTS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Biosanctic Broodsurge.rule: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS and PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units. Each time such a unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, until end of phase add 1 to the Attacks of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Evasive Vanguard
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing them.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: Set it up anywhere more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Saintly Paroxysm
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model.
stratagems.target: That destroyed CHARACTER model. You can use this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (2D3 if the model was an ABOMINANT or PATRIARCH).

stratagems.name: Gene-twisted Muscle
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound, only vs MONSTER or VEHICLE targets.

stratagems.name: Hyper-metabolic Vigour
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3" and need not end closer to the closest enemy model (just as close as possible to the closest enemy unit).

stratagems.name: Stimulated Bio-surge
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Bio-horror Revelation
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit within 9" is selected to shoot, it takes a Leadership test (−1); if failed, its attacks targeting your unit are at −1 to Hit.

Outlander Claw.rule: While a GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or VEHICLE model is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to its Objective Control. At the end of your Command phase, if one or more ATALAN JACKALS units are within range of an objective marker you control, it remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Along Shadowed Trails
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: Set it up anywhere more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Devoted Crew
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GOLIATH ROCKGRINDER or GOLIATH TRUCK unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Close-range Shoot-out
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit that has not shot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".

mathBuff.note: Ranged [LETHAL HITS] vs targets within 18".

stratagems.name: Rapid Feint
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ACHILLES RIDGERUNNERS or ATALAN JACKALS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Deft Manoeuvring
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ACHILLES RIDGERUNNERS or ATALAN JACKALS unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Encircling the Prey
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit not within Engagement Range and wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Xenocreed Congregation.rule: For each ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS and NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit, while one or more CHARACTER models are leading it, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for it. If that CHARACTER is a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD, it has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability while leading that unit.

stratagems.name: Vengeance for the Martyr!
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model.
stratagems.target: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly ACOLYTE/HYBRID METAMORPHS/NEOPHYTE model attacks that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 (full re-roll if the destroyed model was a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD).

stratagems.name: Frenzied Devotion
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding CHARACTERS) in your unit by 1, and those weapons have [HAZARDOUS].

mathBuff.note: +1 Attacks and +1 to Hit (improved WS) melee, with [HAZARDOUS]. Non-CHARACTER models.

stratagems.name: Tireless Fervour
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit made an Advance or Fall Back move this turn, that move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge. When your unit declares a charge, you can use this part of this Stratagem. If you do: your unit can re-roll the Charge roll; and your unit must end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit that is engaged with a friendly CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.name: Transcendent Celerity
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit that has not shot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: The Downtrodden Rise
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit on the battlefield without a Cult Ambush marker, more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: The Path of Anguish
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit that had models destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", ending as close as possible to the closest enemy unit, possibly within Engagement Range.

Host of Ascension.rule: Each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Trap
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units that have not shot or fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (within Engagement Range of both if used in Fight). Until end of phase those units can only target it, and each time a model in them attacks, add 1 to the Wound roll.

mathBuff.note: +1 Wound (both selected units must focus the one chosen enemy unit).

stratagems.name: Primed and Readied
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit that has not shot or fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

stratagems.name: Tunnel Crawlers
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit arriving via Deep Strike this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (not eligible to charge that turn).

stratagems.name: Lying in Wait
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE unit in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up via a Cult Ambush marker, set up wholly within 6" of it and not within Engagement Range of enemy units.

stratagems.name: Return to the Shadows
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: A Deadly Snare
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit that was a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, 3 mortal wounds.

Heroes of the Uprising.rule:
Friendly KELERMORPH / LOCUS / REDUCTUS SABOTEUR / SANCTUS models have the KILLER keyword.
Friendly KILLER models' attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Living Up to Legend
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit has attacked, if those attacks destroyed an enemy unit or an enemy CHARACTER model.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect: Each visible friendly Battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of your unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Surging Broodworship
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks made by KILLER models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Loyal to the End
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly KILLER unit.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect: When a KILLER model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: on a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 2+, do not remove that model. It is removed after your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase.

Purestrain Broodswarm.rule:
At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, friendly unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units can be placed in Strategic Reserves.
This detachment has the PURESTRAIN tag and cannot be taken with another PURESTRAIN detachment.

stratagems.name: Lurk and Strike
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Crawling Horror
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has 6" detection range until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Inhuman Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

Xenocult Masses.rule:
In your Command phase, if a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is within a terrain feature, that unit heals 3 wounds.
This detachment has the HOSTS tag and cannot be taken with another HOSTS detachment.

stratagems.name: Eyes of the Cult
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a terrain feature.
stratagems.effect: Enemy units within that terrain feature have +6" detection range.

stratagems.name: Fanatical Hail
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Your unit's ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can re-roll Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Slunk from the Underbelly
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit with every model within a terrain feature.
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that unit has attacked.

Final Day.rule:
At the end of your Movement phase, for each TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army, you can select one friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit (excluding PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS and PATRIARCH units) and one friendly TYRANIDS unit, each within 9" of and visible to that SYNAPSE unit. If you do, that GENESTEALER CULTS unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds, one model in the selected TYRANIDS unit regains up to that many lost wounds, and until the start of your next Movement phase each model in the selected TYRANIDS unit adds 1 to its Hit rolls.
TYRANIDS units from your army have: Catalyst (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
THE STAR CHILDREN'S BLESSINGS: You can include TYRANIDS VANGUARD INVADER units (excluding AIRCRAFT, BROODLORD and GENESTEALERS units) up to a points cap by battle size (Incursion 500 / Strike Force 1000 / Onslaught 1500). No TYRANIDS model can be your Warlord.

stratagems.name: Hyperferocity
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each model re-rolls a Wound roll of 1; if one or more friendly TYRANIDS units are within 6" of the target, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Divine Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of a friendly engaged TYRANIDS unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That GENESTEALER CULTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 to Charge rolls; optionally it can re-roll the Charge roll but must end engaged with an enemy unit that is engaged with that friendly TYRANIDS unit.

stratagems.name: Psi Surge
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit's Catalyst ability by 3". You cannot use this Stratagem again until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Darting Attacks
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Star Children
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS CHARACTER unit from your army destroyed by that enemy unit this phase (usable even though just destroyed).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each GENESTEALER CULTS model that targets that enemy unit adds 1 to the Hit roll and 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Resistance Tunnels
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS or TYRANIDS unit from your army not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

_armyRule.name: Cult Ambush
_armyRule.rule:
Genestealer Cults hide their strength until the Day of Ascension, then emerge with intimate knowledge of the battlefield as reinforcements slip from the shadows or spill up from below.

If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, you start the battle with Resurgence points based on battle size: Incursion 6, Strike Force 10, Onslaught 14.

Each time a unit from your army in which every model has this ability is destroyed, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points (by unit and Starting Strength, below). If you do: add a new unit identical to the destroyed one (excluding CHARACTER models) in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength with full wounds and any [ONE SHOT] weapons treated as not yet fired; then place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units (if impossible, no marker is placed).

parts.name: Resurgence Costs
parts.desc:
Aberrants: 5 models = 4 RP, 10 models = 8 RP.
Acolyte Hybrids (Autopistols / Hand Flamers) & Hybrid Metamorphs: 5 = 2 RP, 10 = 4 RP.
Atalan Jackals: 5 = 2 RP, 10 = 6 RP.
Neophyte Hybrids: 10 = 3 RP, 20 = 6 RP.
Purestrain Genestealers: 5 = 2 RP, 10 = 6 RP.

parts.name: Units in Cult Ambush
parts.desc: Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up using a Cult Ambush marker (below) or via the rules for Strategic Reserves in a later turn.

parts.name: Cult Ambush Markers
parts.desc: Use a 32mm circular marker. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each surviving marker you can set up one of your Cult Ambush units more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, with at least one model touching the marker and all others wholly within 3" of it (the marker is then removed).

enhancements.name: Guiding Presence
enhancements.desc: Aeldari Psyker model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one friendly Aeldari Vehicle model within 9" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time that model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Conductor of Torment
enhancements.desc:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In your Command phase, you can do one of the following:
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently losing the wager, you can gain 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Drukhari**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently winning the wager, you can discard 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Harlequins**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.

enhancements.name: Reaper's Cowl
enhancements.desc: ^^**Harlequins**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth and Infiltrators abilities.

enhancements.name: Webway walker
enhancements.desc: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if that unit is currently losing the wager, until the end of the turn, you can re‑roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Harmonisation Matrix
enhancements.desc: Aeldari model only. In your Command phase, if the bearer (or any Transport it is embarked within) is within range of an objective marker you control, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Spirit Stone of Raelyth
enhancements.desc: Aeldari Psyker model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly Aeldari Vehicle units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability. In your Command phase, you can select one friendly Aeldari Vehicle model within 3" of the bearer. That model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Guileful Strategist
enhancements.desc: Aeldari model only. If your army includes the bearer, after both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Aeldari Vehicle units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Aspect of Murder
enhancements.desc: **^^Autarch^^** or **^^Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and those weapons have the **[PRECISION]** ability.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Wisdom
enhancements.desc: ^^**Autarch^^** or ^^**Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. While the bearer is leading an ^^**Aspect Warriors^^** unit, each time that unit is selected to shoot or fight, until the end of the phase, models in that unit gain both of the abilities from the Path of the Warrior Detachment rule.

enhancements.name: Shimmerstone
enhancements.desc: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Strategic Savant
enhancements.desc: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Gaze of Ynnead
enhancements.desc: Farseer model only. The bearer's Eldritch Storm weapon has the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

enhancements.name: Storm of Whispers
enhancements.desc: Warlock model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Borrowed Vigour
enhancements.desc: **^^Archon^^** model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Morbid Might
enhancements.desc: Succubus model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Cegorach's Coil
enhancements.desc: Troupe Master model only. Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, then roll one D6 for each model in the bearer's unit that is within Engagment Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

enhancements.name: Mask of Secrets
enhancements.desc: Harlequins model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

enhancements.name: Murder's Jest
enhancements.desc: Death Jester model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a unit that is below Half-strength, each successful Hit scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Mistweave
enhancements.desc: Shadowseer model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Craftworld's Champion
enhancements.desc: Asuryani model only. The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

enhancements.name: Ethereal Pathway
enhancements.desc: Asuryani model only. In the Deploy Armies step, select up to two Guardians units from your army. Models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Protector of the Paths
enhancements.desc: Asuryani model only. While the bearer is leading a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit, once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP, and while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control.

enhancements.name: Breath of Vaul
enhancements.desc: **^^Asuryani^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a **^^Storm Guardians^^** unit, each time you roll to determine the number of attacks made with a flamer equipped by a model in that unit, you can re-roll the result, and each time you make a Damage roll for a model equipped with a Guardian fusion gun in that unit, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.name: Crucible of Malediction
enhancements.desc: **^^Haemonculus^^** model only. Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend 1 Pain token. Then, each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if you spent 1 Pain token. Each time a **^^Psyker^^** unit fails that test, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Eye of Spite
enhancements.desc: **^^Succubus^^** model only. Improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

enhancements.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
enhancements.desc:
**^^Archon^^** model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can do one of the following:
Spend 1 Pain token and gain 1CP.
Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Dark Vitality
enhancements.desc: **^^Drukhari^^** model only. The bearer's unit is always Empowered - you do not need to spend any Pain tokens to activate that unit's Pain abilities

enhancements.name: Lucid Eye
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. In your Command phase, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the value of one Fate dice in your Fate dice pool.

enhancements.name: Runes of Warding
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds, Psychic Attacks and Critical Wounds caused by attacks with the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

enhancements.name: Stone of Eldritch Fury
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. Add 12" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Torc of Morai-Heg
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Psyker model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of the bearer with a Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, increase the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Phantasmal Smoke
enhancements.desc:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within 6" of a friendly ^^**Drukhari Transport**^^:
Models in the bearer’s unit have the  Stealth ability
Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Sadistic Fulcrum
enhancements.desc: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time you spend 1 Pain token to Empower the bearer’s unit in the Shooting phase, select one friendly ^^**Drukhari Transport**^^ within 6" of the bearer’s unit; until the end of the phase, each time that ^^**Transport**^^ makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Spiteful Raider
enhancements.desc: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, if that enemy unit was within range of one or more objective markers when the bearer’s unit was selected to fight, you gain 1 additional Pain token.

enhancements.name: Nightmare Shroud
enhancements.desc: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time the bearer’s unit disembarks from a ^^**Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Light of Clarity
enhancements.desc: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of Infanty models in that unit and add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic of Monster models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Stave of Kurnous
enhancements.desc: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer (excluding Titanic units). Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [Precision] ability.

enhancements.name: Rune of Mists
enhancements.desc: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, unless the attacking model is within 18, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Higher Duty
enhancements.desc: Spiritseer model only. Oncer per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of the bearer, the bearer's unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Psychic Destroyer
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ ^^Psyker^^ model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Phoenix Gem
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, remove it from play, then, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one of more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Gift of Foresight
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Timeless Strategist
enhancements.desc: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. At the start of the battle round, if the bearer is on the battlefield (or any Transport it is embarked within is on the battlefield), you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.

enhancements.name: Firstdrawn Blade
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Mirage Field
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Seersight Strike
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted Psyker model only. Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer have the [Anti-Monster 2+] and [Anti-Vehicle 2+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Echoes of Ulthanesh
enhancements.desc: Asuryani Mounted model only. In your Command phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is not within your deployment zone, and adding an additional 1 to the result if the bearer is within your opponent's deployment zone: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Master Regenesist
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Each time the bearer uses its Fleshcraft ability, you can return up to D3+3 destroyed Bodyguard models to the bearer's unit instead of D3+1.

enhancements.name: Master Nemesine
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. The bearer's weapons have the ^^**[Anti-Beast 2+]**^^ and ^^**[Anti-Monster 4+]**^^ abilities.

enhancements.name: Master Artisan
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic and add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Master Repugnomancer [Aura]
enhancements.desc: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer's Fear Incarnate ability, and each time a friendly ^^**Drukhari**^^ within 9" of the bearer fails a Battle-shock test or is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 4+, you gain 1 Pain token.

enhancements.name: Leechbite Plate
enhancements.desc: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+. At the start of either player's Command phase, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, the bearer regains all of its lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Webway Awl
enhancements.desc: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability, and you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Informant Network

enhancements.name: Towering Arrogance
enhancements.desc: ^^**Archon**^^ models only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pharmacophex
enhancements.desc: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. At the start of your Command phase, after selecting which Combat Drugs will be active for your army, roll one D6 and consult the Combat Drugs list. The result rolled applies to the bearer's unit until the start of your next Command phase in addition to any other Combat Drugs that are active for your army. If you randomly select one that is already active for your army, it has no additional effect.

enhancements.name: Chronoshard
enhancements.desc: ^^** Succubus**^^ model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Periapt of Torments
enhancements.desc: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Morghenna's Curse
enhancements.desc: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1.

enhancements.name: Key of Ghosts
enhancements.desc: ^^**Harlequins**^^ model only (excluding ^^**Solitaire**^^ models). Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Fanged Leer
enhancements.desc: ^^**Death Jester**^^ model only. When using the bearer’s Cruel Amusement ability, you can select two of the abilities for its shrieker cannon to gain, instead of one.

enhancements.name: Shedskin Raiment
enhancements.desc: ^^**Shadowseer**^^ model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Harlequins units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Weavers' Wail
enhancements.desc: ^^**Troupe Master**^^ model only. Add 3 to the Strength and add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Pirate Prince
enhancements.desc: ^^**Prince Yriel**^^ unit only. Each time you spend a Battle Focus token to enable this unit to perform an Agile Manoeuvre, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Battle Focus token.

enhancements.name: Alacritous Assault
enhancements.desc: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the ^^**[LANCE]**^^ ability.

enhancements.name: Exotic Munitions
enhancements.desc: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the ^^**[ANTI‑MONSTER 5+]**^^ and ^^**[ANTI‑VEHICLE 5+]**^^ abilities.

enhancements.name: Adrenal Infusions
enhancements.desc: ^^**Anhrathe Infantry**^^ unit only. This unit can perform the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre without spending a Battle Focus token to do so. It can do so even if other units have done so in the same phase, and doing so does not prevent other units from performing the same Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase.

enhancements.name: Infamy (Aura)
enhancements.desc: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. While an enemy unit is within 3” of this unit, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit (to a minimum of 1).

enhancements.name: Webway Pathstone
enhancements.desc: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. Models in this unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can use this ability. If it does, remove this unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Archraider
enhancements.desc:
^^**Anhrathe Character**^^ unit only. At the start of the battle, select one ^^**Character**^^ model in this unit. That model has the following ability: 


**Lord of Deceit (Aura):** Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12” of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Voidstone
enhancements.desc: ^^**Anhrathe Infantry**^^ unit only. Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Periapt of Torments
enhancements.desc: SUCCUBUS model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Hyperstimm Trafficker
enhancements.desc: SUCCUBUS model only. This unit has +1 T.

enhancements.name: Towering Arrogance
enhancements.desc: ARCHON model only. This unit has +1 Ld and +1 OC.

enhancements.name: Contempt for Rivals
enhancements.desc: ARCHON model only. This unit's attacks have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Gnarlskin Experimentor
enhancements.desc: HAEMONCULUS model only. Each time an attack targets this unit, if the Strength of that attack is greater than this unit's Toughness, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Elixir of the Corpse Courts
enhancements.desc: CRONOS / TALOS unit only. This unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

Realspace Raiders.rule: At the start of the battle, gain 2 Pain tokens for each combination your army contains (cumulative, up to 6): ARCHON + KABALITE WARRIORS; SUCCUBUS + WYCHES; HAEMONCULUS + WRACKS.

stratagems.name: Insensible to Pain
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Fighting Shadows
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit (excluding HAEMONCULUS COVENS) that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Instinctive Spite
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two DRUKHARI BATTLELINE units, or one other DRUKHARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Spend 1 Pain token optionally. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in those units attacks an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll (and +1 Wound if you spent the token).

mathBuff.note: +1 Hit vs Below Half-strength targets (spend 1 Pain token for +1 Wound too).

stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two WRACKS units, or one other DRUKHARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

mathBuff.note: Melee [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two WYCHES units, or one other DRUKHARI unit, that have not moved this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Raid and Fade

stratagems.effect: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6" (not within Engagement Range; not eligible to charge this turn).
