stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Spectacle of Spite.rule:
At the start of your Command phase, select (or roll two D6 for) Combat Drugs active for WYCH CULT models until your next Command phase (each selectable once per battle):
1. Adrenalight: +1 Attacks melee.
2. Hypex: +2" Move.
3. Serpentin: +1 Weapon Skill melee.
4. Painbringer: +1 Toughness.
5. Grave Lotus: +1 Strength melee.
6. Splintermind: +1 Leadership and +1 Ballistic Skill.

stratagems.name: Berserk Fugue
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WYCH CULT unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it has not fought, do not remove it; it fights after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Deadly Debut
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit that made a Charge move this turn and has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons in your unit have [LETHAL HITS]. If a WYCHES unit, also improve the Armour Penetration of those weapons by 1.

mathBuff.note: Melee [LETHAL HITS] (must have charged). WYCHES units also get +1 AP — add apMod:1 if simulating Wyches.

stratagems.name: Feigned Weakness
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That DRUKHARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Agility
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ignore modifiers to its Move and to Advance/Charge rolls, and it can move horizontally through models.

stratagems.name: A Challenge Met
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fallback move.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged WYCH CULT unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fallback move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: Acrobatic Display
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WYCH CULT unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Covenite Coterie.rule: Each time an attack targets a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Postmortality
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One HAEMONCULUS model just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent. You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with it more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Symphony of Suffering
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That DRUKHARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 9" and visible must take a Battle-shock test (−1 if your unit is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit).

stratagems.name: Poisoner's Art
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit has fought.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit. Until end of battle it is poisoned; at the start of each Command phase roll one D6 per poisoned unit: on a 4+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Distillers of Fear
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a Battle-shocked enemy unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

mathBuff.note: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS], only vs Battle-shocked enemy units.

stratagems.name: Connoisseurs of Pain
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Spend 1 Pain Token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit, you gain 1 Pain Token.

stratagems.name: Enfolding Nightmare
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Kabalite Cartel.rule:
At the start of the first battle round, select one Contract and a matching enemy unit as your Contract unit. KABAL and BLADES FOR HIRE units gain the Contract ability; when the Contract unit is destroyed, the Contract completes and you gain 3 Pain tokens.
- Trophy Hunters (CHARACTER): [PRECISION] vs the Contract unit.
- Sow Fear and Terror (INFANTRY/MOUNTED): [SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs INFANTRY/MOUNTED.
- Show of Strength (MONSTER/VEHICLE): [LETHAL HITS] vs MONSTER/VEHICLE.

stratagems.name: Double-Cross
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit selected as a target, and one friendly DRUKHARI unit (excluding VEHICLES).
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time you would allocate an attack to your KABAL/BLADES unit, if your other DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacker, no save is made; instead that DRUKHARI unit suffers mortal wounds equal to the attack's Damage.

stratagems.name: Taken Alive
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result, every enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test.

mathBuff.note: +1 Hit melee.

stratagems.name: Tailored Toxins
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit that has not shot or fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Enemies Without Number
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.
stratagems.target: One ARCHON WARLORD from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select a new Contract and a matching enemy unit as your Contract unit (Murderous Agenda applies as normal).

stratagems.name: Making a Point
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit that has not shot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

mathBuff.note: +1 to Hit (improved BS) and +1 AP on ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Deadly Deceivers
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Exhibition of Slaughter.rule:
Friendly WYCH CULT units' melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS] against non-MONSTER/VEHICLE targets.
This detachment has the WYCH CULT tag and cannot be taken with another WYCH CULT detachment.

stratagems.name: Planned Strikes
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That WYCH CULT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

mathBuff.note: [LETHAL HITS] melee for a WYCH CULT unit.

stratagems.name: Sculpting the Stage
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That WYCH CULT unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an Action.

stratagems.name: Acrobatic Display
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WYCH CULT unit.
stratagems.target: That WYCH CULT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

Kabalite Agonysts.rule:
Friendly BLADES FOR HIRE / KABAL units' ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] against non-MONSTER/VEHICLE targets.
This detachment has the KABAL tag and cannot be taken with another KABAL detachment.

stratagems.name: Prioritised Victim
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE / KABAL unit targets a CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.target: That BLADES FOR HIRE / KABAL unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

mathBuff.note: Re-roll Hits/Wounds of 1 vs CHARACTER targets.

stratagems.name: Shadows' Reach
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE / KABAL unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That BLADES FOR HIRE / KABAL unit.
stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.name: Killers from the Dark Spires
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KABALITE WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That KABALITE WARRIORS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

mathBuff.note: [IGNORES COVER] ranged for KABALITE WARRIORS.

Tools of Torment.rule:
Each time an attack targets a friendly CRONOS / TALOS unit, if the Strength of that attack is greater than the Toughness of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
This detachment has the COVENS tag and cannot be taken with another COVENS detachment.

stratagems.name: Salting the Wound
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CRONOS / TALOS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That CRONOS / TALOS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks that target a Battle-shocked unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

mathBuff.note: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] vs a Battle-shocked target.

stratagems.name: Dividends of Agony
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, with -1 to that test.

stratagems.name: Urgent Metamorphosis
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Reaper's Wager.rule:
At the start of the battle, DRUKHARI units from your army are winning the wager. Each time a DRUKHARI unit destroys an enemy unit, DRUKHARI units are winning the wager; each time a HARLEQUINS unit destroys an enemy unit, HARLEQUINS units are winning the wager. While one is winning, the other is losing.
Each time a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS model from your army makes an attack: if its unit is winning the wager, re-roll a Hit roll of 1; if its unit is losing the wager, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1 instead.
HARLEQUINS: You can include HARLEQUINS units (Codex: Aeldari) up to a points cap by battle size (Incursion 500 / Strike Force 1000 / Onslaught 1500); no HARLEQUINS model can be your Warlord. Taking this Detachment replaces the Corsairs and Travelling Players army rule.

stratagems.name: Malicious Frenzy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

mathBuff.note: [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Shorten the Odds
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit Advances.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Fateful Role
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed before fighting, roll one D6 (+1 if losing the wager): on a 4+, it is not removed and fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Scintillating Tempo
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit moves, is set up, or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use Fire Overwatch to shoot at your unit.

stratagems.name: Murderer's Circus
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Dance Macabre
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6" (up to 6" instead if it is currently losing the wager).

_armyRule.name: Power from Pain
_armyRule.rule:
The Drukhari feed on suffering. As the battle rages they drink deep of the floodtide of pain, sinews singing with stolen strength, and fight all the harder to extract yet sweeter agonies from their prey.

If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI, you Empower units that have Pain abilities by spending Pain tokens.

parts.name: Pain Abilities
parts.desc: All DRUKHARI units have a Pain ability (tagged with the word 'Pain'). Pain abilities apply to a unit only while it is Empowered. (Pain tokens can also be spent to activate effects in certain Enhancements and Stratagems.)

parts.name: Gaining Pain Tokens
parts.desc: You gain Pain tokens as follows: 1 at the start of your Command phase; 1 each time an enemy unit is destroyed; 1 each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test. Keep gained tokens in your Pain token pool; spending a token reduces the pool by that amount.

parts.name: Empowered Through Pain
parts.desc: Each Pain ability states when you can spend Pain tokens to Empower that unit. When you do, until the end of the phase that unit is Empowered and all of its Pain abilities take effect. While an Attached unit is Empowered, the Pain abilities of all Leader and Bodyguard units in it also take effect (no additional tokens required).

parts.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
parts.desc: You can include HARLEQUINS and ANHRATHE units even though they do not have the DRUKHARI Faction keyword. The combined points value depends on battle size: Incursion up to 250 pts, Strike Force up to 500 pts, Onslaught up to 750 pts. None of these models can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.
